Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value:

  • Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables.

  • Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy.

  • Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients.

The role 🔍

One wrong number in a pitch deck can cost a banker a client. Our users send pitch decks, financial models and investment reports to clients every day, and AI now writes a growing part of them. Someone has to make sure what goes out is right.

You will own that problem. You will build the product that checks deliverables before they leave the building: numbers that match between the Excel model and the deck, totals that add up, sources and footnotes that are there, disclaimers that are complete, AI-generated text that says only what the data supports.

This is a Senior PM role (L3 on our career ladder). You frame the problem, not only the solution.

The team 🧑‍🤝‍🧑

You will join the Product team: 5 PMs, 2 product designers and 2 product marketing managers. You will work every day with a product designer and with your own engineering squad. You will report to Matteo, our Chief Product Officer.

How we work 🤖

We are an AI-first product team. We lead the move to AI tools across the whole company, and we hold ourselves to that standard first.

We build with AI. Our designers build and maintain front-end experiences themselves, directly in Claude Code. PMs test working prototypes with clients before development starts.

We discover with AI. We regularly co-design experiences with customers using vibe coding: we build and change the prototype with them, in the same session.

What this means for you:

  • Short loops. An idea goes from a client call to something clients can click in days.

  • Real ownership. You own the problem, the customer and the go-to-market, not only the backlog.

  • Room to grow. AI skills are part of our career ladder. As a Senior PM, you will build skills and agents the whole team uses, and help set how PMs work with AI at UpSlide.

Team goals 🎯

We run two workstreams: we keep improving the features thousands of financial professionals use every day, and we are building our new AI product. We launched our first AI product in April 2026 and we are rebuilding the full product around AI.

Verification is a core part of that bet. Financial firms will only let AI produce client work if they can trust the output. If we make trust measurable, we win the deals our competitors cannot.

Your responsibilities 🖋️

Own the verification product (50%)

  • Run discovery with bankers, financial advisors, PE and asset management teams. Learn how they review a deck or a model today, what they miss, and what an error costs them.

  • Define what "verified" means for each type of deliverable: pitch deck, financial model, investment report.

  • Build and own the roadmap across 2 squads. Say no to good ideas to protect the important ones. Plan a quarter ahead and adjust.

  • Test prototypes on real client files before development starts.

Drive adoption and revenue (30%)

  • Define the tracking plan before launch. Run a monthly metrics review of your area.

  • Partner with Sales on key deals and with Product Marketing on launches.

  • Send a weekly update an exec can read in 2 minutes.

  • Mentor 1 or 2 PMs and interview candidates.

Set the quality bar for AI (20%)

  • Build the eval sets and guardrails for verification. Track false positives as closely as missed errors: a checker that cries wolf gets switched off.

  • Make the cost, latency and accuracy trade-offs with Engineering.

  • Set the quality standard our regulated finance clients expect, and make it reusable for other AI features.

You will work with Notion, Azure DevOps, Figma, Claude and, of course, PowerPoint, Excel and Word with UpSlide.

Your goals ⚡

After 3 months: you know our users and their deliverables. You have mapped the most common and most costly errors in decks, models and reports, from at least 15 client interviews. You have a first eval set and a prototype tested with clients.

After 6 months: the first verification checks are live with design partner clients. You can show their accuracy (errors caught, false alarms) and you have a roadmap for the next two quarters.

After 9 months: verification is a paid capability. It moves a metric the company tracks, for example paid AI adoption in a segment from X to Y accounts, or win rate against a named competitor.

At UpSlide we have a career path to help you grow. From Senior PM, you can move to Lead PM (individual contributor, owning a strategic bet across several squads) or Group PM (managing 2 to 4 PMs).


You are a great fit if you have:

  • Built or rolled out an AI product used by real customers. You have designed prompts and evals, made cost and latency trade-offs, and you know how to spot when the model is wrong. This is a must.

  • 5+ years in product management in B2B software, with a product area you owned end to end.

  • Taken an ambiguous problem, framed it, and turned it into a plan a team could execute.

  • Moved a business metric (revenue, retention, win rate) and can explain how your roadmap did it.

  • A habit of building with AI every day: prototypes, specs, data queries, interview synthesis.

  • Comfort with data: you define tracking plans and change priorities based on what usage shows.

  • Clear written English. Your updates are short, factual and easy to act on.

Hybrid work: 3 days a week in the office.

Location: Paris

We'd love it if:

  • You have worked as an investment banker or in financial advisory (M&A, valuation, transaction services). You have built pitch decks and financial models and lived through late-night review cycles.

  • You have worked on quality, review or compliance products (document review, audit, data validation).

  • You have sold to or worked with regulated financial firms and know their security and compliance demands.

  • You speak French.

✨ If you don't tick all the boxes but you think you'd be a great fit, please apply and tell us why.

Recruitment process

  1. Intro call with Andréa (30 min): your background, your motivation, logistics.

  2. Interview with Matteo, CPO (45 min): the AI products you built or rolled out, what worked, what did not, and why.

  3. Case study with a PM, a product designer and an Engineering Manager (60 min).

  4. Cross-functional interview with Sales or Customer Success lead (45 min): how you work with GTM teams and with demanding clients.

  5. Final interview with Philippe, CEO (30 min): values and long-term fit.

🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive!

⚡ On average, our process lasts 3 weeks.

What we offer

As an FPGA Engineer Intern on Harmattan AI’s compute module team, you will take camera aggregation from concept to real hardware for the first time. Candidate Requirements

FPGA Engineer (Controls & Signal Processing)

About Enact

The next defining technological breakthrough will be in the physical world. We stand at a historical inflection point: bringing general-purpose intelligence into robotics.

At Enact we rethink the entire robotic tech stack from model architectures and data pipelines, to the actuators and sensors that feed the model. Pushing beyond pure vision and language approaches, we build a proprioceptive nerve system, and the cortex that makes sense of it, to solve dexterity through whole-body force-awareness and deploy robots for thousands of tasks in industry and beyond.

We are shaping a company where brilliant and unconventional people thrive together on solving the hardest challenges of our time. We are truth seekers. We reason from first principles, test our beliefs against reality, and trust that the best ideas can come from anyone. We move fast. We care deeply about our work and colleagues and are driven by passion to change the status quo.

If this resonates, we're excited to hear from you.

In This Role You Will

  • Design, implement, and verify the FPGA fabric at the heart of our custom hardware, from real-time control and signal processing to high-speed sensor and data interfaces.

  • Own the build flow: synthesis, place & route, static timing analysis, and timing closure on real silicon.

  • Develop testbenches, simulation, and co-simulation to verify behaviour at unit and system level.

  • Take designs from RTL through board bring-up, integration, and lab debug under real operating conditions all the way through to production-ready.

  • Keep the design understandable: specifications, timing budgets, and verification plans.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong digital design fundamentals: RTL in SystemVerilog (or VHDL), and a solid grasp of computer architecture.

  • The ability to reason about fixed- and floating-point data paths and pipelines - where precision goes, where it costs you, and how a computation maps onto real hardware.

  • Experience closing timing: static timing analysis, writing constraints, clock-domain crossing, and synchronization.

  • Fluency with at least one vendor toolchain (Xilinx/AMD, Intel/Altera, or Lattice), in a heavily scripted setting.

  • Comfortable reading schematics, reasoning from first principles, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with electronics and mechanical engineers.

  • The ability to take designs from benchtop prototype to production ready.

  • Fluency in English (German not required, though useful!).

Bonus Points If You Have

Having done these before is a plus, not a prerequisite. You'll do much of it in the role:

  • Rust or embedded firmware experience.

  • DSP in fabric: filtering (FIR/IIR), FFT, and fixed-point implementation.

  • Control theory: system identification, plant modeling, and loop tuning.

  • High-speed ADC/DAC interfaces and sensor/communication protocols.

  • Expert knowledge of version control, especially git.

  • Safety-critical or certified design.

  • Experience collaborating across analog, software, and mechanical domains.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to make a real impact working on some of the biggest challenges of our time

  • A fast-paced learning environment alongside an outstanding, driven team

  • Ownership from day one, with the ability to iterate quickly and see your impact firsthand in an early-stage startup

  • Visa sponsorship & relocation benefits to hire the best in the world

  • A world-class in-person setup in central Zürich, with excellent prototyping, robotics, and technical infrastructure for hands-on builders

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity participation

jobs.title: Director, Information Security
jobs.description:
Director, Information Security

About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity 🚀

Carrot is looking for a Director, Information Security to lead the security program that protects the highly sensitive fertility and family-building data of members around the world. You will set the security strategy, own both corporate security (GRC, incident response, security awareness, vendor risk) and product security (application, cloud and infrastructure security, secure development lifecycle), and serve as the trusted voice on Carrot's security posture with executives, auditors, and enterprise customers.

Day to day, you will balance setting direction with staying close to the work: prioritizing risk with Engineering and IT, guiding audit and certification cycles, coaching a small and talented team, and joining customer conversations where security is part of the buying decision. Carrot has already earned SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, HITRUST, and PCI DSS compliance, so this role is about taking a strong foundation to the next level of maturity, not starting from scratch.

What makes this role different is the combination of stakes and influence. Few security leaders get to protect data this personal, at global scale, while working directly with executive leadership and shaping how a health platform is built, sold, and trusted.

What You’ll Own 💼

In this role, you will:

  • Lead Carrot's security strategy and roadmap, using a recognized maturity model (such as C2M2 or NIST CSF) to prioritize investments and report progress to executive leadership
  • Own the full security program across corporate security (GRC, incident management, security awareness, third-party risk) and product security (application security, cloud and infrastructure security, secure SDLC)
  • Partner with Engineering, especially the Internal Platform team, to build security into how Carrot designs, ships, and operates its systems, going beyond compliance
  • Lead internal risk assessments across application, cloud, and corporate environments and turn the results into prioritized technical safeguards
  • Own the compliance portfolio, including SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, PCI DSS, and HIPAA, and prepare Carrot for additional frameworks such as ISO 27001 as the business requires
  • Direct incident response readiness, including playbooks, tabletop exercises, executive communication, and post-incident learning
  • Represent Carrot's security posture to employers, health plans, and health systems through security reviews, questionnaires, and strategic sales conversations
  • Work with Legal and Privacy to meet global data protection requirements (HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA/CPRA) for member health data
  • Build, coach, and grow the security team, balancing hands-on execution with delegation as the team scales
  • Manage the security budget, tooling, and vendor relationships, and tailor security guidance for a remote-first workforce and physical offices

What Success Looks Like 📈

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • A documented, executive-endorsed security strategy and multi-year roadmap with clear priorities, owners, and measures of progress
  • Clean outcomes on recurring audits and certifications (SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, PCI DSS), with remediation items closed on schedule
  • A tested incident response program, with regular tabletop exercises completed and lessons learned built back into the program
  • A measurable reduction in high-risk vulnerabilities and open security findings, with remediation timelines agreed on with Engineering
  • A living risk register and vendor security review process that leaders rely on to make decisions
  • A security team with defined roles, clear growth paths, and the right capacity for Carrot's growth, including key hires made
  • Faster, more consistent security reviews for Sales and Customer Success, with fewer escalations from enterprise customers
  • A clear plan, and visible progress, on any additional frameworks the business prioritizes, such as ISO 27001

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 10+ years of experience in technology, including 5+ years in information security and at least 3 years leading security teams
  • A security certification such as CISSP or CISM
  • Experience leading the security function at a late-stage startup, scale-up, or public company
  • Working depth in healthcare data protection and privacy frameworks, including HIPAA, GDPR, and CCPA/CPRA
  • Experience overseeing enterprise frameworks and audits such as SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, PCI DSS, and ISO 27001
  • Strong knowledge of application, network, and cloud security (AWS and Azure) and frameworks such as NIST CSF and OWASP
  • Experience running core security programs, including incident response, risk management, vulnerability management, penetration testing, and security awareness
  • Executive-level communication skills and confidence engaging customers and sales teams on security requirements
  • Experience managing budget and allocating resources across people, tools, and vendors

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience leading security through a major company event such as an IPO, acquisition, or large-scale audit cycle
  • A background in healthcare, digital health, or another highly regulated, high-trust environment
  • Experience leading security in a remote-first, globally distributed company
  • Familiarity with compliance automation platforms such as Drata
  • Experience building a security engineering practice alongside platform and infrastructure teams

Why This Role Matters 🧡

Members trust Carrot with some of the most personal information a person can share, often during some of the most meaningful moments of their lives. Protecting that trust is not a back-office function. It is what allows employers, health plans, and health systems to bring Carrot to millions of people worldwide.

As Carrot grows, security leadership shapes how we build, how we sell, and how we show up for customers. In this role, you will make security a strength that members and customers can see and rely on, and build a team that keeps raising the bar as the business scales.

Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation:

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their lives inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $188,000.00 - $245,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer (Backend Leaning) - Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Full-Stack Engineer (Backend Leaning) - Platform Engineering

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

Core Platform builds the foundations every other team at ElevenLabs builds on: how users, workspaces and permissions work across our products. Our systems sit on the path of every request and are relied on by millions of users and by enterprise customers, so correctness, security and safe rollout matter as much as speed.

We are hiring full stack engineers (backend leaning) for two focus areas. Depending on the team you join, your responsibilities might include:

Workspaces & User Management (serving external customers)

  • Building and improving the building blocks customers touch directly: API keys, login experience, analytics, admin tooling, workspace security and more

  • Working closely with Sales, FDEs and customer teams to turn enterprise and self-serve feedback into the right improvements, and helping large customers with complex organisational structures.

  • Shipping customer-facing features end to end, from backend services to the admin and settings UI.

Permissions & Resources (serving ElevenLabs engineering teams)

  • Designing and building generic resource and permissioning services that product teams use to build features safely and quickly.

  • Solving hard, largely greenfield problems at scale, for example how a customer with a million agents assigns and manages access.

  • Working across product teams to understand their needs, and driving adoption with changes that don't require every team to rework their code.

In both teams you will:

  • Scope work as part of a large existing system: understand what exists, what could go wrong on rollout, whether a migration is needed, and how downstream teams are affected.

  • Roll out changes safely and with minimal disruption to existing users, teams or systems.

  • Debug and operate what you build, working from customer reports, logs and code.

  • Own features from scoping to completion, with the support of experienced engineers who are happy to mentor.

Requirements

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking engineers who can show they have solved impressively hard problems, through past projects or GitHub contributions. We do require:

  • Expertise in Python.

  • A strong background in backend development, with comfort working across the stack where the work needs it.

  • Experience with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure, including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions and data structures.

  • Strong test design and security fundamentals.

  • Care and attention to detail when changing live, business-critical systems, and the ability to learn a large existing codebase quickly.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: working out what should be built, and prioritising among competing signals.

Bonus:

  • Experience with authentication, authorization or permissioning (OAuth, SSO/SCIM, RBAC or similar).

  • Experience with Kubernetes.

  • Experience building internal platforms or services used by other engineering teams.

Location

Our team is based across the UK, EU and US, and this is our main focus. We are flexible for exceptional candidates elsewhere. You can work remotely, or from our offices in Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Senior Talent Partner (12 month FTC)

Senior Talent Partner

📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid 4 days WFH) | 💰 £50,000 - £60,000

Street Group is scaling fast toward an ambitious growth plan, and hiring is about to get harder: more senior roles, a higher bar, and a market where the best people don't apply; they get found and won. We need someone who owns how we hire, not just who we hire.

We're looking for a TA Specialist with a truly commercial mindset: skilled at your craft, able to own searches end-to-end across every part of the organisation with full autonomy, and a trusted partner to the hiring managers you work with.

Why this role exists now

Our recruiting team is strong but stacked. We've recently raised investment and have ambitious goals to achieve, which means hiring across every part of the business at the same time. We need an experienced recruiter who can pick up roles anywhere in the organisation, switch between them easily, and partner with hiring managers without needing a steer, so the whole team can keep hiring quality people at pace.

We're hiring this role initially on a 12 month FTC, but if our growth continues the way it's going (and we expect it will!), there's every chance it becomes a permanent position.

The role

You'll own searches end-to-end across the entire organisation, often running very different roles side by side. That means switching context quickly: getting up to speed on each team's goals, how its roles tie in to commercial goals and what good looks like for them. You'll work through ambiguity largely on your own, pulling in your manager only for the genuinely strategic or sensitive calls.

Strong stakeholder partnering is at the heart of the role. You'll build trusted relationships with hiring managers across the business, handle competing demands between teams, and bring market and funnel insight into role and salary conversations, so hiring managers trust your evidence when you influence role definition, expectations and candidate decisions. Along the way, you'll keep improving how your own searches run: smoother pipelines with less drop-off of good candidates, better scorecards and smarter sourcing.

Day to day, that looks like:

  • Running a varied set of searches across the whole business end-to-end, from intake to offer.

Why you might not want to apply

About the Role

As a Strategic Sourcing Lead, you’ll lead a new global sourcing hub focused on finding the right contributors for complex AI projects that require specialized or hard-to-reach talent across a wide range of domains, from translation and localization to legal, medical, scientific, and technical fields.

This is a strategic, hands-on role within Fulfillment. You’ll define how the hub operates, develop the team, and partner with Recruitment and Delivery to build sourcing strategies ranging from complex searches to high-volume scaling. The team will work in a data-informed and AI-enabled environment, using technology to enhance research, outreach, analysis, and sourcing efficiency.

Your Impact

  • Design and execute creative sourcing strategies for specialized, hard-to-reach, and high-volume needs.
  • Partner with Recruitment and Delivery to assess requirements, sourcing feasibility, and project needs.
  • Build relationships with production stakeholders and communicate risks, timelines, and expectations.
  • Use sourcing and conversion data to identify bottlenecks, test approaches, and improve funnel performance.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience sourcing for AI, data, or crowdsourcing projects.
  • Experience sourcing linguists, translators, or other language profiles across markets.
  • Experience working with global or distributed teams across time zones.

Compensation

Additional Information

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest quality AI solutions for frontier models.

jobs.title: Director of Security Operations and Engineering
jobs.description:
Director of Security Operations and Engineering

A Little About Us

EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. EDB empowers enterprises to control risk, manage costs and scale efficiently for a data and AI led world. Serving more than 1,500 customers globally and as the leading contributor to the vibrant and fast-growing PostgreSQL community, EDB supports major government organizations, financial services, media and information technology companies. EDB’s data-driven solutions enable customers to modernize legacy systems and break data silos while leveraging enterprise-grade open source technologies. EDB delivers the confidence of up to 99.999% high availability with mission critical capabilities built in such as security, compliance controls, and observability. For more information, visit www.enterprisedb.com

The Role:

You'll lead Security Operations and Security Engineering at EDB, reporting to the CISO as a trusted member of the security leadership team. You own how we detect, respond, and (increasingly) prevent. That means the people, the platforms, and the playbooks behind threat detection, incident response, and the engineering that makes them scale.

You'll be a peer to the leaders across security, including Governance, Risk & Compliance and Application Security & Vulnerability Management, and you'll help shape the direction of the broader InfoSec organization. You'll also partner closely with peer leaders in IT and Product, because most of the controls we define live in their systems, pipelines, and roadmaps. This is a scaling role. The business is growing fast, and so is everything security has to cover: more products, more cloud, more acquired companies and environments to bring up to a common standard. You'll decide what to build, what to automate, and where to add people, so the program grows ahead of the risk instead of behind it. As EDB grows, so will the scope and opportunity of the role.

One leader owns both Security Operations and Security Engineering on purpose: the best incident is the one that never happens. What we learn from detection and response feeds directly into the engineering of preventive controls, so we move from detecting bad things to making them impossible, and from manual triage to automation and agents that give analysts leverage. If you want to build that, and grow a program and a team as the company grows, this is the seat.

What your impact will be:

  • Incident response end to end, from intake and severity model through after-action and improvement, including partnership with Legal on investigations
  • Detection engineering, threat hunting, and the SIEM, EDR, SOAR, and cloud security platforms that support them
  • Security Engineering strategy and delivery, with the goal of preventing incidents rather than responding to them: preventive controls, least privilege, and identity assurance across employees, contractors, and build systems
  • The insider threat program, built with HR, Legal, and IT
  • Automation and agentic AI that extends analyst capacity (the analyst always owns the decision)
  • Security integration of acquired companies and new environments into EDB's standards
  • Close partnership with IT and Product leadership to build preventive controls into the platforms, pipelines, and products they own, plus security input to third-party risk and device posture with GRC
  • Scaling the program: the org design, operating rhythms, roadmap, budget, and vendor strategy that let coverage grow with the business without growing linearly with headcount

What you will bring:

  • 5+ years of management experience leading security teams
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in security operations, incident response, detection, or security engineering
  • A track record of scaling a security function through rapid growth (hiring, automation, and operating discipline), not just running one
  • Strategic thinking that goes beyond the immediate scope of the role
  • The ability to translate technical risk into business impact for executives, legal, customers, and your IT and Product counterparts
  • Comfort in a global, remote-first environment with flexible schedules and on-call responsibilities

What will give you an edge:

  • Hands-on scripting or automation experience (Python, Go, etc.)
  • Experience applying AI or agent-based automation to security workflows
  • Cloud security experience and background in M&A security integration
  • Experience building an insider threat or identity assurance program

EDB is committed to supporting our employees' overall well being by offering a range of benefits and resources to promote a healthy work-life balance and wellness. We provide access to CuraLinc to aid employees in health and wellness tips and practices, as well as Wellness Fridays extending to December 2026! Check out our career site for more information on perks and benefits and reach out to our Talent Acquisition team for region specific benefits.

We know it takes a unique mix of people and skills to help us in our mission to supercharge Postgres, and we understand that not everyone will check every box. We’d love to hear from you and we want you to apply!

EDB is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. EDB was built on a commitment to trust and respect each other and to embrace an array of people and ideas. These values remain at the center of our culture and are key to our company’s integrity.

Associate Venture Development – Commercial Product Energy (w/m/d)

Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

Omniwatt Energy ist die Strom-Unit von Enpal und macht saubere Energie für jeden Haushalt zugänglich – vom günstigsten Stromtarif Deutschlands bis hin zu intelligenten Energielösungen, die Erzeugung, Speicherung und Verbrauch optimal vernetzen.

Mit ambitionierten Wachstumszielen und einem schnell wachsenden Kundenstamm bauen wir ein Team, das den deutschen Energiemarkt aktiv mitgestaltet. Dabei verbinden wir Startup-Geschwindigkeit mit der Skalierung eines Marktführers – über alle Bereiche hinweg, von Operations und Technologie über Finance und Customer Support bis hin zu Produktentwicklung.

Deine Aufgaben

Du willst Produkte nicht nur konzipieren, sondern sie selbst live bringen?

Im Commercial Product Team von Omniwatt entwickeln wir unsere Energieprodukte, von klassischen und dynamischen Stromtarifen bis zu unserem Virtual Power Plant. In dieser Rolle verantwortest du eigene Produkte und bringst sie von der ersten Idee bis zum erfolgreichen Launch. Dabei arbeitest du in einem kleinen, motivierten Team mit kurzen Wegen und viel Gestaltungsspielraum.

  • Du bringst neue Produkte schnell und sauber live, trackst ihre Performance und machst sie datenbasiert immer besser.

  • Du ownst die Umsetzung unserer Product Roadmap, bringst Tech, Operations, Growth und Finance an einen Tisch und triffst Entscheidungen selbst, bei größeren Weichenstellungen gemeinsam mit Senior Stakeholdern.

  • Du findest eigenständig Wege, unsere Prozesse mit Agentic AI, Automatisierung und datengetriebenen Analysen smarter und skalierbarer zu machen.

 

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst 2–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung mit, z. B. aus Strategy, Consulting, Produktmanagement, der Energiewirtschaft oder einem Startup.

  • Du hast an einer führenden Universität oder Business School studiert, mit Business- oder MINT-Hintergrund.

  • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Commercial Mindset und ein gutes Gespür für Kundenbedürfnisse und Markttrends.

  • Du denkst strukturiert, bereitest komplexe Themen klar auf und kommst schnell von der Idee in die Umsetzung.

  • Du begeisterst dich für die Energiewende und neue Geschäftsmodelle im Strom- und Flexibilitätsmarkt. Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft oder Gründungserfahrung sind ein Plus.

  • KI-Tools sind für dich selbstverständlich. Du nutzt sie täglich für Analysen, Konzepte und Präsentationen und arbeitest gern mit Daten-Tools wie Snowflake oder Airtable.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch, idealerweise auch auf Englisch.

 

Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️

  • Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.

  • Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.

Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen.

  • Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt.

  • Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

The Payments team owns how ElevenLabs charges customers: billing, usage tracking, pricing and payments across self-serve and enterprise. Everything we do has to be correct, because it underpins the company's revenue and is immediately visible to every customer and team.

We are hiring full stack engineers (backend leaning) to expand and evolve our payments systems. Your responsibilities might include:

  • Building and maintaining usage tracking so that requests are metered accurately without impacting latency.

  • Leading our migration of enterprise pricing and usage processing, including new stream-processing services for usage events.

  • Making it easy for customers to upgrade and pay, including paying through different entities and supporting new payment providers.

  • Working with Finance and Tax teams to meet compliance, audit and reporting requirements.

  • Enabling pricing and Growth experiments with Growth and product teams.

  • Debugging complex customer billing scenarios: piecing together what happened from the customer's experience, logs and code, and fixing the cause.

  • Collaborating with Sales, FDEs, Finance and engineers across the company.

Much of this work extends or replaces systems that already exist, so you will scope carefully, plan migrations, and roll changes out without disrupting customers.

Requirements

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking engineers who can show they have solved impressively hard problems, through past projects or GitHub contributions. We do require:

  • Expertise in Python.

  • A strong background in backend development.

  • Experience with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure, including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions and data structures.

  • Strong test design and security fundamentals.

  • Care and attention to detail when changing live systems that handle money.

  • The ability to learn a large existing system quickly and to debug complex production issues.

Bonus:

  • Experience with payment processing providers, or with billing and usage-based pricing systems

  • Experience with stream processing or high-throughput event pipelines.

  • Experience working with finance, tax or audit requirements.

  • Experience with Kubernetes.

Location

Our team is based across the UK, EU and US, and this is our main focus. We are flexible for exceptional candidates elsewhere. You can work remotely, or from our offices in Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco and Warsaw.


#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Stage - Service client : Onboarding

Notre département “Care” (ou service client) est composé de 3 équipes :

  1. La team Customer Care Representative, qui répond à toutes les questions ponctuelles sur des sujets variés comme le droit, la comptabilité, les travaux, l’utilisation de la plateforme, etc.

  2. La team Customer Success, qui accompagne sur le long terme les copropriétés sur le modèle coopératif et les aide dans leurs problématiques complexes,

  3. La team Customer Onboarding (10 personnes) : qui organise la phase de transition, paramètre l’espace client, gère la reprise comptable, et guide le client dans sa nouvelle fonction de syndic. C’est cette équipe que tu rejoins.

Ce département est central chez Matera, et nécessite de bien communiquer et de se synchroniser avec les équipes Commerciale, et les équipes d’experts Juristes, Travaux, Comptables etc., afin de garantir une satisfaction client optimale !

En tant que "Customer Onboarding", ton rôle est d’accompagner les clients dans leur projet de changement de syndic, dans leur prise en main de l’outil Matera, et d'améliorer leur expérience et leur satisfaction dès leurs premiers mois avec nous. Tu reprends en main la relation client dès leur signature de contrat avec l’équipe Commerciale.

Concrètement, tes missions sont les suivantes :

  1. Accompagner la configuration & la relation client :
    ◦ Aider les nouveaux clients à configurer leur espace sur la plateforme et les guider dans la prise en main de l'outil.
    ◦ Assister l'équipe dans le suivi des dossiers administratifs (relances, prise de rendez-vous).
    ◦ Présenter les services complémentaires Matera (compte de paiement) lors des échanges d'onboarding.

jobs.title: Freelance, Recovery Operations
jobs.description:
Freelance, Recovery Operations

Who We Are

Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France: an AI agent runs the entire sale and purchase journey end-to-end, orchestrating local brokers, portals, buyers, and documents.

Backed by €60 million from top-tier investors Sequoia Capital and Kima Ventures, we're committed to accelerating life changes for millions of current and future European homeowners.

Mission freelance de 7 mois, du 1er février au 25 août 2027, à Paris 9e.

🎯 La mission

Quand un vendeur ou un agent partenaire vend un bien hors du cadre contractuel de son mandat Zefir, la squad Protect le détecte, le prouve, puis transforme ce manquement en cash encaissé, avec l'équipe Sales Zefir et nos avocats partenaires. Tu leads cette squad.

La squad est jeune et en pleine construction : elle est passée de 0 € à plus de 100 000 € de chiffre d'affaires en 3 mois, et l'objectif est d'atteindre 500 000 € par mois d'ici la fin du S1 2027. Les premiers outils et process tournent déjà, mais l'essentiel reste à bâtir, et c'est toi qui t'en charges.

🛠️ Ce que tu feras

Ton rôle s'articule autour de quatre axes :

1. Lead la squad Protect

  • Pilotage : suivre la performance de toute la chaîne, de la détection des fraudes au cash encaissé, côté Sales comme côté avocats. Repérer ce qui décroche et porter les plans d'action.

  • Weekly : préparer et animer le weekly d'équipe : chiffres de la semaine, points bloquants, décisions à prendre.

  • OKR : définir chaque trimestre les objectifs et les résultats clés de la squad.

2. Générer du pipe de recouvrement

  • Run : chaque jour, revoir les ventes détectées par nos outils et décider s'il faut demander les documents officiels, comme l'acte de vente. Puis revoir les actes reçus et, à partir de l'analyse produite par nos outils, décider d'enclencher ou non le recouvrement par nos équipes.

  • Build : automatiser chaque étape qui peut l'être, pour que le funnel opère en totale autonomie (ex : automatiser le traitement des réponses du service de publicité foncière reçues par email).

  • Pilotage : t'assurer que le funnel tourne et qu'aucun dossier ne reste bloqué à une étape. Quand ça bloque, tu investigues, tu trouves la cause et tu la corriges.

3. Convertir le pipe avec l'équipe Sales Zefir

  • Build : donner à l'équipe Sales des dossiers prêts à travailler : analyse juridique, brief d'appel, mises en demeure, suivi des échéanciers. Automatiser des tâches qu'ils font aujourd'hui manuellement pour augmenter leur productivité (ex : automatiser la rédaction et l'envoi des mises en demeure).

  • Pilotage : suivre chaque semaine avec l'équipe la conversion des dossiers en protocoles signés et le cash encaissé. Repérer les indicateurs qui décrochent et proposer un plan d'action.

4. Convertir le pipe avec nos avocats

  • Run : être l'interlocuteur de nos deux cabinets. Chaque semaine, tu tiens un point avec chacun pour revoir le pipe dossier par dossier. Entre deux points, tu fournis les pièces demandées et tu rends les arbitrages de Zefir : plancher de négociation, assignation, classement, etc. Tu comprends aussi leurs enjeux, leurs irritants et ce qui les bloque, pour améliorer nos process avec eux.

  • Build : faire évoluer l'outil de suivi partagé avec les cabinets (ex : relances automatiques, to-do priorisée, etc.).

  • Pilotage : suivre les délais, la conversion et les coûts de chaque cabinet, et les challenger chaque semaine. Comme pour la partie Sales, tu repères les indicateurs qui décrochent et tu proposes un plan d'action.

Partout, tu construis vite, en MVP, avec Claude Code, Lovable, Pipedream et BigQuery.

🙋 Profil recherché

On cherche un profil Ops builder : quelqu'un qui aime partir d'une page blanche, mettre les mains dans le cambouis, puis construire les process et les automatiser.

  • Une expérience dans un rôle Ops où tu as construit toi-même un process ou un outil de zéro, idéalement en start-up.

  • Le goût du terrain : tu traites toi-même les premiers dossiers pour comprendre le problème avant de l'automatiser.

  • Une vraie autonomie dans l'ambiguïté : peu de cadre, des priorités qui bougent, et c'est toi qui poses la structure.

  • Une rigueur à toute épreuve et une organisation solide, pour mener plusieurs chantiers de front sans en lâcher aucun.

  • Le goût de la performance : on se fixe des objectifs ambitieux, et tu fais tout pour les atteindre.

💰 Modalités

  • Démarrage : 1er février 2027.

  • Durée : 7 mois, du 1er février au 25 août 2027.

  • Lieu : Paris 9e, bureaux du Peletier.

  • Rémunération : TJM à 450 € HT.

  • Processus : un échange avec Constance, qui occupe le poste aujourd'hui, puis avec Arthus de Torquat, Lead Operations.


Benefits

The following is for permanent employees only. For other contracts (interns, apprentices, fixed-term..), please, check with your recruiter.

  • Competitive salary: You can run your own simulation with our salary calculator.

  • BSPCE (Stock Options): Available for everyone, with monthly vesting after year one, over a 4-year period.

  • Healthcare plan: Full coverage with Alan for team members, their partners, and children.

  • Office in Le Peletier, Paris (9th arrondissement): With flexible remote work options.

  • Swile meal card: €11 per worked day.

  • Swile mobility card: €45/month to support sustainable transportation (metro, carpooling, biking…).

  • Team events: Monthly Mixers to connect and share good times, and quarterly All Hands to celebrate wins across the company.

Our Operating Principles

🏔️ Steep Mountains Are Steep: Setting ambitious goals and working hard to achieve them.

🌊 Ride Reality: Actively seeking challenges and thriving by adapting flexibly to changes.

🏀 Play for the Front of the Jersey: Prioritizing team success over individual recognition.

jobs.description:
EMEA Regional Events Field Marketing Lead

About Us

Point One Navigation is building the future of precise location. Our mission is to deliver a unified location platform that enables autonomy, safety, and efficiency across industries from robotics to transportation. We are a high-performance, high-collaboration team that thrives on solving complex problems, moving fast, and delivering impact.

Role Outcome

We are seeking a European Events Field Marketing Lead to own the strategy, planning, and execution of events and programs that builds Point One's presence, pipeline, and aligns with our brand across the region. This is a hands-on, execution-first role combining regional market insight, program management discipline, and hustle.

You will work directly with Marketing, Sales, Product, and Customer Success to identify the highest-leverage events, conferences, and customer gatherings across Europe, then run each one end to end — from strategy and budget through booth design, booth experience, speaker placement, and post-event pipeline handoff. You will serve as the region's on-the-ground marketing owner, translating market knowledge into a calendar of events that generates qualified pipeline and reinforces Point One as the category leader in precise location.

The ultimate outcome of this role is a European field program that reliably converts marketing spend into qualified pipeline and secondarily supports brand visibility, and customer engagement — planned and executed with minimal oversight.

Success in this role is measured by volume and quality of pipeline generated from events (virtual and in person). Events, sponsorships, and field activity with prospects, customers or partners are the means to achieve these results, not the end in themselves.

Immediate Areas of Focus

Event Strategy & Calendar Ownership

  • Own the European event calendar — identify, prioritize, and select the conferences, trade shows, and customer events that best support pipeline and brand goals.

  • Build the business case for each event: audience fit, expected pipeline, cost, and ROI — and defend that case against a limited budget.

  • Continuously evaluate the regional event landscape and reallocate investment toward what's working.

End-to-End Logistics & Operational Execution

  • Run every logistical element of an event — booth and sponsorship design, shipping, staffing, collateral, signage, and on-site coordination — while in alignment with centralized dedicated events, brand, and product teams.

  • Coordinate speaking opportunities, demos, and customer meetings on-site to maximize the value of each event.

  • Manage vendors, venues, and local partners across multiple European countries and languages.

Pipeline & Follow-Through & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Bring strong operational rigor by partnering with marketing, business development and sales to ensure every event has clear pre-event outreach, on-site lead capture, and post-event follow-up.

  • Track and report pipeline generated, cost per lead, and event ROI back to the business. Align activity with central processes and reporting, working with Marketing Ops team.

  • Close the loop with Sales and Customer Success to make sure event-sourced leads convert.

Regional Brand & Field Presence

  • Align Point One's brand and reputation across Europe through field presence, local press, partner co-marketing, and customer-facing moments.

  • Identify opportunities to bring partners, customers and prospects together outside of large industry events — dinners, roundtables, and regional meetups.

  • Act as the local voice of the brand, adapting global messaging for European markets and customers.

  • Act as the bridge between European Sales and the global Marketing and Product teams.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in field marketing, event marketing, or demand generation roles, with direct ownership of event strategy and execution in a high growth start up environment

  • Track record of running high-impact events and conferences from planning through pipeline delivery, with a scrappy DIY culture.

  • Comfortable owning budget, ROI reporting, and vendor negotiation independently.

  • Experience marketing to technical or engineering audiences.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to run multiple concurrent events across countries and time zones.

  • Ability to travel up to 50% across Europe.

Preferred

  • Experience marketing into robotics, autonomous systems, automotive, drones, industrial automation, or federal technologies.

  • Fluency in a second European language in addition to English.

  • Experience building a European field marketing

  • Experience working closely with sales in a B2B, enterprise, or deep-tech sales motion. GNSS experience appreciated but not required.

Our Cultural Foundation

At Point One, our cultural and operating design is built around one guiding principle: we must move with extreme speed and efficiency of effort to stay in a leadership position.

This environment gives people a high level of autonomy and the ability to make a real impact. It also challenges every team member to grow — both professionally and personally. Because we focus on promoting from within rather than relying on external hiring, the opportunities for advancement are tremendous for those who seek them.

That said, growth only comes from delivering in the present. What matters most is the job to be done today, not the job you want tomorrow. When we all focus on today’s outcomes with excellence, the path to greater responsibility and growth naturally follows.

We think about our culture in two dimensions:

How We Show Up Every Day

These are the behaviors we expect every team member to bring to work — the foundation of being a consummate, high-output teammate:

  • Trust / Assume Best Intent — Trust allows us to move fast. When we start from trust, we spend no time second-guessing or looking for ulterior motives and thus focus all our energy on acting.

  • High Output, Action Oriented — Our default posture is “yes.” We bias toward action and deliver results quickly, knowing that speed and efficiency compound into impact as we unblock others around us.

  • Divine Discontent — We’re never satisfied with the status quo and are self-motivated to improve ourselves, our work, and our company. We actively seek feedback in real-time to shorten improvement cycles.

  • No Ego, One Team — Collaboration without ego creates leverage. When we win as one team, we eliminate friction and move faster together.

  • Self Accountability — Taking ownership is the straightest line to learning, self-improvement, and correcting our course of action. And blaming others around us is a fast path to destroying trust.

Operating Principles

These are the systems and norms that amplify speed and efficiency at the company level:

  • Edge Innovation — We bias toward action over approval. Experiment, decide, and move — failure is just a step toward faster learning.

  • No Hierarchies — We practice self-prioritization and go direct to the source. Flattening layers reduces drag and maximizes autonomy.

  • Customer Experience First — We optimize for the end-to-end customer outcome, not functional or departmental efficiency. This focus cuts waste, aligns priorities, and ensures we spend effort where it matters most.

If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply below and join us in shaping the future of precise location.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
Product Owner

Bouw mee aan eerlijke, betrokken en goed presterende teams

Wij geloven dat iedereen een eerlijke kans verdient om te groeien en beloond te worden voor wat hij of zij bijdraagt. Daarom bouwt Learned software die organisaties helpt met heldere rollen, eerlijke en objectieve beoordelingen, gerichte ontwikkeling en transparante beloning. Dat gebeurt in één doorlopend proces.

Honderden bedrijven, van scale-ups tot corporates, werken al met Learned en dat worden er nog veel meer. Daarom zoeken we versterking in team Product.

Jouw impact als Product Owner

Als Product Owner speel je een sleutelrol in de verdere ontwikkeling van ons platform. Jij zorgt dat onze ambitieuze roadmap niet op papier blijft, maar écht landt. Je vertaalt strategie, klantbehoeften en ideeën naar productverbeteringen die het verschil maken voor onze klanten.

Wat je doet

  • Samen met de Product Lead bepaal je en bewaak je de roadmap. Je kiest ook wat níét gebeurt.

  • Je houdt vier development squads op koers: planning, kwaliteit en voortgang.

  • Je ontwerpt zelf prototypes op basis van prompts en ons design system, en stemt de details zorgvuldig af met UX.

  • Businessbehoeften vertaal je naar scherpe requirements en heldere prioriteiten.

  • Stakeholders houd je aangehaakt bij releases en voortgang.

  • Risico’s en afhankelijkheden zie je aankomen voordat ze een probleem worden.

Jij verbindt strategie, development, design en business, en zorgt dat iedereen dezelfde kant op beweegt: richting de groei van onze klanten.

Wie ben jij?

Je weet hoe je complexe productontwikkeling in een softwareomgeving tot een goed einde brengt. Je houdt overzicht als er veel tegelijk gebeurt, je let op details zonder het grote plaatje te verliezen, en je krijgt mensen

jobs.title: Afstudeerstage AI Adoption
jobs.description:
Afstudeerstage AI Adoption

Wil jij helpen om AI van technologie naar dagelijks werk te brengen?

Bij HG geloven we dat technologie mensen sterker maakt. Daarom hebben we de afgelopen periode een stevig fundament gelegd voor AI binnen onze organisatie. Microsoft Copilot is geïntroduceerd, er zijn verschillende AI-initiatieven gestart en steeds meer collega’s ontdekken wat AI voor hun werk kan betekenen.

De volgende stap is opschalen. Want AI beschikbaar maken is één ding. Zorgen dat mensen het daadwerkelijk goed gebruiken, er nieuwe vaardigheden mee ontwikkelen en hun manier van werken aanpassen, is waar de echte transformatie plaatsvindt.

Als afstudeerstagiair AI Adoption help je ons om die volgende stap te zetten.

Je komt terecht in een internationale organisatie waar samenwerking, initiatief en nieuwsgierigheid centraal staan. Je begint dus niet vanaf nul. Je bouwt verder op wat er al staat en helpt ons te ontdekken welke aanpak nodig is om AI-adoptie verder te versnellen.

Je combineert onderzoek met praktijk. Je analyseert hoe AI wordt gebruikt, vertaalt data naar concrete acties, ontwikkelt en geeft trainingen voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus en helpt collega’s om AI steeds beter toe te passen in hun dagelijkse werk.

De exacte onderzoeksopdracht bepalen we samen, zodat deze aansluit bij jouw opleiding, interesses en afstudeereisen.

HG is een compacte, snelgroeiende en internationale organisatie waar je direct de impact van je werk ziet. Dit vraagt om eigenaarschap, initiatief en een pragmatische, resultaatgerichte houding. De cultuur is open en stimuleert het delen van ideeën, constructieve samenwerking en verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Alles wat we doen is gebaseerd op onze kernwaarden: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected.

Wat ga je doen?

Binnen HG zijn de eerste stappen in AI-adoptie al gezet. Er is dus een fundament om op voort te bouwen. Tijdens jouw stage help je ons om naar brede, structurele adoptie te gaan.

Concreet ga je onder andere:

  • Praktische en inspirerende Copilot-demo’s geven aan verschillende groepen medewerkers.

  • Bestaande adoptiedata analyseren en vertalen naar inzichten en concrete acties om gebruik en impact te vergroten.

  • Onderzoeken waar adoptie achterblijft en welke interventies kunnen helpen om medewerkers verder te brengen.

  • AI-trainingsprogramma’s ontwerpen en uitvoeren voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus, van collega’s die net beginnen tot ervaren gebruikers.

  • Trainingen, workshops, oefeningen en praktische hulpmiddelen ontwikkelen waarmee medewerkers AI direct in hun eigen werk kunnen toepassen.

  • De Copilot Academy op ons intranet verder ontwikkelen en actueel en relevant houden.

  • Medewerkers meenemen in de bredere AI-transformatie en concreet maken wat AI voor hun eigen werkzaamheden betekent.

  • Het AI Champions-programma ondersteunen en verder helpen ontwikkelen.

  • Feedback en behoeften van medewerkers ophalen en vertalen naar verbeteringen in trainingen, communicatie en andere adoptie-initiatieven.

  • Onderzoeken welke activiteiten daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan meer gebruik, betere AI-vaardigheden en waarde voor de organisatie.

Jouw onderzoek en werkzaamheden helpen HG om AI niet alleen beschikbaar te maken, maar daadwerkelijk onderdeel te maken van de dagelijkse manier van werken.

Je werkt rechtstreeks samen met onze AI Transformation Lead en hebt veel contact met collega’s uit verschillende afdelingen binnen de organisatie. Hierdoor krijg je een goed beeld van zowel de menselijke als bedrijfskundige kant van AI-transformatie.

Omdat HG actief is in meer dan 45 landen, werk je bovendien in een internationale omgeving waarin verschillende functies, perspectieven en niveaus van AI-volwassenheid samenkomen.

“We beginnen bij HG niet meer vanaf nul met AI. Er ligt een fundament en steeds meer collega’s werken ermee. De interessante vraag is nu: hoe zorgen we dat AI voor veel meer mensen écht onderdeel wordt van hun dagelijkse werk? Ik zoek iemand die het leuk vindt om daar samen met mij de volgende stap in te zetten.”
– Els Marchal, AI Transformation Lead


Wie ben je?

  • Je volgt een relevante hbo-opleiding, zoals Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, ICT, Business Informatics, Data & Business, Human Resource Management, Learning & Development, Communicatie of vergelijkbaar.

  • Je hebt interesse in AI én de manier waarop mensen nieuwe technologie adopteren.

  • Je vindt het leuk om voor groepen te staan en anderen iets nieuws te leren.

  • Je kunt complexe onderwerpen op een eenvoudige en praktische manier uitleggen.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig en gestructureerd.

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig en stelt kritische vragen.

  • Je vindt het interessant om data te analyseren en inzichten te vertalen naar concrete acties.

  • Je kunt goed schakelen tussen verschillende doelgroepen en niveaus van AI-ervaring.

  • Je vindt het leuk om trainingen, materialen en nieuwe manieren van leren te ontwikkelen.

  • Je durft initiatief te nemen en ideeën in de praktijk uit te proberen.

Ervaring met tools zoals Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT en Power BI is een pre. Belangrijker is dat je nieuwsgierig bent naar AI en enthousiast wordt van de vraag: hoe zorgen we ervoor dat mensen AI daadwerkelijk goed gaan gebruiken?

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een afstudeeropdracht met directe impact op de organisatie.

  • Intensieve begeleiding door de AI Transformation Lead.

  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ondernemerschap.

  • De kans om ervaring op te doen met AI-adoptie en organisatieverandering.

  • Praktijkervaring met het ontwikkelen en geven van AI-trainingen, demo’s en workshops.

  • De mogelijkheid om met echte adoptiedata te werken en te onderzoeken welke interventies daadwerkelijk effect hebben.

  • Een actieve rol binnen het AI Champions-programma.

  • Werken aan actuele AI-vraagstukken binnen een internationale organisatie.

  • Een hybride werkomgeving vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Almere.

  • Een informele en betrokken werksfeer waarin samenwerking centraal staat.

  • Stagevergoeding van €450,- bruto per maand (obv 32 uur).

Aan het einde van je stage heb je niet alleen een sterke afstudeerscriptie, maar ook praktische ervaring opgedaan met AI-adoptie, training en organisatieverandering binnen een internationale organisatie. Je hebt zelf trainingen en demo’s gegeven, met echte adoptiedata gewerkt en gezien wat ervoor nodig is om medewerkers daadwerkelijk mee te krijgen in een AI-transformatie.

Wij zijn HG!

Bij HG, een toonaangevend Europees merk in specialistische reinigings- en onderhoudsproducten, geloven we dat een huis een plek moet zijn waar je zorgeloos kunt leven. Met aandacht voor de plek waar je woont en voor de spullen die je omringen. Daarom ontwikkelen wij onze producten zo dat ze veilig doen wat ze beloven.

De missie van HG is om jou te helpen optimaal van je huis te genieten, zonder je zorgen te maken over wat er mis kan gaan. Dit realiseren wij met onze zeer effectieve, veilige en specialistische reinigingsoplossingen, gecombineerd met deskundig advies.

Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Almere zetten wij ons dagelijks in voor superioriteit, innovatie, kwaliteit en klanttevredenheid. Met een sterke aanwezigheid in Europa en daarbuiten blijven wij continu investeren om een nog grotere impact te maken.

HG doet wat het belooft.

Nog vragen?

jobs.title: Advocaat-stagiaire Banking & Finance
jobs.description:
Advocaat-stagiaire Banking & Finance

Het team en de functie

Binnen ons Banking & Finance team werken we op dit moment met zeven advocaten. We begeleiden transacties, adviseren over financieel toezichtrecht en staan cliënten bij in procedures over onder andere zorgplicht en verhaal. Dat doen we voor banken, verzekeraars, fondsen, leasemaatschappijen, factoraars en grotere bedrijven. Samen met ons Herstructuring & Insolventie-team staan we ook bedrijven met een herstructureringsvraagstuk en hun stakeholders zijn.

Ons team wordt erkend als toonaangevende praktijk in de internationale ranglijsten Legal500 en Chambers and Partners. In het afgelopen jaar heeft ons team voor meer dan EUR 8 miljard aan financieringen naar closing begeleid.

Ter ondersteuning en uitbreiding van onze praktijk zijn we op zoek naar een juridisch medewerker en/of beginnend advocaat-stagiair. Als juridisch medewerker begin je in eerste instantie op fulltime basis, met de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar de functie van advocaat-stagiaire. De functie is opgezet voor een periode van twee tot vier maanden, afhankelijk van het mogelijke startmoment van de beroepsopleiding. Als advocaat-stagiaire streven we ernaar om je op te leiden tot een succesvolle advocaat. Je krijgt onder begeleiding van ervaren collega's snel verantwoordelijkheden en speelt een zelfstandige rol in dossiers.

In jouw functie ben je bezig met het coördineren van transacties, het opstellen van besluiten, zekerheden, leningsovereenkomsten en andere transactiedocumenten en het adviseren op het gebied van financiering en zekerheden. Je hebt veel interactie met cliënten en andere adviseurs. De transactiepraktijk is internationaal en altijd in beweging. Daarom werk je altijd samen met onze ervaren advocaten, die je ondersteunen in je ontwikkeling.

Wij bieden

  •        Een inspirerende werkomgeving met veel aandacht voor persoonlijke verhoudingen en samenwerking

  •        Alle ruimte om je persoonlijk en professioneel verder te ontwikkelen, onder andere door onze VBK Academy en de mogelijkheid tot het volgen van een specialisatieopleiding

  •        Uitstekende doorgroeimogelijkheden en de kans om je wetenschappelijk te ontwikkelen, bijvoorbeeld door te doceren en door het schrijven van publicaties

  •        Ruime gelegenheid om je collega's te leren kennen tijdens de vele sociale activiteiten, zoals de wekelijkse donderdagmiddagborrel, sportactiviteiten, uitjes en kantoorfeesten

  •        Een marktconform salaris en breed pakket aan secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een Microsoft Copilot+ laptop, iPhone, NS-businesscard of mobiliteitsbudget en fietsplanregeling.


Wij zoeken een collega die

  •        Aantoonbaar geïnteresseerd is in financiering en zekerheden en de transactiepraktijk

  •        Sociaal, proactief, servicegericht en analytisch is

  •        In staat is om cliënten op een praktische en doeltreffende wijze bij te staan

  •        Zowel in teamverband als zelfstandig goed kan werken

  •        De Engelse taal op een goed niveau beheerst

 

Zo maken wij Legal

Onze medewerkers zijn gedreven, altijd in beweging en verbinden zich met elkaar, onze cliënten en met de maatschappij. Niet voor niets verkozen zakelijke beslissers ons al drie keer tot beste juridisch dienstverlener (2019, 2021, 2023) van Nederland (MT1000).

In ons vakgebied betekent stilstand achteruitgang. We bieden je daarom alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en te ontplooien. Vakinhoudelijk, maar ook qua soft skills. Tegelijkertijd is er meer dan werk alleen. Onze successen vieren we daarom samen en we hechten veel waarde aan onze onderlinge verbinding. Zo blijven we individueel en als team in beweging om samen de beste resultaten te behalen. Want samen maken wij legal.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Implementation Specialist

WorkWave is a leading provider of SaaS solutions, helping businesses streamline their operations and drive growth through innovative technology. As we continue to expand, we are looking for an experienced Implementation Specialist to join our Global Professional Services team. In this role, you will play a key part in supporting our ongoing SaaS client implementations and software integrations—working alongside our senior product leads and implementation team to drive project delivery, manage data migration and mapping tasks, coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and provide project management support across active client go-lives.

Operating as a critical member of our APAC delivery team, you will serve as the engine powering project execution. While our core product leads oversee deep system configuration, you will ensure data flows accurately between systems, test integration workflows, keep stakeholders aligned, and deliver a smooth, high-trust customer onboarding experience.

This role demands an exceptional blend of analytical accuracy, clear communication, and calm composure under competing priorities. You will bring structure and momentum to active implementations, ensuring every client transitions smoothly into live operation. This role is based in Melbourne, Australia, reporting to the Head of Professional Services.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Technical Consultancy & Implementation: Deliver high-quality technical consultancy and implementation services in line with the contract and Statement of Work (SOW), ensuring a consistently positive customer experience.

  • Data Migration & Integration Validation: Manage data preparation, mapping, and migration activities while executing UAT and test scenarios to confirm solutions and integrations perform accurately prior to go-live.

  • Implementation & Configuration Support: Partner with senior implementation leads to execute project tasks, software configuration, and system validation across active client deployments.

  • Project Governance & Risk Tracking: Track implementation progress alongside project leads, complete stage-gate task lists within agreed SLAs, and proactively highlight risks or issues that could impact delivery timelines.

  • Customer Enablement & Adoption: Communicate clearly with clients regarding project requirements, delivering hands-on training and guiding them through business process improvements and technology adoption.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales and Customer Success colleagues to ensure seamless project handovers, smooth onboarding, and timely escalation of commercial expansion opportunities.

  • Product Mastery & Standards: Maintain strong working knowledge of WorkWave products, delivery methodologies, and company policies, representing WorkWave professionally at all times.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Implementation Experience: 2+ years of experience conducting software implementations within a SaaS environment, with a strong grasp of data migration, mapping, and UAT workflows.

  • Client Training & Enablement: Proven ability to train clients on new software platforms and updated operational processes.

  • Domain & System Familiarity: Experience with Finance, Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), and/or Payroll systems is advantageous, as is familiarity with the Cleaning, Facilities Management, or Security industries.

  • Stakeholder & Priority Management: Demonstrated ability to manage stakeholder expectations and conflicting priorities while maintaining perspective, accuracy, and composure.

  • Situational & Commercial Awareness: Strong judgment to escalate delivery risks appropriately to management and spot additional commercial opportunities during client engagements.

  • Communication & Professionalism: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a commitment to high standards of professional conduct and teamwork.

  • Education: A Bachelor’s degree in IT or a business-related field is desirable (no specific licences or certifications required).

Compensation

Additional Information

  • Laid back, but high-performing: We offer a casual work environment, remote flexibility, and a commitment to building innovative, best-in-class solutions that drive customer success.

  • Customer-focused: We deliver software and services that make a measurable difference to our clients and their businesses.

  • Inclusive and collaborative: We build partnerships based on mutual trust, shared goals, and open communication.

  • Curious and driven: Our team values proactive problem-solvers who want to make an impact while enjoying what they do.

LOVE WHAT YOU DO, NO MATTER WHERE YOU DO IT:

  • Remote-First Global Community: WorkWave connects talent worldwide with a modern remote-first culture. You get the stability and reach of an established global platform combined with the autonomy, innovation, and direct impact of a scale-up.

A GLOBAL COMPANY WITH A LOCAL PRESENCE:

  • True Workplace Flexibility: We support modern work/life balance. Whether collaborating virtually or meeting up face-to-face, our teams are fully equipped to deliver high-impact results remotely across Australia.

  • Global Footprint: Headquartered at the Bell Works campus in New Jersey (USA), we have team members across North America, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region.

  • Connected Culture: Regardless of location, every team member joins an inclusive network committed to supporting each other, delivering great software, and engaging with our local communities.

REWARD & WELLBEING:

In addition to statutory superannuation (guaranteed at the current legislated rate) and standard National Employment Standards (NES) leave—such as 4 weeks of annual leave and 10 days of personal/carer’s leave—we provide:
