Signal Processing Engineer (Radar)

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a confirmed Radar Signal Processing Engineer on Harmattan AI's Radar team in Paris, you will own the signal processing algorithms behind our next-generation airborne radar payload. You will take full ownership of your workstream, from algorithmic research through embedded implementation and flight validation, working with high autonomy and minimal oversight. You will work closely with the EW and RF analytics teams to translate product-level requirements into deployed, mission-ready capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement near-real-time algorithms for radar image formation, including inverse SAR (ISAR) processing of moving targets.

  • Develop and refine detection and tracking algorithms (e.g., EKF/UKF-based approaches) for moving target indication on airborne radar data.

  • Build jamming estimation capabilities, combining out-of-band spectral sniffing with in-band spatial covariance analysis, and the adaptive logic that drives radar behavior in response.

  • Contribute radar-derived observables and algorithms that support navigation when GNSS is unavailable.

  • Prototype and port algorithms onto the selected embedded computing platform, balancing algorithmic performance against real-time and resource constraints.

  • Validate algorithms end-to-end through hardware-in-the-loop bench testing, anechoic chamber campaigns, and real flight conditions, iterating quickly on results.

  • Work closely with the EW and RF analytics modules to align signal processing development with system-level requirements.

Candidate Requirements

  • 2 to 5 years of confirmed, hands-on experience in radar signal processing, gained in the defense or automotive radar industry preferably.

  • Solid experience in Signal Processing on radar systems, either FMCW or pulsed, is required; exposure to moving target tracking, ECCM, radar-based navigation, or live/real-time processing is a strong plus.

  • Strong theoretical foundations and genuine hands-on comfort with the underlying mathematics, not reliance on off-the-shelf tools or LLM-generated solutions.

  • A quick thinker, comfortable taking full ownership of a technical scope end-to-end with minimal oversight.

  • Comfortable working in a fast, iterative cycle: writing code, running hardware-in-the-loop tests, and pushing validated changes independently.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

CDI - Head of Finance (Paris)

We are hiring a Head of Finance and to own the finance function end to end, reporting to the CFO: monthly close and reporting, budget and rolling business plan, board materials, cash, audits and the regulatory obligations of a syndic, across our French and German entities.

It is a hands-on role for someone who can do every job in the team and wants to shape the function as the company scales.

With our CFO focused on fundraising and strategic topics, you will be the day-to-day finance decision-maker, working directly with the CEO, the VPs and the German country manager. As Matera grows, including through acquisitions in France and Germany, there is scope to rapidly grow into a VP Finance role.

What you will do

1. Operational finance and business plan (70%) :

  • Own the monthly close of all entities (in France and Germany) and deliver the management reporting pack: P&L, cash, KPIs, reconciliation with the statutory accounts, reporting to investors and banks.

  • Own the annual budget, built with every team lead, and the business plan, updated every month after the close, for France and Germany.

  • Own cash: the cash forecast, collection from customers, bank loans and their covenants, financing files and data rooms.

  • Deliver the statutory audits in France and Germany and the annual accounts and filings of every entity, as well as the obligations specific to a property manager: the financial guarantee (garantie financière) that protects our clients' money, and the certifications of the funds we hold on their behalf (fonds mandants). You also cover the research tax credit (CIR) and tax.

2. Strategic topics (20%) :

  • Lead the finance team (4 people) and steer our external accountants and auditors on scope, calendar and fees.

  • Prepare the board deck and investor materials with the CFO, including for our 2027 fundraise, and bring a clear finance view to strategic decisions: acquisitions, growth versus capacity, cash allocation, pricing.

  • Drive our finance tools roadmap: selecting and rolling out an ERP (planned for late 2027), billing and payment tools, and automating data and reporting.

  • Pick up whatever else lands on finance: supplier negotiations, legal structure of our entities, equity events.

3. M&A (10%) : work with the other teams on financial analyses, billing, and the integration of the companies we acquire.

What success looks like after 12 months

  • The monthly close and reporting pack land on a fixed calendar in both countries, without escalation

  • Audits in France and Germany are signed on time and on fee; every entity's accounts are filed on time

  • Garantie financière and fonds mandants obligations are met with no gaps

  • The rolling business plan is the single reference for decisions, refreshed every month after close

  • The weekly cash forecast is trusted by the CEO and the board; collection has improved measurably

  • Every finance deliverable has a clear owner, and the German close runs locally

  • The ERP is selected and its implementation is on plan

What we offer

Benefits

  • Parental support: a gradual return at 80% for 4 weeks (paid at 100%), plus 5 extra days off per year when your child is sick.

  • Responsible commute leave: 1 extra paid day off per year (can be split into two half-days) to encourage low-carbon commuting.

  • Menstrual leave: 1 extra paid day off per month to manage painful periods.

  • Sport: access to Wellpass for affordable gym and sports.

  • Works council perks (Leeto): discounts on culture and leisure (cinema, museums, theme parks…).

  • Remote work: 2 days a week at the office.

  • Career support: weekly one-to-ones with your manager, 2 performance reviews a year, and an internal mobility policy.

  • A laptop and a work phone.

Practical information

  • Location: Paris 10th

  • Contract: permanent contract (CDI), full-time, cadre status on a forfait jours basis

  • Salary: €90k to €100k base, depending on experience

  • Start date: before July 2027


What we are looking for

You must have:

  • 7+ years in finance, including at least 2 years owning the close and audits of a multi-entity company, for example as Head of Finance, Finance Manager or Senior Financial Controller.

  • Hands-on experience of closing the books and running statutory audits in France: you know the French system (social charges, tax, statutory auditors).

  • Experience in a group with entities in other countries (not necessarily Germany).

  • You build and defend financial models (P&L, cash, headcount, churn) and can run a monthly business plan yourself.

  • You have managed a small team, and you still like doing some of the work yourself.

  • Fluent French and English, written and spoken.

You are:

  • Direct: you say when a number does not hold, including to the CEO.

  • Hands-on and structured: you turn open questions into plans with owners and deadlines.

  • Firm with suppliers: you manage auditors, accountants and vendors on scope, calendar and fees.

  • Autonomous and comfortable with change: you have worked in a growing company that needed structure.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with a German subsidiary or parent company, or speaking German.

  • Experience of acquisitions and their integration.

  • Experience in a regulated environment or with client funds (real estate, property management, fintech).

  • Experience of selecting or rolling out an ERP.

Our hiring process

1️⃣ A 30-minute phone call with Camille, our recruiter

2️⃣ A technical discussion with Krystal, our CFO, and Valent, our current Head of Finance (45 min, video call)

3️⃣ A case study to prepare and present to the CFO and Head Of Finance (45 min, video call)

4️⃣ A meeting with Raphaël, our CEO, and the team, at our office (1h)

5️⃣ Reference checks, then an offer

Good to know:

🕑 We do our best to get back to you quickly (within a week). Whether the answer is yes or no, you will receive an email from us, so remember to check your spam folder.

☝️ If you need any adjustments to take part in the interviews in the best conditions, let us know in your application or tell the recruitment team.

The role

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you are the first commercial point of contact with our prospects. You join Zefir's Sales team and reach out to homeowners who have run a valuation on our website but have not booked an appointment yet.

The core of the role is reactivation: these homeowners showed interest, then stopped there. You are the one who gets them moving again, on the phone, one by one.

Your goal as a BDR: create the sales opportunities that feed our revenue directly.

Career path

We are transparent on this. A BDR role can open the door to an Account Executive role internally, but there is no automatic progression and no guaranteed timeline. Any move depends on three things: performance, behavioral fit, and team needs.

Computational Biologist
jobs.description:
Computational Biologist

About Proxima

Proxima (formerly VantAI) is advancing an AI-native approach to drug discovery by making protein interactions programmable. Our platform brings together foundation-model machine learning, a scalable data generation engine, and a partnership track record exceeding $5B in collaborations across the world’s leading biopharma and tech organizations. We’ve recently closed an oversubscribed seed round partnering us with an elite group of sophisticated and dedicated VCs including DCVC, Nvidia’s Nventures, AIX, Yosemite among others.

Neo-1 is our all-atom foundation model that combines state-of-the-art structure prediction and molecular generation in a single system. Neo-1 enables rapid exploration of chemical and structural space for high value, previously intractable targets, and in particular unlocks small molecule proximity therapeutics like molecular glues with AI for the first time.

In parallel, we are developing an advanced structural interactomics platform built on proprietary XLMS technology and a lab equipped with next-generation mass spectrometry instrumentation. This platform produces proteome-scale maps of protein interactions and helps identify small molecules that modulate proximity. Together with Neo-1, it creates an integrated system capable of co-folding protein complexes while generating candidate small molecules to influence those interactions.

Proximity-based therapeutics represent one of most promising frontiers in modern drug discovery with the potential to treat previously intractable diseases and target ‘undruggable’ proteins. Our technology combines proteome-scale structural data with state-of-the-art generative AI foundation models, and coupled with our talented team of scientists and engineers we are uniquely well-positioned to discover and develop a new class of medicines. Come join us!

About You:

Proxima is seeking highly-motivated Computational Biologists interested in building the leading AI-enabled drug discovery platform for novel induced proximity therapeutic modality.

Successful candidates will work closely with the Computational Chemistry, Machine Learning and Application Engineering teams to tap into the wealth of evolutionary, structural and -omics data to unlock the full potential of unified machine learning representations and large-scale geometric deep learning generative models.

Projects may include designing large-scale scientific workflows for mining public and unique in-house data; developing novel systems biology and structural biology computational methods, tools and algorithms; and/or designing, training and fine-tuning best-in-class machine learning models. In our projects we apply induced proximity approaches to some of the most challenging targets considered “undruggable” as well as discover, build and develop novel proximity platforms spanning across multiple targets and disease areas.

We value individuals who want to make an impact, have a deep intellectual curiosity, enjoy solving challenging problems and have a track record of achievement. At Proxima, we believe that success is determined by talent and hard work, and individuals are given equal opportunities to grow and advance based on their abilities and contributions.

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Develop pilot capabilities and create large-scale data pipelines from the ground up 

  • Collaborate with other teams across Proxima and partnering organizations to achieve project goals by contributing code, analyses, benchmarks, optimizations and ideas to ongoing research-driven projects

  • Integrate biological insights into the next generation of AI/ML models for drug discovery

  • Validate and interpret computational predictions by working closely with experimentalists 

 Basic Qualifications:

  • Hold an MSc or PhD degree in computational biology, bioinformatics or a related field

  • Possess mixed academic and/or industrial experience, preferably in the biotech industry

  • Have a strong background in computational structural or systems biology

  • Demonstrate strong programming skills in Python, R and/or other languages

  • Experience building reproducible and scalable computational biology workflows

  • Experience designing and applying machine learning models

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with geometric deep learning, graph neural networks, protein language models, transformers and representation learning is a plus

  • Preferably have prior exposure to drug discovery problems

  • Experience working with cloud-based infrastructure

  • Agile project management

jobs.title: Senior Data Architect (remote from Europe)
jobs.description:
Senior Data Architect (remote from Europe)

Data Architecture & Governance

Designs scalable and reusable data architectures to support transversal use across multiple domains and systems.

Leads the definition and standardization of enterprise-wide common data models (submissions, cases, products, etc.).

Develops and enforces data governance policies to support consistent, high-quality, and compliant data usage.

Data Quality, Classification & Retention

Establishes data quality controls, validation frameworks, and monitoring mechanisms across key datasets.

Defines and implements data classification standards and integrates them into data cataloguing solutions.

Supports the implementation and enforcement of data retention and lifecycle policies in alignment with regulatory and business needs.

API Design & Integration

Defines API contracts and facilitates alignment between producers and consumers of data services.

Ensures APIs reflect well-defined and reusable data models, enabling efficient integration across teams and systems.

Leads integration efforts with enterprise data platforms, ensuring data flows are secure, traceable, and optimised.

Testing, Documentation & Support

Designs test data strategies for validating data pipelines and ensuring robustness of data-dependent applications.

Supports, suggests and applies methods for the creation of synthetic data for testing purposes.

Ensures technical documentation of data models, data flows, and integration points is maintained and accessible.

Supports platform teams and domain owners by advising on best practices in using shared data assets and APIs.

Technical Design and Implementation

Translates business and platform needs into scalable, secure, and maintainable data architecture designs.

Supports resolution of legacy data issues, including schema harmonization, normalization, and versioning.

Security, Compliance & Risk Management

Ensures data solutions adhere to security and compliance standards, including data privacy, access control, and regulatory requirements.

Collaborates with data protection and legal teams to ensure the architecture supports compliance-by-design principles.

Agile Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

Actively participates in SAFe Agile ceremonies, supporting backlog refinement, planning, and reviews.

REQUIREMENTS:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Engineering or a related field.

Proven experience as a Data Architect or in a similar role focused on enterprise data architecture, data modelling, and platform integration.

Solid understanding of modern data architecture patterns, including data Lakehouse, event-driven architectures, and API-based data access.

Familiarity with Agile development methodologies, particularly SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework).

Extensive experience designing and maintaining common data models across large-scale enterprise systems (e.g., submissions, cases, products).

Experience implementing data governance frameworks, retention policies, and classification schemes.

Strong background in API design and the definition of clear and reusable API contracts between systems.

Proven experience integrating data systems with external platforms, data hubs, and pipelines.

Experience with testing frameworks for data, including generating and managing synthetic or representative test data.

Demonstrated ability to assess, document, and resolve technical debt in data pipelines and data models.

Experience with metadata management, data cataloguing tools, and improving data discoverability and reusability.

Level: Senior

Delivery mode: Remote from Europe (flexibility to travel to Amsterdam for Client’s meetings occasionally).

Europass CV format

only EU Citizens

jobs.title: Senior Sales Executive
Senior Manager CMI Europe
jobs.description:
Senior Manager CMI Europe

 

 

 

The Practical Detail 
Location: Amsterdam 
Hybrid model 

Why this role matters
We are looking for a commercially minded Head of Consumer & Market Insights Europe to ensure that consumers are at the heart of the decisions shaping the future growth of our great brands. This role is vital because it brings the consumer's voice into every strategic choice, from brand positioning to innovation and execution. In this role you will translate complex market and consumer data into clear, actionable opportunities that drive better food experiences in kitchens across Europe. Your work will help the business anticipate shifts in taste, nutrition, and consumer needs, ensuring Flora Food Group stays one step ahead. 

What you'll do 

  • Lead the European consumer and market insights strategy, identifying and delivering against the key questions that drive growth. 
  • Partner with senior marketing and cross-functional leaders to shape strategy and commercial decisions with clear, evidence-based consumer perspectives. 
  • Build and manage a focused learning agenda aligned with Flora's six strategic growth priorities, supporting innovation and market acceleration. 
  • Integrate qualitative and quantitative data, market intelligence, and emerging technologies to create a holistic view of consumer behaviour. 
  • Lead a lean, high-impact insights team, optimizing resources and fostering curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning. 

Performance 
You will own the quality and impact of consumer insights that shape European business decisions, driving measurable growth. Success will be tracked by how insight influences priority decisions, the delivery of learning agendas on time, and early involvement in innovation projects. You will lead the adoption of AI and advanced analytics to improve decision speed and quality, ensuring research budgets deliver maximum return on investment. 

Care 
You will report to the Global Insights Vice President and lead a dedicated European insights team. Collaboration across marketing, innovation, research and development, and other functions will be key to embedding consumer centricity throughout the organisation. Your leadership will ensure sustainable, responsible use of data and technology, building long-term capabilities that support Flora Food Group's mission to create better food for diverse communities. 

Passion 
As a food lover and consumer champion, you will bring relentless curiosity and empathy to your role. You will connect deeply with evolving food culture, nutrition trends, and consumer needs, inspiring your team and partners to innovate with confidence. Your passion for integrating taste, nutrition, functionality, and reliability will raise the bar for how insights drive meaningful consumer experiences. 

About you 
You have significant senior experience in consumer and market insights, ideally within food, beverages, or fast-moving consumer goods. You excel at influencing senior stakeholders and shaping brand, innovation, and commercial decisions through integrated insight and strong storytelling capabilities. You have experience operating across countries and cultures  and your strategic mindset combines human understanding with advanced analytics and emerging technologies like AI. You thrive in complex, matrixed environments and build trust across diverse teams to prioritise impactful work. 

You are genuinely interested in food culture and have a relentless curiosity about consumer behaviour and how future food trends shape innovation. You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences. 

Where this could lead to 
This role typically leads to broader leadership positions within global consumer insights or commercial strategy, expanding your influence across more markets. Over time, potentially shaping Flora Food Group's global approach to consumer understanding and innovation, driving long-term growth and transformation. 

What's next 
If this opportunity sounds exciting, we'd love to hear from you. 

Apply before: 1st of December. 

For questions about the role, please contact: 
Alice Graca 
 

We understand your resume might not be up to date and recommend that you apply with what you have or your LinkedIn Profile. Flora Food Group is dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workplace, we understand that you might not meet all the requirements stated in the description, but we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the right candidate for this role or other roles.

jobs.title: Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Test Engineer

Wij zijn op zoek naar een test engineer met een brede technische interesse die techniek graag combineert met organiseren en samenwerken. Hoe mooi is het om als eerste een installatie aan te zetten en te testen of alles werkt zoals bedoeld en voldoet aan de verwachtingen van de opdrachtgever? Je werkt met uiteenlopende systemen, zoals camerasystemen, branddetectie, luchtbehandeling, voedingsverdeelkasten, verlichting, netwerken en waterinstallaties. Kortom: een compleet technisch gebouw, waarbij jij helpt om alles goed en aantoonbaar werkend op te leveren.

Dit wordt jouw baan

Je brengt samen met de testmanager in kaart wat er getest moet worden, stelt testplanningen en -protocollen op en bewaakt de voortgang. Je bereidt onder andere FAT-, PAT- en iFAT-testen voor, zorgt dat de juiste mensen, systemen en componenten beschikbaar zijn en begeleidt de daadwerkelijke testuitvoering. Bevindingen leg je zorgvuldig vast en je bewaakt dat deze worden opgevolgd. Je hoeft daarbij niet vanaf dag één specialist te zijn in alle systemen. Je werkt samen met ervaren testmanagers, testcoördinatoren, engineers en technische specialisten en krijgt de ruimte om je inhoudelijk verder te ontwikkelen.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

Hier zit je op je plek

Je wordt onderdeel van de vakgroep Technische Installaties binnen het cluster Ontwerp van Dura Vermeer Infra Landelijke Projecten. Samen met circa 140 collega's werk je aan de grootste multidisciplinaire infrastructurele projecten van Nederland, zoals tunnels, bruggen, sluizen, energieprojecten, waterzuiveringen en hoogspanningsinstallaties. Binnen het project werk je nauw samen met collega's uit ontwerp, uitvoering en projectbeheersing. Je krijgt veel ruimte om richting te geven aan het testproces en kunt daarbij terugvallen op ervaren collega's en technische specialisten. Afhankelijk van het project werk je op locatie, vanuit een Dura Vermeer-kantoor of vanuit huis. Als eerste opdracht voorzien we een rol op het project Landstations, waarbij we de locatie realiseren waar de wind energie vanuit windparken op zee wordt omgezet naar het landzijdige nationale elektriciteitsnet. Je werk daarmee direct mee aan de verduurzaming van onze elektriciteitsvoorziening.


Dit breng jij mee

  • Een hbo / wo opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in elektrotechniek, werktuigbouwkunde, industriële automatisering of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • Een brede interesse in technische installaties en de motivatie om verschillende systemen te leren doorgronden;

  • Je kunt technische tekeningen en documentatie lezen of bent gemotiveerd om dit verder te leren;

  • Je werkt gestructureerd en kunt technische informatie vertalen naar een praktische aanpak;

  • Je communiceert makkelijk met verschillende partijen en vindt het leuk om techniek en coördinatie te combineren;

  • Ervaring met testen, commissioning, FAT/SAT of technische projectcoördinatie is een pré.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Het salaris voor deze functie ligt tussen € 4.291,63,- en € 5.364,54,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Het exacte salaris is afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring.

  • Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra).

  • 43 verlofdagen volgens de Cao Bouw & Infra. Van deze dagen worden er 13 uitbetaald in je individuele budget, je kunt ervoor kiezen om deze dagen terug te kopen;

  • Een laptop en een smartphone;

  • Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico's, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap;

  • Je hebt de keuze tussen een mobiliteitsbudget, NS Business Card of een elektrische leaseauto;

  • Bij een contract voor onbepaalde tijd kun je een gloednieuwe (elektrische) fiets uitzoeken dankzij onze samenwerking met lease-a-bike;

  • Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied, maar bijvoorbeeld ook op het gebied van vitaliteit;

  • Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500 sportlocaties door heel Nederland;

  • Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij een flexibelwerkenbeleid en soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of sabbatical;

  • Voor verse vaders en partners: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens de vijf weken van het aanvullend geboorteverlof, in plaats van de standaard 70%.

Wil jij ook meer uit je werk halen?

Dan zijn wij nieuwsgierig naar jou! Solliciteer direct via de sollicitatiebutton.

Meer weten? Neem contact op met onze recruiter.

Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met Fabian Kamps op

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
Account Executive

Competencies

Planhat OS is a model-agnostic AI operating system where people and agents work together across the entire customer lifecycle. At its heart is Pi, the world’s first multiplayer customer agent. Think Salesforce, Slack and Claude all in one and Google Cloud has stated that Planhat has built the first next-generation CRM.

We’re 250+ people, profitable, and growing fast. The world’s biggest logos run on Planhat because Salesforce and ServiceNow can’t deliver fast enough.

More specifically, the people who do this well bring:

  • Sales process expertise: you successfully carry revenue responsibility and can craft memorable sales processes tailored to SaaS VP and C-level executives

  • Curiosity: you know it's much deeper than slide decks and swag. You're speaking with a FinTech company and quickly figure out that the CRO wants to reduce churn, and that CS reps need to automate a bunch of tedious tasks

  • Business acumen: you're tech-savvy and a quick learner. You can figure out people's biggest commercial challenges and set them on their way to long-term success

  • Builder mentality: you thrive in uncharted territory. You take initiative, create your own playbooks, and figure out how to get traction

  • High performance: you consistently exceed revenue targets. You're motivated by growth and impact, and you're always looking for a tougher challenge

Before joining Planhat our current Account Executives had experience such as:

  • Proven track records in selling powerful B2B SaaS products, usually at scrappy startups, often starting out as BDR/SDR and progressing quickly to AE

  • Running an effective sales cycle, defining and owning it, from prospecting to closing with VP and C-level executives

  • Revenue responsibility in sales or customer success, exceeding targets and overperforming at fast-growing software companies

  • A strong academic and/or competitive sports background, since this role takes a blend of grit, determination, and commercial acumen

Trajectory

We define and drive Planhat's GTM strategy and sales process. We excel at identifying our buyers' objectives regardless of their role, seniority level, company size, or industry. This means we power the growth not only of Planhat, but of software businesses across our key markets:

  • Tailoring our approach for every person, even when leaders at the same company have unique goals and pain points

  • Leading strategic discussions with the C-suite, diving deep into the product, and ironing out the nitty-gritty details

  • Listening and building trust, understanding what success looks like, handling objections, creating the right onboarding plan, and steering the path to a signed contract

Definition of Success

  • You own a revenue target and exceed it quarter over quarter

  • You have a strong pipeline, built through both inbound and self-sourced opportunities, and you own the full sales cycle end to end

  • You are consistently seen as a trusted advisor by your prospects and customers, not just a salesperson

  • You are growing into more senior commercial responsibilities within the team

  • You are actively shaping the culture and playbook of a high-performing AE team at Planhat

jobs.description:
Account Manager (ENT/Strategic) (Remote) (Chicago, Illinois)

KnowBe4 empowers the modern workforce to make smarter security decisions every day. Trusted by more than 70,000 organizations worldwide, KnowBe4 is the pioneer of digital workforce security, securing both AI agents and humans. The KnowBe4 Platform provides attack simulation and training, collaboration security, and agent security powered by AIDA (Artificial Intelligence Defense Agents) and a proprietary Risk Score. The platform leverages 15-years of behavioral data to combat advanced threats including social engineering, prompt injection, and shadow AI. By securing humans and agents, KnowBe4 leads the industry in workforce trust and defense.

The Account Manager (Enterprise/Strategic) position is responsible for managing assigned customer accounts and maximizing all sales opportunities within those accounts. More specifically, this position will be charged with promoting and selling KnowBe4’s additional products and services to businesses (organizations with 1501+ employees), with the objective to achieve and exceed monthly sales quota. This can be achieved by targeting your book of business and maximizing cross sale opportunities, increasing subscription levels and adding on additional seats due to account growth. This role will work closely with the Customer Success Manager to ensure increased ARR and more product suite adoption by our customers.

Responsibilities:

  • Promote and sell KnowBe4’s range of products and services
  • Build and maintain a pipeline of potential cross sale, add-on and upgrade opportunities by developing and managing relationships with your assigned accounts
  • Identify key decision makers while developing and qualifying cross sale, add-on and upgrade opportunities
  • Articulate the value proposition of KnowBe4’s full suite of products and help the customer understand how it will improve their business’s security awareness training (and security overall)

  • Experience selling multi-year deals

  • Experience with strategic account planning and management showing measurable account growth
  • Experience managing and progressing opportunities involving multiple stakeholders
  • Has a track record of managing and closing complex, multi-year deals with multiple stakeholders
  • Experience creating and communicating compelling business cases
  • Experience with consultative selling approach and value selling methodology
  • Experience handling technical objections
  • Skilled in running discovery conversations and managing tailored product demonstrations
  • Technical aptitude with experience using sales tools
  • Experience with CRM systems (preferably Salesforce)
  • Experienced with pipeline management & accurate forecasting
  • Familiarity with standard concepts, practices and procedures within the IT Security Field
  • Experience with Salesforce and Gmail
  • Network or Security Plus preferred
  • Proven track record of grit and resilience in challenging situations, with high performance under pressure
  • Collegiate athlete or competitive sports background demonstrating rigorous discipline, teamwork, dedication, and competitive spirit
  • History of setting and achieving ambitious personal or professional goals
  • Track record of leadership in team settings

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with previous presentation experience
  • Excellent phone presence and professional demeanor
  • Time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to handle rejection and maintain persistence
  • Stats driven business professional
  • Motivated, energetic self-starter
  • Strong collaborative and teamwork skills

    • Basic network and email security concepts
    • SIEM/SOAR platforms
    • Zero Trust Architecture

Technical Lead Manager

About Us:

Homebound is on a mission to make it possible for anyone, anywhere, to build a home using technology. Created by an experienced team of construction, real estate, design, and technology experts, Homebound is transforming the residential construction industry by improving the costly and inefficient process of building a home.

We’ve created an entirely new way to build homes with technology powering every stage from start to finish to provide a seamless experience for our customers. Homeowners across the country can choose where they want to live, select a home plan that’s perfect for them, then personalize and buy it, all online. Homebound has raised $150M in capital from leading venture capitalists like Google, Khosla, Thrive Ventures, and we’re scaling quickly in places like Texas, Colorado and Florida. Come build your future with us.

About The Role:

We're hiring a Tech Lead Manager (Staff+) to lead a small team building the platform that is modernizing homebuilding. This is a leadership-track role for a senior engineer ready to grow their scope and impact. You'll stay hands-on as a technical leader while directly managing a team of 2–4 engineers.

The role blends deep technical ownership with people leadership. You'll set technical direction for your domain, ship production-grade code, and be accountable for the growth, output, and delivery of your team. The work spans the full stack and covers both internal tools that power construction operations and customer-facing experiences for homeowners and trades.

We're a remote-first team. You'll work from wherever you do your best work, with regular offsites to get together in person. You'll own entire product areas, make real technical decisions, and work directly with engineering leadership, product, and design to take features from concept to production.

What You'll Do:

Technical Leadership:

  • Set technical direction for your domain. Contribute to architecture decisions, API contracts, and data models that shape how our systems scale and evolve.

  • Design, build, and deliver features across the platform. You own the full lifecycle from technical design through deployment and monitoring.

  • Stay hands-on. Write and deploy high-quality, production-grade code on a regular basis.

  • Raise the bar across engineering. Review designs, improve developer experience, and help other engineers work through complex problems.

People Leadership:

  • Directly manage a team of 2–4 engineers. Hold regular 1:1s, give clear and actionable feedback, and lead growth and performance conversations.

  • Own your team's delivery. Drive planning, prioritization, and execution, and be accountable for outcomes.

  • Coach and develop your engineers. Help them grow their skills, scope, and careers, and create the conditions for them to do their best work.

  • Partner with product and design to translate messy, real-world processes into clean, reliable software and to make tradeoffs that balance speed and quality.

  • Help grow the team. Recruit, interview, and raise the bar on who we hire.

About You:

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping products that land real-world impact.

  • Experience as a tech lead, team lead, or engineering manager. You've led projects and/or people, whether formally or informally, and prior direct management experience is a strong plus.

  • Built and delivered full-stack features across modern web technologies. Our stack includes TypeScript, Node, React, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and AWS. We care more about your ability to learn and build than checking every box.

  • Actively using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) in your daily workflow. You can explain how they change the way you approach problems and how you'd bring that leverage to a team.

  • Demonstrated leadership and ownership. Mentoring engineers, influencing technical direction, and being the person people depend on.

  • Designed systems that balance quick iterations with long-term reliability and maintainability.

  • Partnered with product, design, and non-technical stakeholders to define requirements, make tradeoffs, and deliver outcomes. Not just code.

Who You Are:

  • You want to grow your scope and impact through leadership, both technical and people.

  • You care about the people on your team. Their growth, their output, and their experience.

  • You take ownership and seek autonomy over your work and outcomes.

  • You're excited to build and lead within a small, nimble, high-impact team.

  • You are self-directed. Comfortable prioritizing your own work and your team's with minimal oversight.

  • You communicate clearly and proactively. Especially in writing.

  • You're humble, good-natured, and bring positive energy to your tea

jobs.title: Senior IT & Corporate Engineering
jobs.description:
Senior IT & Corporate Engineering

Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.

We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.

Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

- Mission-critical problems: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.

- High bar, low ego: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.

- Speed over comfort: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.

- Enduring impact: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.

Team & Locations

We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

About The Role

This role owns IT and corporate engineering at Flex, end to end. It reports directly to the CTO.

We think IT's job is enablement. The measure of this function is not how many tickets it closes or how many controls it can point at. It is whether everyone else at Flex can do their work faster and more safely than they could last quarter. A new hire productive on day one instead of day four. An engineer who gets exactly the access they need in minutes, without asking twice and without being handed the keys to everything. A team that can adopt a new tool because someone reviewed it properly, not because they routed around IT to buy it on a personal card. So we are not looking for a gatekeeper, or for someone whose default answer is no. The right person makes the safe path the easy path, and removes friction permanently instead of absorbing it repeatedly.

Which is why this role also owns Flex's corporate security posture. Identity, access, endpoints, and the SaaS estate are one system, and the person who makes access fast should be the person who decides how much access is reasonable. Split those across two teams and employees route around both. You'll set conditional access and MFA policy, own privileged access and endpoint posture, and run third-party OAuth and Workspace grant review. Our security engineers own the product and infrastructure side, the money paths and the code, and you'll work with them constantly. Corporate security is yours to decide, not to implement on someone else's behalf.

This is the hard part of the job, and we'd rather say so than leave it as a bonus line. The argument between moving fast and holding a line is now an argument you have with yourself. Day to day, what gets tightened, what gets mitigated, and what we knowingly accept is your call; the large ones come to the CTO, and we'd rather see a close call early than find out you decided it quietly. What we'd ask is that a no comes from a real read of the risk and the business context rather than a standard applied by default.

The rest of the work has two halves. The IT half is the fleet, identity, access, the SaaS estate, and the joiner/mover/leaver process, delivered with help from a managed IT partner who handles procurement, device logistics, tier-1 support, and international coverage. You own that relationship, define the SLA, and enforce it. The corporate engineering half is the part we think makes this a good job: writing the automation and internal tooling that means the IT half doesn't scale linearly with headcount. If a process only works because a person runs it by hand every Tuesday, we'd rather you replaced it.

You'd be inheriting an estate here, not starting one. The first year is as much untangling what has already accumulated - stale access, tools nobody reviewed, processes that work because someone remembers them - as it is building what comes next. Automate that assessment. Nobody should be reading through a SaaS estate by hand in 2026.

Now the shape of this. Flex is around 150 people, and you would be the only person in this function, with vendor capacity underneath you and a direct line to the CTO. That means real autonomy and real scope from week one. It also means this is a hands-on senior individual contributor role, not a management role, and we are not planning a team under it in the near term. If you're looking to build and lead an IT organization right now, this isn't that job, and we'd rather you knew before you applied.

We're looking for an IT and corporate engineering builder who wants to own security posture, rather than a security specialist willing to cover IT. Both halves have to interest you. If the enablement work reads as the price of admission for the security work, this will be a frustrating job.

What You'll Do

  • Own IT and corporate engineering end to end: the roadmap, the budget, the vendor relationships, and the outcomes.

  • Manage our external IT partner as delivery capacity, not as a peer function. Define the scope, set the SLA, hold them to it, and own the escalation path when it slips.

  • Design the joiner, mover, and leaver process and the entitlement model behind it. Make onboarding fast enough that a new hire is working on day one, and keep deprovisioning in-house and same-day, because it's the highest-consequence action in IT.

  • Administer and improve our identity and productivity stack (Okta, Google Workspace, and the SaaS estate around them), including SSO, SCIM, and group and role design.

  • Own operational policy: device standards, the access-request workflow, and SaaS onboarding and procurement review. Review tools before people buy them, and make that review fast enough that nobody wants to skip it.

  • Build the automation. Provisioning, access reviews, asset and license reconciliation, and the internal tooling that removes recurring manual work across the SaaS estate.

  • Run the endpoint and MDM program across a distributed, increasingly international company, and keep the fleet in a state you'd be comfortable showing an auditor.

  • Own Flex's corporate security posture. Conditional access, MFA, session and device rules, and privileged access are yours to set. So is endpoint posture, and the review of third-party OAuth and Workspace grants that quietly accumulate at every company this age.

  • Design and deliver the security awareness and training program. Not a once-a-year video, and not the version people click through with the sound off.

  • Partner with our security engineers, who own product and infrastructure security. The line runs between corporate and product, not between operating and deciding. You'll bring them into identity decisions with blast radius, and they'll rely on you for provisioning data they can trust.

  • Work closely with People, Finance, and Legal. Onboarding, offboarding, spend, and audit evidence all run through this function.

  • Be a real internal service. Publish what you own, respond when people ask, and find the friction before it turns into a workaround.

What Makes You A Great Fit

  • You think IT exists to make other people effective, and you can point at specific friction you removed rather than tickets you closed.

  • You write code. Not necessarily production services, but scripts, integrations, and glue that other people end up depending on.

  • You'd rather fix the process than get faster at the workaround.

  • You hold both sides of this honestly. You've said no to something that mattered, and you've also said yes to something a stricter version of you would have blocked, and you can explain both calls.

  • You're comfortable being the only person in a function, and comfortable saying what you need instead of quietly absorbing it.

  • You know you can't be in the loop on every request, and you don't want to be. You build the self-service paths that let people get what they need without going through you.

  • You can hold a vendor accountable without turning the relationship adversarial.

  • You can tell a colleague, including a senior one, that what they've built can't keep the access it has, explain why in plain language, and work alongside them to find a way that works.

  • You're calm when something is broken and several people are watching.

  • You explain technical constraints clearly to people who don't share your background, in writing, across time zones.

What We're Looking For

  • Substantial hands-on experience owning IT or corporate engineering at a growing company, including a stretch where you were the most senior person doing the work. Roughly [6+] years is typical, but we care about what you've owned, not the year count.

  • Deep, hands-on ownership of an identity provider (Okta, Entra, JumpCloud, or similar) at the design layer: SSO, SCIM, SAML, group and entitlement modeling. Not just the admin console.

  • Practical experience running Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 as a platform.

  • Real MDM and endpoint experience across macOS, and ideally Windows, in a remote or hybrid company.

  • Automation ability in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, Go, TypeScript, or similar), and comfort with APIs and identity plumbing.

  • Experience designing an access model and running access reviews, not only fulfilling requests.

  • Real ownership of identity security decisions, not only their execution. You've set MFA or conditional access policy, tightened privileged access, or cleaned up third-party app grants, and you can talk about what you traded away to do it.

  • Track record managing an outsourced IT provider or MSP, or a clear-eyed view of why the ones you've worked with succeeded or failed.

  • Clear written communication. Much of this job is asynchronous and cross-team.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience in a regulated or audited environment (SOC 2, PCI, or a bank partnership), as the control owner rather than the auditor.

  • Time as the senior security voice somewhere without a security team, or without a CISO to escalate to.

  • Experience supporting employees and contractors across multiple countries, including device logistics and local employment platforms.

  • Experience at a company that grew quickly enough that you had to replace your own early processes.

  • Experience introducing AI tooling internally in a way that was actually adopted and actually governed.

Interested? We'd love to hear from you

At Flex, we value passion, determination, and honesty. Even if you don't fully match the job specifics, we encourage you to apply. Unusual career paths and unique skills can help you stand out. We believe diversity drives our success. Join us at jobs@flex.one

Flex is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital or family status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation at any point in the process, tell us and we'll sort it out.

Compensation

Final compensation within this range will be based on experience, qualifications, and interview performance. This position is also eligible for equity compensation. Flex offers medical, dental and vision insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Additional Information

Why Join Us

Build something generational — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners.

Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.

Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.

True ownership — Small teams, high trust, real accountability.

Founder-level exposure — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors.

High bar, high taste — Move fast without cutting corners.

Elite peers — People here are builders, not tourists.

Real upside — Meaningful equity if you help build something big.

jobs.title: Venture Development | AI Engineering - Internship
jobs.description:
Venture Development | AI Engineering - Internship

Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

Omniwatt Energy is Enpal’s electricity division, making clean energy accessible to every household—from Germany’s most affordable electricity rates to smart energy solutions that optimally integrate generation, storage, and consumption.

With ambitious growth targets and a rapidly expanding customer base, we are building a team that is actively shaping the German energy market. In doing so, we combine startup agility with the scale of a market leader—across all areas, from operations and technology to finance, customer support, and product development.

What you’ll do

  • You build AI solutions that streamline our customer ticket inflow, from automated resolution to smart routing and agent assistance

  • You work with Customer Service and other teams to identify high-impact use cases and translate them into working solutions

  • You take ownership end-to-end, from scoping the business case and aligning with stakeholders to hands-on implementation and measuring impact

  • You use a modern agentic stack to iterate rapidly, going from first prototype to deployment in a few days

 
 

What you’ll bring

  • You are enrolled in or have completed a technical university program such as engineering, mathematics, computer science, or related

  • You think in business impact and want ownership of the full problem, not just the technical part

  • You have hands-on experience building and evaluating agentic tools; experience with classical ML and statistical modeling is also valuable

  • You understand the fundamentals behind modern AI (e.g. attention mechanism) and can weigh technical trade-offs

  • You think in systems and understand how components like APIs and databases fit together; you can reason about code, perfect syntax is not required

  • You communicate clearly with non-technical colleagues and enjoy working in a business-driven team

 

Are you interested even if you don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential—regardless of whether your experience meets every single requirement. ☀️

 

What we offer

  • Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition.

  • The sun shines all over the world - At Enpal, you'll work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities.

  • The ideal setup for your focus - We are convinced that excellent results are achieved when the conditions are right. That's why we rely on a hybrid working concept that gives you the freedom to always work in the way that best suits your tasks.

  • Grown-up business & startup spirit - In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain, you'll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and table tennis to stocked beverage fridges and barista coffee.

  • The energy transition can only be achieved together - At Enpal, you can expect legendary team spirit and unforgettable team events.

  • Make your home smart – Sustainability starts at your doorstep. As part of our team, you’ll benefit from a permanent 25% discount on the entire Bosch Smart Home product range – for an even more efficient and connected home.

  • Your extra boost - 20 vacation days + one additional day off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve, discounted membership at Wellhub, and corporate benefits. Everything you need to help you achieve a good work-life balance.

Du arbeitest technisch an unseren dezentralen Batteriespeichern im Utility-Scale-Bereich (2 MW bis 10 MW), von der Auslegung bis zur Inbetriebnahme und Übergabe an den Betrieb.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Technische Auslegung: Du verantwortest die elektrotechnische Auslegung und Systemarchitektur der Speicheranlagen sowie die technischen Schnittstellen zwischen den Komponenten.

  • Netzintegration und Genehmigungen: Du erstellst die technischen Unterlagen für Netzanschluss- und Genehmigungsverfahren und stimmst dich eigenständig mit Netzbetreibern ab.

Konstrukteur / Produktentwickler (m/w/d)

Bei Wahtari nScan bringen wir Maschinen das Sehen bei – und erobern damit Branche für Branche. Wir entwickeln KI-gestützte Inspektionssysteme für die industrielle Qualitätssicherung und machen dabei alles selbst: Kamera und Beleuchtung abgestimmt auf die Prüfaufgabe, Mechanik, eigene Auswerteeinheit und eigene KI-Software. Herzstück ist eine hochmodulare, KI-getriebene Plattform. Aus ihr entstehen neue Produkte nicht in Jahren, sondern in wenigen Monaten.

Mit nScan prüfen wir Glasflaschen in der Getränkeabfüllung, mit nLine Kabel, Drähte, Schläuche und Rohre im 360-Grad-Blick direkt in der Extrusion, mit nTire Reifen von der DOT-Code-Erkennung bis zur Endprüfung. Dazu kommen Lösungen für Lebensmittel, Automobil, Elektronik, Medizintechnik und Maschinenbau – oft genau dort, wo andere Anbieter an ihre Grenzen stoßen. Wir arbeiten an dem, was in der Industrie gerade erst beginnt und bei uns längst Alltag ist.

Aufgabenbereich

Trockene Konstruktion nach Lastenheft war gestern. Bei uns entwickelst du Produkte mit echter Verantwortung, hohem Tempo und jeder Menge Abwechslung.

  • Du verantwortest eigenständig die mechanische Entwicklung neuer Produkte und Module, von der ersten Idee über Prototyp und Erprobung bis zur Serienreife

  • Kein Projekt gleicht dem anderen: Inspektionsstationen und Flaschenführung für die Getränkeabfüllung, Prüfköpfe mit 360°-Rundumsicht für die Extrusion, vibrationsarmes Reifenhandling oder Kamerasysteme für die Lebensmittelproduktion

  • Du baust unsere modulare Plattform mit aus: Gehäuse, Träger für Kamera und Beleuchtung sowie Komponenten für Schutz und Schaltschrank, die sich schnell an neue Branchen und Prüfaufgaben anpassen lassen

  • Als Product Owner verantwortest du eigene Produkte und Module, inklusive Anforderungsmanagement, Priorisierung und Planung der Roadmap

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Softwareentwicklung, KI und Vertrieb zusammen, bist bei Machbarkeitstests dabei und siehst bei Inbetriebnahmen, wie deine Konstruktion in der Produktion läuft

  • Du nutzt moderne Werkzeuge wie 3D-Druck und KI für schnelle Iterationen. Der Weg vom ersten Entwurf in CAD zum funktionierenden Prototyp ist bei uns kurz

  • Du sorgst für Lösungen, die sich gut fertigen lassen und im Kostenrahmen bleiben: Konstruktion in CAD, Zeichnungen und Stücklisten, Materialauswahl und passende Fertigungsverfahren

Leistungen

  • Eine Schlüsselposition mit echter Produktverantwortung – deine Entwicklungen gehen in wenigen Monaten an den Markt

  • Eine faire, transparente und leistungsorientierte Vergütung

  • Moderne Arbeitsausstattung mit Firmenlaptop und -handy

  • 30 Urlaubstage sowie zusätzliche halbe freie Tage an Heiligabend und Silvester

  • Monatlich 50 € steuerfreier Sachbezug (z.B. Wellpass, Deutschlandticket u.v.m.)

  • Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: mindestens 1 Tag Home-Office pro Woche

  • Kostenlose Getränke, Snacks sowie regelmäßige Firmenevents

Anforderungsprofil

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung (z. B. Techniker:in) in Maschinenbau, Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

  • Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Entwicklung elektromechanischer Systeme, idealerweise im Sondermaschinenbau

  • Du bist topfit in SolidWorks. Es ist dein tägliches Werkzeug, mit dem du schnell und sauber arbeitest

  • Du hast Lust auf Tempo und Abwechslung: Neue Branchen und Aufgaben sind für dich Ansporn, keine Störung

  • Du musst nicht alles können, aber du verstehst, wie KI, 3D-Druck und modulare Plattformen die Entwicklung verändern, und willst das aktiv nutzen

  • Freude am Ausprobieren: Du findest pragmatische Lösungen, auch wenn der Weg noch nicht ganz klar ist, und behältst dabei Fertigung und Kosten im Blick

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch, in Wort und Schrift

jobs.title: Leitung Technik und Vertrieb (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Leitung Technik und Vertrieb (m/w/d)

PantaTec ist ein innovatives Unternehmen im Bereich der Oberflächentechnik durch Strahlprozesse. Als Teil der starken Eggersmann Gruppe sind wir seit vielen Jahren in unserem Markt der erste Ansprechpartner, wenn es um Verbesserungen beim Strahlen geht.

Wir sind weltweit führend in der Entwicklung, Herstellung und Implementierung des mittlerweile sehr bekannten PantaTec-Verfahrens. Die Integration unserer Technologie in alle herkömmlichen Strahlanlagen spart Zeit und senkt die Produktionskosten deutlich. Die hohe Anerkennung bei unseren weltweiten Anwendern und unsere Alleinstellung haben wir uns über viele Jahre mit fundierter Expertise, hohem Engagement und absoluter Serviceorientierung erarbeitet.

Im Zuge einer geregelten Nachfolge suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt den geeigneten neuen Leiter Technik und Vertrieb (m/w/d). Bei entsprechender Entwicklung besteht perspektivisch die Möglichkeit, die Gesamtgeschäftsführung der PantaTec zu übernehmen.

Aufgaben

  • Leitung und Weiterentwicklung der Geschäftsaktivitäten mit dem bestehenden Team zur Erreichung unserer Wachstumsziele

  • Umfassende wirtschaftliche Organisation der Produktion aller PantaTec-Produkte

  • Planung und Umsetzung technologischer Weiterentwicklungen des PantaTec-Verfahrens

  • Gesamtverantwortung Vertrieb und Auftragsabwicklung aller Produkte und Dienstleistungen des PantaTec-Verfahrens

  • Führung und Weiterentwicklung der internationalen Vertriebspartner, durch regelmäßige Präsenz vor Ort

  • Repräsentation auf Messen und Tagungen (inkl. Vorträgen) sowie bei relevanten Verbänden und Institutionen

  • Professionelle Darstellung und praktische Einführung des PantaTec-Verfahrens beim Kunden, inkl. Analyse der Ausgangssituation, Zielstellung im Gesamtprozess und Begleitung der Produktion in der Einführungsphase

  • Organisation und Steuerung der praktischen Implementierung beim Kunden durch das Team

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (z.B. Maschinenbau) oder vergleichbare technische Ausbildung bzw. Berufserfahrung

  • Erfolgreich im technischen Vertrieb, idealerweise in der Oberflächentechnik oder Metallverarbeitung

  • Erfahrung in der Analyse und Optimierung von Kundenprozessen sowie in der Einführung technischer Verfahren beim Kunden

  • Nachweisbare Führungserfahrung

  • Hands-on-Mentalität und hohe operative Umsetzungsstärke (Bereitschaft, auch selbst beim Kunden vor Ort Tests/Einführungen durchzuführen)

  • Solide betriebswirtschaftliche bzw. kaufmännische Kenntnisse

  • Sicherer Umgang mit ERP-Systemen sowie mit kennzahlenbasierter Steuerung (Forecast, Pipeline-Management, Produktionsplanung)

  • Deutsch- und Englisch verhandlungssicher, weitere Fremdsprache von Vorteil

Benefits

  • Anspruchsvolle Führungsaufgabe im familiären Team mit flachen Hierarchien

  • Technologische Alleinstellung mit hohem Wachstumspotenzial

  • Attraktive Möglichkeit auch für den nächsten Karriereschritt

  • Fundierte Einarbeitung mit Begleitung durch den bisherigen Stelleninhaber

  • Attraktive Vergütung

  • Dienstfahrzeug, auch zur Privatnutzung

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

Wenn wir Ihr Interesse geweckt haben, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung (Lebenslauf und Zeugnisse). Ein zusätzliches Anschreiben ist wünschenswert.

jobs.title: Junior Account Manager
jobs.description:
Junior Account Manager

Lumiform ist eine spezialisierte Software, mit der Frontline-Teams Inspektionen, Audits und Checklisten skalierbar über viele Standorte hinweg durchführen. Gegründet 2019 in Berlin, hauptsächlich für europäische Unternehmen gebaut. Unternehmen wie EDEKA, AmRest, Virgin Media und Nordsee sowie Prüf-, Inspektions- und Zertifizierungsgesellschaften setzen auf Lumiform (4,6 von 5 auf G2).

Jährlich laufen über unsere Plattform Millionen von Prüfungen. Jede einzelne macht einen Arbeitsplatz sicherer, einen Prozess effizienter oder ein Produkt oder einen Service besser. Wenn du mit deiner Arbeit einen Unterschied in der Gesellschaft machen möchtest, dann arbeitest du hier an einem Produkt, das genau das jeden Tag tut.

Über die Rolle

Das ist eine Rolle für jemanden, der den nächsten Schritt gehen will. Du bringst bereits 1 bis 2 Jahre Customer Success mit und willst jetzt echte Verantwortung: dein eigenes Portfolio aus namhaften Enterprise-Kunden, das dir gehört und das du weiterentwickelst.

Deine zentrale Kennzahl ist die Net Revenue Retention deines Portfolios. Das heißt, du denkst kommerziell und erkennst Wachstumspotenziale, kannst aber genauso souverän deeskalieren, kritische Situationen drehen und Churn verhindern, bevor er entsteht. Du bekommst kein „Startpaket" aus kalten Leads, sondern ein starkes Bestandsportfolio mit starken Marken, das nur darauf wartet, ausgebaut zu werden.

Aufgaben

  • Ownership deines Portfolios: Du verantwortest ein eigenes Book of Business aus namhaften Enterprise-Kunden, treibst es proaktiv statt auf Anfragen oder schlechte Health-Scores zu warten, und entwickelst es strategisch weiter.

  • Net Revenue Retention steigern: Du treibst Renewals, erkennst Expansion-Potenziale (zusätzliche Use Cases, Standorte, neue Buying Center) und machst aus zufriedenen Kunden wachsende Accounts.

  • Strategischer Sparringspartner auf Entscheider-Ebene: Du erarbeitest dir Zugang zu den relevanten Stakeholdern, führst strategische Account-Reviews und wirst zum Trusted Advisor deiner Kunden.

  • Deeskalation und Churn-Prävention: Du erkennst Risiken früh, führst kritische Gespräche souverän und drehst gefährdete Accounts, bevor sie kippen.

  • Onboarding, Aktivierung und Schulungen: Du führst neue Teams erfolgreich ein, leitest Workshops und sorgst dafür, dass deine Kunden das volle Potenzial der Software ausschöpfen.

  • Produkt und Zusammenarbeit: Du bündelst Kundenfeedback strukturiert fürs Produktteam und arbeitest eng mit Sales, Marketing und Produkt zusammen.

Qualifikation

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Du bringst 1 bis 2 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Customer-Success, Account Management oder Vertrieb mit, idealerweise im SaaS-Umfeld, und willst jetzt den nächsten Schritt mit mehr Verantwortung gehen.

  • Du hast ein kommerzielles Gespür: Du erkennst Expansions- und Wachstumschancen in deinem Portfolio und gehst aktiv auf sie zu.

  • Du kannst deeskalieren: Auch in kritischen Situationen bleibst du souverän, findest Lösungen und hältst Kunden.Kommunikation ist eine deiner Stärken. Du gehst selbstständig in Gespräche, auch auf Entscheider-Ebene, und bleibst dran, bis der Termin steht.

  • Du verstehst technische Konzepte und kannst sie verständlich erklären.

  • Du denkst strategisch, planst vorausschauend und arbeitest gerne im Team.

Benefits

  • Ein eigenes Bestandsportfolio aus etablierten Kunden, das du eigenverantwortlich weiterentwickelst, mit klarem Weg zu größeren und strategischeren Accounts.

  • Neben deinem Fixgehalt eine variable Komponente mit Umsatzbeteiligung, wenn du dein Portfolio in neue Buying Center hinein ausbaust (horizontale Expansion).

  • Eine internationale Kundenbasis und die Chance, mit starken Brands auf Enterprise-Niveau zu arbeiten.

  • Ein Produkt mit echtem Purpose: Millionen von Prüfungen pro Jahr, die Arbeitsplätze sicherer und effizienter und Produkte und Services besser machen.

  • Modernes Büro im Herzen von Berlin-Mitte (Chausseestraße).

  • Investition in deine Zukunft mit einem jährlichen Lernbudget von 500€.

  • Zusätzliche finanzielle Anreize: monatlicher Sachbezug von 50€ oder Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft.

  • Kostenlose Verpflegung: jederzeit guter Kaffee, Tee, Schorlen, frisches Obst sowie Bier oder Wein.

  • Flexibilität und Balance mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Home-Office-Möglichkeiten.

  • Ein internationales Team mit flachen Hierarchien und offenem Feedback, in dem du viel Verantwortung übernehmen kannst.

Wenn das nach dir klingt, dann lass uns sprechen. Wenn du bereit bist, mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen, dein eigenes Portfolio starker Kunden aufzubauen und an einem Produkt zu arbeiten, das täglich einen echten Unterschied macht, freuen wir uns auf dich.

Lebenslauf oder LinkedIn-Profil genügt, ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht.

Unser Hiring-Prozess:

  1. Interview mit HR (30 Minuten)

  2. Interview mit unserem Head of Customer Success (30 Minuten)

  3. Challenge (wird dir vorab zugesendet, damit du dich in Ruhe vorbereiten kannst)

  4. Referenzgespräch (als letzten Schritt sprechen wir mit einer Referenz von dir)

jobs.title: VA Virtuelle Assistenz für den Antragsservice (m/w/d) | 100 % Remote | 2-4 Std. täglich
jobs.description:
VA Virtuelle Assistenz für den Antragsservice (m/w/d) | 100 % Remote | 2-4 Std. täglich

Du kannst gut organisieren, kommunizierst gerne mit Kunden und bleibst dran, bis offene Fragen geklärt sind? Du behältst auch bei mehreren laufenden Vorgängen den Überblick und bringst Struktur in komplexe Abläufe? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen!

Für unser Weiterbildungsprojekt suchen wir Unterstützung auf selbstständiger Freelancer-Basis – vollständig remote.

🎓 Das Projekt: Unternehmen bei der Mitarbeiterweiterbildung unterstützen

Wir begleiten Unternehmen bei der Beantragung von Förderungen für die Weiterbildung ihrer Mitarbeitenden bei der Agentur für Arbeit.

Unser Antragsservice unterstützt die Unternehmen dabei, den organisatorischen Ablauf zu bewältigen, erforderliche Unterlagen zusammenzustellen und die nächsten Schritte im Blick zu behalten. Dafür braucht es eine verlässliche Kundenbetreuung und eine gut koordinierte Zusammenarbeit zwischen allen Beteiligten.

Deine Rolle: Antragsbegleitung & Kundenkoordination

Nach der Übergabe durch unser Sales-Team übernimmst du die Betreuung der Unternehmen. Du koordinierst das Onboarding, begleitest die Antragstellung und hältst offene Unterlagen, Rückmeldungen und nächste Schritte nach.

Dabei bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson für organisatorische Fragen und die Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, unserem Team, dem Bildungsinstitut und den Dozenten. Du sorgst dafür, dass Informationen zusammenlaufen, Zuständigkeiten klar sind und Vorgänge strukturiert weiterbearbeitet werden.

Aufgaben

🤝 Kundenmanagement & Antragsbegleitung

  • Du übernimmst neue Unternehmenskunden nach der Übergabe durch Sales und stellst den ersten Kontakt her.

  • Du führst das Kunden-Onboarding durch und erläuterst den organisatorischen Ablauf sowie die nächsten Schritte.

  • Du begleitest die Unternehmen bei der Antragstellung zur Förderung ihrer Mitarbeiterweiterbildung bei der Agentur für Arbeit.

  • Du unterstützt dabei, die für den jeweiligen Antrag benötigten Informationen und Unterlagen zusammenzutragen.

  • Du hältst ausstehende Dokumente und Rückmeldungen nach und betreust offene Kundenfälle durch regelmäßige Follow-ups.

  • Du hältst die Kunden über den aktuellen Stand und anstehende Aufgaben auf dem Laufenden.

⚙️ Operative Projektkoordination

  • Du stimmst dich mit dem Bildungsinstitut, den Dozenten und weiteren Ansprechpartnern ab.

  • Du koordinierst laufende Abläufe und klärst offene organisatorische Fragen.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass relevante Informationen rechtzeitig bei den zuständigen Personen ankommen.

  • Du erkennst frühzeitig, wenn Vorgänge ins Stocken geraten, und stößt die notwendigen nächsten Schritte an.

  • Du stellst eine klare und nachvollziehbare Kommunikation zwischen allen Beteiligten sicher.

📋 CRM & Prozessmanagement

  • Du pflegst die Kundenpipeline und hältst alle relevanten Angaben im CRM aktuell.

  • Du dokumentierst Kundenstatus, Gesprächsergebnisse, offene Aufgaben und nächste Schritte.

  • Du hältst Zuständigkeiten, Termine und Wiedervorlagen nachvollziehbar fest.

  • Du priorisierst laufende Vorgänge und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Kundenfällen den Überblick.

  • Du erkennst wiederkehrende Hindernisse und bringst konkrete Vorschläge zur Verbesserung der Abläufe ein.

Qualifikation

🎯 Verantwortung übernehmen

Du verschickst nicht nur eine Anfrage und hakst die Aufgabe ab. Du behältst im Blick, ob eine Rückmeldung eingeht und wie es anschließend weitergeht. Fehlen Informationen oder ist eine Zuständigkeit unklar, gehst du dem Thema nach.

🗂️ Eigenständig organisieren

Du strukturierst deine Aufgaben selbstständig, setzt sinnvolle Prioritäten und betreust mehrere Vorgänge parallel. Wenn sich Verzögerungen oder Probleme abzeichnen, kommunizierst du sie frühzeitig.

💬 Verständlich und verbindlich kommunizieren

Du kannst mehrstufige Abläufe verständlich erklären und gehst auf unterschiedliche Ansprechpartner professionell ein. Du bleibst freundlich und serviceorientiert – auch wenn du mehrfach nachfassen musst.

📝 Sorgfältig dokumentieren

Du arbeitest genau und hältst Informationen so fest, dass der aktuelle Stand eines Vorgangs jederzeit nachvollziehbar ist. Mit Kundeninformationen und Unterlagen gehst du verantwortungsbewusst um.

💡 Mitdenken und Lösungen finden

Du arbeitest dich gerne in neue Themen ein, erkennst offene Punkte und bringst Lösungsvorschläge mit. Dein Ziel ist nicht nur, Aufgaben zu erledigen, sondern Abläufe zuverlässig voranzubringen.

Must-haves

  • Erfahrung in Kundenbetreuung, Sachbearbeitung oder Projektkoordination: Du hast bereits Kunden betreut, administrative Vorgänge bearbeitet oder mehrere Beteiligte miteinander koordiniert.

  • Organisationstalent: Du kannst mehrere Kundenfälle parallel strukturieren, priorisieren und konsequent nachverfolgen.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du kommunizierst telefonisch und schriftlich freundlich, klar und verbindlich.

  • Digitale Arbeitsweise: Du gehst sicher mit gängigen Office-Anwendungen um und findest dich schnell in CRM-Systemen und digitalen Tools zurecht.

  • Sorgfalt und Zuverlässigkeit: Du dokumentierst nachvollziehbar, behältst Termine im Blick und hältst Vereinbarungen ein.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse: Du kannst auch erklärungsbedürftige Sachverhalte mündlich und schriftlich sicher vermitteln.

  • Selbstständige Arbeitsweise: Du organisierst deine Tätigkeit eigenverantwortlich und bringst die Voraussetzungen für eine Zusammenarbeit auf Freelancer-Basis mit.

Das ist zusätzlich hilfreich

  • Erfahrung mit Förderanträgen, Antragsservices oder administrativen Abläufen im Weiterbildungsbereich.

  • Berührungspunkte mit der Agentur für Arbeit oder anderen Förderstellen.

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Bildungsträgern und Unternehmenskunden.

  • Routine im Umgang mit dokumentenintensiven und mehrstufigen Prozessen.

Was dich in der Zusammenarbeit erwartet

🌍 100% remote

Du unterstützt das Projekt vollständig remote. Kommunikation, Dokumentation und Abstimmung erfolgen digital.

Zusammenarbeit auf Freelancer-Basis

Du bringst deine Erfahrung im Rahmen einer selbstständigen Zusammenarbeit in das Projekt ein.

Verantwortung für eigene Kundenfälle

Du begleitest Unternehmen nach der Sales-Übergabe durch das Onboarding und die weiteren organisatorischen Schritte der Antragstellung.

Eine vielseitige Schnittstellenrolle

Du verbindest Kundenkontakt, Antragsbegleitung und Projektkoordination und arbeitest mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartnern zusammen.

Raum für deine Erfahrung

Du kannst Vorschläge einbringen, um Abläufe übersichtlicher, die Kommunikation klarer und die Bearbeitung von Kundenfällen effizienter zu gestalten.

🚀 Bereit, Unternehmen auf dem Weg zur Weiterbildung zu begleiten?

Du arbeitest strukturiert, kommunizierst verbindlich und hast Freude daran, offene Vorgänge voranzubringen? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf oder dein Freelancer-Profil und einen kurzen Einblick in deine bisherigen Erfahrungen in der Kundenbetreuung, Antragsbegleitung oder Projektkoordination.

jobs.description:
