jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description:
Business Development Manager The opportunity

Total Delivery Pharma is growing, and we are looking for a commercially ambitious Business Development Manager to help us reach more organisations across the pharmaceutical and wider life-sciences sectors.

This is an opportunity to take real ownership of business development within a specialist consultancy. You will have an established CRM and leads to work from, alongside the freedom to develop new relationships, test new approaches and build a strong pipeline of your own.

We are not looking for someone who only books meetings and hands opportunities over. We want somebody who enjoys opening doors, understanding what matters to a prospective client and staying with the opportunity through discovery, proposal, negotiation and decision.

About TDP

TDP provides pharmaceutical quality, compliance and regulatory consultancy to clients in the UK and internationally. Our services include QP and RP support, GxP auditing, regulatory affairs, CMC and MS&T, batch review, compliance remediation, training, due diligence and outsourced quality and regulatory functions.

Our clients come to us when they need experienced, practical support with important and often time-sensitive challenges. You do not need to be a technical consultant, but you will need the curiosity and confidence to learn our services, ask strong questions and communicate their commercial value clearly.

What you will do

  • Use HubSpot to identify, prioritise and develop leads and target accounts.
  • Create new opportunities through thoughtful outreach, referrals, networking, partnerships, events and inbound enquiries.
  • Lead discovery conversations and understand the client's need, urgency, stakeholders, budget, decision process and timescale.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers across pharmaceutical and life-sciences organisations.
  • Position TDP's services clearly and turn technical capability into relevant commercial value.
  • Qualify opportunities properly and focus time on work with a genuine route to decision.
  • Coordinate the input needed to develop clear, commercially sound proposals while retaining ownership of the client relationship.
  • Present proposals, manage follow-up, handle objections and negotiate within agreed authority.
  • Maintain a clean and accurate pipeline, with clear next steps and reliable forecasts.
  • Support a structured handover when work is won so the client experience remains strong from sale into delivery.


What we are looking for

  • A proven track record in outbound B2B business development or consultative service sales.
  • Experience progressing opportunities beyond an introductory meeting and contributing directly to a commercial decision.
  • Confidence selling high-value or complex services to senior stakeholders.
  • Strong discovery, qualification, relationship-building, follow-up and negotiation skills.
  • Comfort using a CRM to manage activity, pipeline and forecasts. HubSpot experience would be particularly useful.
  • Commercial awareness, including an understanding of pricing, margin and the difference between activity and genuine progress.
  • The ability to learn a technical service offering and explain it in clear, practical language.
  • A self-starting and persistent approach, combined with sound judgement and honest forecasting.


Experience that would be helpful

Experience in pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical devices, scientific services, laboratories, CROs, CDMOs or another regulated professional-services market would be valuable, but it is not essential. We are equally interested in strong service-sales professionals who can show that they learn quickly, ask intelligent questions and take ownership of a complex commercial process.

What you will get

  • A supportive and collaborative workplace where people share knowledge and work together.
  • A visible role with meaningful ownership of your pipeline, relationships and results.
  • A company that is keen to encourage development and help its people succeed.
  • The opportunity to build your knowledge of the pharmaceutical and life-sciences sectors while developing as an independent seller of complex services.
  • Uncapped commission and clear scope to increase your earnings through performance.
  • Private healthcare, life insurance, income protection and a company pension.
  • Remote working, with opportunities to meet clients and represent TDP at relevant industry events.


Your development

We want the successful person to become confident and increasingly independent in the role. You will receive support while you learn TDP's services and market, with the expectation that you will progressively take ownership of discovery, qualification, proposals, negotiation and closing.

We will encourage you to build your capability, contribute ideas and shape how TDP approaches business development as the company grows. Success in this role should create scope for greater responsibility, stronger earnings and continued career development.

Compliance Analyst - Alternance (Contrat de 24 mois)

🦊 À propos de Green-Got :

Green-Got est une institution financière française qui permet à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance.

Nous construisons l’infrastructure financière du monde qui vient, au service de la transition écologique.

Depuis janvier 2026, Green-Got est un Établissement de Paiement agréé par l’ACPR, supervisé par la Banque de France. Nous proposons un compte de paiement associé à une carte, ainsi qu’une gamme de placements pour investir dans les entreprises de la transition.

La Compliance est au cœur de ce modèle : c’est le socle de notre crédibilité vis-à-vis de nos membres, du régulateur et de la mission que nous portons.

Lieu : Paris (75) + Télétravail partiel Contrat : Alternance Niveau : Master 1 Poste à pourvoir : Janvier - Février 2027

Chez Green-Got, la Compliance est un pilier stratégique. Nous voulons la faire évoluer vite, avec les bons outils, les bonnes personnes et une vraie culture de la donnée.

Nous recherchons un profil hybride, capable de concilier la rigueur du traitement opérationnel et la puissance de la data. Au-delà des acquis académiques, c’est la posture qui fera la différence : autonomie, initiative sincère et envie d’avancer dans un environnement qui bouge vite.

Tu es méthodique sur le fond et réactif dans l’exécution. Les deux à la fois.

Une mission au service de notre raison d’être

La transition écologique est notre mission principale : permettre à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance, et orienter nos placements vers les entreprises qui font avancer la transition. La Compliance rend cette mission crédible et durable.

Tes missions

Au sein d’une équipe Compliance à taille humaine (nous sommes 5 aujourd’hui), tu es en interface directe avec les équipes Customer Care, Produit, Tech, Data, nos partenaires et nos membres.

Nos missions vont évoluer avec notre offre et avec une année 2027 qui s’annonce très dynamique. Le descriptif de ce poste bougera donc certainement, mais l’objectif restera le même : rester conforme à nos obligations tout en faisant avancer l’entreprise.

Production et gestion des dossiers Compliance (80 %)

  • Traitement des dossiers KYC et de l’entrée en relation : tu analyses les dossiers, vérifies la cohérence des informations et prépares les décisions de validation ou de refus.

  • Vigilance sur les flux et les alertes : tu qualifies les alertes, identifies les situations à risque et proposes les mesures à prendre.

  • Déclarations de soupçon (TRACFIN) : tu participes à la préparation et à la transmission des déclarations, sous la supervision de l’équipe.

  • Relation avec les membres et les partenaires : tu réponds aux questions de conformité avec un discours clair, pédagogique et ferme.

  • Traçabilité : chaque action est documentée. Dans un environnement réglementé, ce qui n’est pas tracé n’a pas été fait.

Outils et amélioration continue (20 %)

  • Maîtrise de nos outils internes : tu utilises Notion au quotidien pour documenter, suivre et partager le travail de l’équipe. C’est un outil central de notre fonctionnement que tu dois maîtriser rapidement.

  • Automatisation : tu repères les tâches répétitives et proposes des solutions pour les réduire, en lien avec l’équipe Data & IA.

  • Veille et documentation : tu suis les évolutions réglementaires et contribues à maintenir nos procédures à jour.

Ta montée en compétences

Les premiers mois sont consacrés à une immersion forte dans la production. Nous te donnons un cadre clair pour gagner en autonomie :

  • Mois 1 : comprendre Green-Got, notre application et les fondamentaux de la Compliance.

  • Mois 2 : maîtriser les outils et les sujets opérationnels.

  • Mois 3 : être autonome sur les cas simples, continuer d’apprendre sur les cas complexes.

  • Mois 4 : être pleinement autonome sur l’opérationnel et contribuer aux projets de l’équipe.

Ton profil

Nous recherchons un esprit agile et curieux, prêt à grandir avec nous : quelqu’un de passionné par les enjeux réglementaires et par les sujets data et IA, qui veut voir l’impact concret de son travail sur une infrastructure financière que nous construisons avec conviction.

Tu as une vraie envie de travailler, d’avancer et d’évoluer. Tu es prêt à un rythme soutenu, car la charge de travail peut être importante.

  • Maturité et autonomie : tu avances sans attendre qu’on te guide pas à pas. Tu identifies les problèmes, tu proposes des solutions et tu prends en charge tes sujets jusqu’au bout.

  • Sens de l’initiative : ton rôle dépasse l’exécution. Tu questionnes, tu améliores, tu contribues.

  • Curiosité et débrouillardise : tu apprends vite, seul comme en équipe, et tu es à l’aise dans un environnement qui change souvent.

  • Niveau d’exigence : tu ne te contentes pas de l’à-peu-près. La précision est un réflexe.

  • Appétence pour l’IA et la data : tu utilises déjà ces outils pour travailler plus vite et mieux, et tu as envie d’aller plus loin. Ce n’est pas la mission principale du poste, mais c’est une compétence que nous attendons.

  • Intérêt pour la conformité : tu veux comprendre les mécanismes KYC, LCB-FT et RGPD, et t’y investir sur la durée.

  • Aisance rédactionnelle et relationnelle : tu sais expliquer une situation complexe simplement, à un membre comme à un collègue.

  • Esprit d’équipe : la Compliance se construit collectivement, le partage d’information fait partie de notre culture.

  • Formation : tu démarres un Master 1 (ou une année équivalente en école de commerce, d’ingénierie ou de droit), idéalement avec un ancrage en finance, risques, audit ou droit.

  • Anglais opérationnel, indispensable pour échanger avec l’équipe technique et nos partenaires.

  • Bonus : une première expérience ou un projet personnel qui te fait fier. Un lien à partager est le bienvenu.

Chez Green-Got, nous sommes rusés, responsables, nous recherchons constamment le progrès, nous allons vite et le collectif passe avant l’individu.

Ce que nous t'offrons

Avec notre agrément ACPR, nous construisons nos propres standards de Compliance, avec les personnes qui nous rejoignent maintenant.

  • Un rôle avec de vraies responsabilités : dès les premiers mois, tu portes tes sujets, et ton travail a un impact direct sur notre dispositif.

  • Un apprentissage de terrain : aux côtés d’une équipe qui transmet ses savoir-faire opérationnels, au contact de l’ensemble des équipes (Customer Care, Produit, Tech, Data).

  • Une équipe exigeante et soudée, qui sait aussi passer de bons moments ensemble.

  • Un environnement en forte croissance, où les profils les plus engagés progressent vite.

Le package

  • Cadre : alternance basée à Paris, minimum 4 jours au bureau par semaine.

  • Rémunération : selon la grille légale en vigueur (variable selon l’âge, le niveau de formation et le type de contrat).

  • Santé : mutuelle Alan.

  • Cohésion : une journée d’équipe chaque semestre.

Déroulement des entretiens

  • Envoie-nous ton CV, une courte présentation de toi, ton calendrier d’alternance et, si possible, le montant de tes frais d’inscription.

  • Nous t’appellerons rapidement pour faire connaissance, dès que ton profil aura retenu notre attention. Si ça matche, nous t'enverrons un Business Case à préparer.

  • Entretien en visio avec Justé (Compliance Manager) et un futur collègue pour analyser le Business Case, évaluer tes compétences et faire connaissance..

  • Échange de 15 min avec un autre membre de l’équipe pour le fit culturel.

  • Entretien avec Adèle (Head of Operations).

  • Entretien final avec Andréa (CEO).

Nous avons hâte de te rencontrer !

Ta montée en compétences

Les premiers mois sont consacrés à une immersion forte dans la production, pour bien comprendre nos process avant de les automatiser. Nous te donnons un cadre clair pour gagner en autonomie :

Nous recherchons un esprit agile et curieux, prêt à grandir avec nous. Quelqu’un qui a une véritable passion pour la data, la tech et les enjeux réglementaires, et qui veut voir l’impact concret de son travail sur une infrastructure financière que nous construisons avec conviction.

  • Autonomie et responsabilité réelle : tu avances avec assurance et respect de tes engagements. Tu identifies les problèmes, tu trouves des solutions et tu prends les rênes de tes sujets sans attendre qu’on te les confie.

  • Force de proposition et d’initiative : ton rôle dépasse l’exécution. Tu questionnes, tu améliores, tu contribues.

  • Rigueur et précision : dans un environnement réglementé, chaque action doit être tracée. Tu ne te contentes jamais de l’à-peu-près.

  • Aisance rédactionnelle, éducative et relationnelle : tu as une plume soignée et tu sais traduire une situation complexe en explications simples.

  • Goût pour la transmission : tu aimes partager tes méthodes et voir tes collègues progresser.

  • Esprit d’équipe : la Compliance se construit collectivement, et le partage d’information brise les silos.

  • Formation : tu démarres un Master 1 (ou une année équivalente en école d’ingénieurs, de commerce ou d’informatique), idéalement avec un ancrage en Data Science, IA, Statistiques, Économétrie ou Droit du numérique.

  • Anglais opérationnel : indispensable pour documenter ton travail et échanger avec l’équipe technique et nos partenaires.

  • Bonus : tu connais Notion, un outil de BI, ou tu as déjà mis les mains dans un projet IA appliqué. Un lien vers un projet qui te fait fier ? Nous adorons cela.

Avantages

Ce que nous t'offrons

Green-Got entre dans une nouvelle phase. Avec l'agrément ACPR, nous construisons nos propres standards de compliance - avec les personnes qui nous rejoignent maintenant.

La finance durable se construit avec les bons outils, les bonnes personnes, et une équipe qui sait ce qu'elle défend.

  • De vraies responsabilités : Dès les premiers mois, tu portes tes sujets. Tes scripts et tes analyses ont un impact direct sur notre dispositif de conformité.

  • Apprentissage : Aux côtés d'une équipe qui transmet ses savoirs opérationnels et en lien direct avec notre équipe Data & IA.

Le package

Déroulement des entretiens

Chez Lexroom, nous laissons les buzzwords de côté. Ici, vous construirez quelque chose de durable : une plateforme de confiance, une solide réputation et un nouveau standard pour le monde juridique.

Le poste
En tant que People Operations Specialist pour la France, vous serez l’interlocuteur de référence de nos équipes parisiennes. Profil recherché

IT Architect - Business Domain
jobs.description:
IT Architect - Business Domain

Hoe laat je een CRM, BPM, procesautomatisering, pensioenadministratie en maatwerk goed samenwerken? Hoe kunnen we AI en data concreet inzetten binnen het pensioendomein? Als onze IT Architect voor onze businessdomeinen vertaal je businessvragen naar concrete IT-oplossingen en praktisch advies. Je helpt teams en stakeholders om onderbouwde keuzes te maken over applicaties, platformen en integraties. Daarbij kijk je verder dan één systeem: je zorgt dat oplossingen werken in de praktijk én passen binnen de architectuur voor het pensioendomein. 

Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt bij het Architecture team binnen de afdeling Digital Strategy, Architecture & Innovation. Samen met collega-architecten ben je verantwoordelijk voor de architectuur van het totale pensioendomein. Jullie verbinden de behoeften van de pensioenbusiness met de ontwikkeling van het IT-landschap en bewaken gezamenlijk de samenhang en richting binnen het domein. Je werkt nauw samen met business-, change- en platformteams en leveranciers om architectuurkeuzes te vertalen naar uitvoerbare oplossingen.

Als IT architect voor het pensioendomein ligt je zwaartepunt bij applicatie-, platform- en integratiearchitectuur. Je overziet de samenhang tussen klantbediening, pensioenprocessen, data en technologie en maakt concreet wat een verandering vraagt van de betrokken systemen. Je werkterrein omvat CRM, BPM, portalen, pensioenadministratie, gegevensuitwisseling, marketing technologie en maatwerkapplicaties. Je bent geen architect voor één platform, maar adviseert over oplossingen over de hele keten vanuit het perspectief van de businessbehoefte binnen de kaders van onze IT platformdiensten. 
 
Je verantwoordelijkheden staan niet op zichzelf, maar maken deel uit van de gezamenlijke uitdagingen van de gehele architectuurafdeling. Vanuit je expertise draag je samen met je collega-architecten bij aan de volgende opgaven voor het totale domein: 
 
- Vertalen van businessbehoeften naar concrete architectuurproducten zoals applicatie- en integratieontwerpen en heldere ontwerpkeuzes. 
- Adviseren over de inzet van CRM, Pega BPM, AI platform en andere platformen voor klantinteractie, workflow, casemanagement en procesautomatisering. 
- Afwegen wanneer standaardfunctionaliteit, hergebruik, configuratie of maatwerk passend is, met aandacht voor kosten, complexiteit, beheerbaarheid en leveranciersafhankelijkheid door middel van het toepassen van onze architectuurprincipes. 
- Ontwerpen van de samenhang tussen applicaties, API’s, gegevensstromen en koppelingen, in samenwerking met data- en technologiearchitecten. 
- Uitwerken van doel- en transitiearchitecturen en praktische roadmaps, met oog voor bestaande systemen, technische schuld en lopende veranderingen. 
- Samen met collega-architecten bewaken van de samenhang over domeinen heen en vastleggen van belangrijke keuzes in begrijpelijke, bruikbare architectuurproducten. 


Wat vragen we van jou?

- Wo werk- en denkniveau. 
- Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een architectuurrol, met aantoonbare ervaring in het ontwerpen en begeleiden van IT-oplossingen. 
- Een stevige IT-basis en ervaring met enterprise-applicaties, CRM, workflow-, BPM- en AI en dataplatformen en maatwerkontwikkeling. 
- Ervaring met applicatie-integratie, API’s en gegevensstromen; je kunt technische ontwerpen doorgronden en hierover inhoudelijk adviseren. 
- Vermogen om businessvragen te vertalen naar uitvoerbare ontwerpen, concrete aanbevelingen en heldere afwegingen tussen oplossingsrichtingen. 
- Een praktische, verbindende werkwijze: je schakelt makkelijk tussen businessstakeholders, ontwikkelaars en leveranciers, maakt complexe keuzes begrijpelijk en wordt een teamspeler binnen het architectuurteam. 
- Ervaring met het vastleggen van architectuur en ontwerpbesluiten, bijvoorbeeld met ArchiMate en TOGAF of vergelijkbare methoden; bruikbaarheid staat voorop. 
- Ervaring met Pega BPM is een pré. 
- Ervaring binnen pensioenen, verzekeringen of andere gereguleerde sectoren is een pré. 

Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag.


Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.


In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een NS Business Card of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten.


Salaris per maand:
Op basis van cao schaal 17 HAY is de range € 5.991,23 tot € 7.988,31 op basis van 36 uur.

jobs.title: Workplace Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Workplace Support Specialist

About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As our Workplace Support Specialist, you'll make sure our (beautiful!) workplace works and take some of the logistical burden off our management team. That could mean ensuring board meetings go like clockwork, an offsite that people actually look forward to, meeting rooms that are ready to present in, and a warm welcome for every candidate, visitor and investor who walks through our door.

This role is part of the People & Culture team and is a mix of hospitality, logistics, and executive support. If you love making things just right for other people, if you spot the missing HDMI cable before anyone else, then read on…

What you'll do

Board and leadership support

  • Coordinate with board members (and their assistants) across several time zones, finding the monthly meeting slot that works when nobody thinks one exists.

  • Organise Board meetings end to end: scheduling, meeting room booking, travel and catering, ensuring the room is fully ready before anyone arrives. Support the Chief of Staff as she needs in preparation of these Board meetings.

  • Provide support for organising larger team events, Management Team offsites, and some travel support for the c-suite.

  • Take over managing the CEO's expenses, travel and scheduling those meetings that are really tricky to plan.

Workplace experience

  • Own meeting room management and keep our shared spaces working for everyone.

  • Keep the office looking good, whether that’s ordering office & Vrijmibo supplies, reporting a broken window, filing the printer with paper or tidying away coffee cups.

  • Test the AV and room set-up before important meetings, like Board meetings and company All Hands, so calls connect and screens that share first time.

  • Be the go-to person for daily office questions; working with People Specialist, Facilities Manager, the Building Manager to fix what needs fixing across locations.

  • Help the Facilities & People team plan and organise how we expand into neighbouring office spaces within the building.

Hospitality and first impressions

  • Welcome visitors, partners and investors to the building, and make their visit easy from arrival to departure.

  • Meet interview candidates at reception when the recruiter team is busy, put nervous interviewees at ease, and get them where they need to be on time.

  • Working with our People Partner in setting up new hire onboarding days.

What you'll bring

You'll need

  • 1+ years in an executive support, receptionist or office hospitality role.

  • A genuine hospitality mindset. You enjoy looking after people and it shows.

  • Meticulous attention to detail: you spot the double booking, the missing receipt and the wrong time zone.

  • Proactive in coming up with solutions, not just problems. You’re smart, pragmatic, hands on, and hard working.

  • Calm, confident organisation. You can juggle a board meeting, a visitor and a broken printer in the same hour, and still smile.

  • Discretion and sound judgement with confidential information.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

  • Comfortable with Google Workspace, calendar tools and Claude.

Nice to have

  • Experience coordinating board meetings or complex logistics.

  • Experience in a fast-growing start up or scale up.

  • BHV / first aid experience.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

AI Support Engineer - Toronto

About the Team

OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. We are building the very first post-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others, to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises.

About the Role

We’re looking for dedicated, experienced, and deeply curious individuals to help solve some of the most complex challenges faced by our customers while building the future of post-AGI support alongside us. In this role, you’ll work directly with customers through support tickets and live calls, troubleshooting high-impact issues and resolving novel, often ambiguous technical problems in one of the fastest-moving environments in technology. As AI adoption rapidly accelerates, the work you do will directly support mission-critical systems being built on OpenAI’s platform, serving as a critical line of defense for customers operating at massive scale.

Beyond resolving technical issues, you’ll help define what world-class support looks like in an AGI-driven future. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Operations to improve systems, reduce bugs, and elevate the customer experience, while leveraging automation, agents, and our own AI technology to transform how support operates at scale.

This Toronto-based role is currently remote and is expected to transition to an in-office arrangement.

In this role, you will:

  • Work directly with customers to troubleshoot and resolve their most complex technical issues, including API failures, integration challenges, authentication errors, and production incidents. Providing end-to-end ownership through debugging logs, analyzing system behavior, reproducing issues, and delivering expert guidance.

  • Become a trusted expert on OpenAI’s products and platform, serving as a go-to resource for complex technical issues.

  • Serve as a critical escalation point and line of defense for complex technical issues, partnering closely with customers and Engineering teams to troubleshoot, resolve, and proactively prevent recurring problems while leveraging scripting and emerging AI capabilities to improve internal tooling and automate operational workflows.

  • Take learnings from resolving customer issues and creating our approach to scaling these solutions, partnering with Product and Go-To-Market teams.

  • Drive operational excellence by identifying opportunities for automation and AI-powered workflows, implementing scalable improvements that increase team efficiency, reducing manual effort, and elevating the overall support experience.

  • Provide occasional holiday and weekend support on call coverage, as needed, to support business and customer needs.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have expert-level SaaS troubleshooting skills with the ability to rapidly understand new technologies and complex concepts.

  • Polished enterprise communication and are calm with high-stakes customers during live incident calls.

  • Proven experience building strong relationships with customers and cross-functional partners to drive resolution to complex issues.

  • Exceptional critical thinker and problem solver with the ability to clearly communicate complex technical issues to both customers and internal teams.

  • Thrive in ambiguity, adapt rapidly to change, continuously learn, and proactively seek opportunities for growth.

  • Bring a humble, team first mindset, a genuine eagerness to help others, and the curiosity to quickly learn whatever knowledge is needed to help both your teammates and our customers succeed.

  • Have a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, another relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.description:
Staff Solutions Architect - N.A.

Upbound is redefining how modern infrastructure is built for the Agentic AI Era. We’re the creators and primary maintainers of Crossplane, and we’re building the Intelligent Control Plane—a new platform layer that makes infrastructure programmable, autonomous, and composable.

Our mission is to power the AI-native enterprise with a foundational platform layer that helps teams provision, operate, and adapt infrastructure at scale—so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents. We partner with leading cloud providers, ISVs, and open-source communities to help organizations move faster with greater confidence.

Today, Upbound supports Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across 100+ countries. Crossplane has surpassed 100M+ downloads and is used by 1,000+ teams worldwide. We’re a Series B company backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital, and we’ve raised $69M to date. Learn more at upbound.io

As a Staff Solutions Architect at Upbound, you own the technical success of our customers. You are the primary driver of customer outcomes, from initial implementation through production adoption, ensuring customers achieve real business value with Crossplane and the Upbound platform. This is a deeply technical, hands-on role embedded in the post-sales motion, working closely with customers to deliver working solutions, not just guidance.

In this role, you will own:

Customer Technical Outcomes

  • Drive end-to-end technical success for a portfolio of enterprise customers, from post-sales handoff through production adoption.
  • Own the implementation of known Upbound use cases — control plane architectures, Upbound/Crossplane configurations, GitOps integration, platform engineering patterns — and ensure customers reach their target state.
  • Define and track technical milestones that map to customer business objectives and contract value.
  • Act as the primary technical escalation point when customers face blockers, coordinating engineering and product resources to resolve them.

Implementation & Architecture

  • Lead technical discovery to deeply understand customer environments, platform requirements, and target architecture.
  • Design and deliver Crossplane-based control plane architectures tailored to customer infrastructure and organizational context.
  • Build and maintain reference platforms and implementation accelerators that codify Upbound best practices and reduce time-to-value for common use cases.
  • Contribute Statements of Work that accurately scope implementation engagements.
  • Write code, fix bugs, and build scoped features within Upbound products, provider ecosystem, and Crossplane core where needed to unblock customers.

Technical Voice of the Customer

  • Represent customer technical needs internally to influence product roadmap and prioritization.
  • Partner with pre-sales SEs to ensure smooth, informed handoffs with full context on customer environment and expectations.
  • Identify expansion opportunities as customer technical maturity grows and new Upbound capabilities become relevant.

You are a good fit if you have:

  • Hands-on Kubernetes expertise — operators, controllers, or add-ons; production deployment and management experience.
  • Platform engineering or SRE background, with direct experience building or operating an Internal Developer Platform (IDP).
  • Deep familiarity with cloud-native tooling: CNCF ecosystem, IaC (Terraform/Pulumi), GitOps (Flux/ArgoCD), CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience across at least two major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure) at production scale.
  • Strong programming skills; Go is strongly preferred.
  • Proven track record of leading customers through complex technical implementations to successful, measurable outcomes.
  • Excellent communication skills — comfortable presenting architecture and trade-offs to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Able to manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously in a fast-moving startup environment.

It is a plus if:

  • Crossplane power user — contributions to core or the provider ecosystem are very appreciated [for many reasons]
  • Active Kubernetes community involvement: contributions, conference talks, technical writing, or open source maintainership.
  • CKA or CKAD certification.
  • Prior startup, familiarity with coding agents and distributed team experience.

#LI-REMOTE

Why Upbound?

At Upbound, you’ll help shape the systems and strategies that drive predictable, scalable growth in a product-led company embracing usage-based models. If you're excited to build from the ground up, work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and directly impact how revenue is generated and scaled—this is your seat at the table.

About Upbound

Upbound is pioneering infrastructure platforms for the Agentic AI Era, serving Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across more than 100 countries. The company empowers infrastructure and platform teams with Intelligent Control Planes - based on Kubernetes and Crossplane - that provision, operate, and adapt so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents. Upbound is the creator and primary maintainer of Crossplane, the popular open-source framework for building cloud-native control planes, with over 100 million downloads and adoption by more than 1,000 teams worldwide. A Series B startup backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital, Upbound has raised $69M to date. For more information, visit www.upbound.io.

jobs.description:
Sr. AI/ML Engineer (MXC)

Do work that matters.   

At AlertMedia, we help organizations protect their people, operations, and brand. Our modern Risk Intelligence and Response platform empowers teams to detect emerging threats, assess impact, and respond with confidence. We believe building resilience should be simpler—and it starts with bringing critical information and workflows together in one unified platform.

Our core values drive us in our important mission of keeping people safe & informed:  

  • We’re humans not robots 
  • Customers always come first 
  • We work better together 
  • Simplicity is our strength 
  • Our reputation is priceless 
  • Hard work pays off     

AlertMedia is looking for an innovative and hands-on Sr. AI/ML Engineer with a strong background in applied machine learning and data science to lead the evaluation, training, and integration of advanced AI and machine learning models across our product suite. In this role, you will help shape our AI strategy by identifying the most appropriate models for our use cases, optimizing their performance through fine-tuning and prompt engineering, and ensuring their responsible deployment within our platforms. You will have the opportunity to show who you are throughout our interview process; we don’t ask any trick questions or expect you to perform a whiteboard exercise. We want to see you shine by showing us work you are most proud of!   

Who you are:    

You are an applied AI and machine learning engineer with strong data science fundamentals, deeply curious about what's possible with large language models and practical machine learning applications.   • Familiarity with model evaluation best practices, including offline metrics, cross-validation, and A/B testing.  
  • Proficiency in Python and ML libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face).  
  • Experience working with Elasticsearch or other large-scale search and indexing platforms.

jobs.description:
Shopper & Trade Marketing Manager:in

Jobbeschreibung

Hey!

Wir sind vly – ein innovatives FoodTech-Startup aus Berlin, das die Lebensmittelindustrie revolutioniert. Unser Ziel: Gesunde, pflanzliche Milchalternativen, die nicht nur dir guttun sondern auch unserem Planeten. Nach jahrelanger Forschung haben wir Produkte entwickelt, die deutlich weniger Zucker und mehr Protein enthalten, mit Preisen ausgezeichnet wurden und deutschlandweit erhältlich sind – wie unsere Milchalternativen aus Erbsenprotein und den allerersten Joghurt aus Ackerbohnenprotein. Aber das soll erst der Anfang sein! Neben der ständigen Verbesserung unserer Produkte ist natürlich unsere Sichtbarkeit im Handel mit der wichtigsten Treiber für die Zukunft von vly. Hier beginnt dein nächster Schritt bei vly...

Deine Mission: Als Shopper & Trade Marketing Manager:in bist du die Brücke zwischen unserer Marke und dem Handel. Du sorgst dafür, dass vly maximale Aufmerksamkeit im Regal bekommt – durch überzeugende Argumente, aufmerksamkeitsstarke Materialien und aktivierende Maßnahmen, die unsere Produkte noch schneller aus dem Regal heraus verkaufen. Du berichtest an unsere Head of Marketing, arbeitest aber auch sehr eng mit Sales, Brand und Design zusammen und bist dabei eine der Schlüsselpersonen, die das große Bild von der Brand bis zur Regalplatzierung versteht.

Deine Rolle:

  • Du trägst zur Entwicklung unserer Trademarketing-Strategie für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz bei und bist für deren Umsetzung verantwortlich.
  • Du unterstützt unser KAM- und Field-Force-Team beim Entwickeln von überzeugenden Sell-in-Unterlagen und Category-Management-Argumenten für einschlägige LEH-Kunden.
  • Du planst und koordinierst POS-Maßnahmen: Displayaktionen, Zweitplatzierungen und In-Store-Aktivierungen (z.B. Gewinnspiele).
  • Du analysierst Marktdaten (Nielsen, GfK, interne Sell-out-Daten) und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.
  • Du entwickelst starke Trade Marketing Materialien (z.B. Sales Folder, Präsentationen, Wobbler) in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Brand, Design und Sales.
  • Du organisierst und standardisierst unseren Auftritt bei Trade Messen und Verkostungen in Supermärkten.
  • Du beobachtest den Wettbewerb sowie die Regalentwicklung und bringst proaktiv Impulse, die unsere Sichtbarkeit und den Impact am POS erhöhen.
  • Du bist das Verbindungsstück zwischen Marketing, KAM und Field Force mit dem Ziel, effektive Maßnahmen auf Kundenbedürfnisse zuzuschneiden.

Deine Benefits:

  • Purpose: Es ist absolut essenziell, dass sich das Lebensmittelsystem zum Besseren verändert. Deine Rolle trägt direkt dazu bei, es gesünder und nachhaltiger zu machen.
  • Impact vom ersten Tag: Du baust Trade Marketing bei vly auf – keine fertige Struktur, die du übernimmst, sondern echte Ownership.
  • Echtes Startup Teamgefühl: Ein kreatives und motiviertes Team, das zusammenhält – inklusive regelmäßiger vly-Day- und Offsite-Events.
  • Teamlunch: Unser Highlight - jeden Tag frisch gekochtes Lunch von unserer eigenen vly-Köchin!
  • Mobilität und Company Fitness: Zuschuss sowohl zum BVG / Deutschland-Ticket sowie zu deiner USC Mitgliedschaft.
  • Moderne Ausstattung & Coaching: Wir statten dich mit Mac/Windows-Equipment aus und bieten individuelle Coaching-Möglichkeiten.
  • FoodTech-Community: Sei Teil einer wachsenden Bewegung, mit spannenden Events und Networking-Möglichkeiten.
  • vly-Flatrate: Genieße so viel vly, wie du willst!

Stellenanforderungen

Dein Profil:

  • Hands-on Erfahrung: Du hast 4+ Jahre Berufserfahrung im Trade Marketing oder Category Management in einer FMCG-Brand oder im LEH-Umfeld.
  • Expertise: Du hast bereits Trade Marketing Konzepte eigenverantwortlich entwickelt und umgesetzt. Displayaktionen, Sonderplatzierungen und kreative Materialien sind für dich kein Neuland.
  • Netzwerk: Du hast ein Netzwerk von einschlägigen Herstellern von Trade Materialien und kennst die Produktionsprozesse vom Design-Briefing bis zum Versand.
  • Daten sind deine Grundlage: Du kannst Nielsen-Daten und interne Daten lesen, interpretieren und in überzeugende Storys für den Handel übersetzen.
  • Mindset: Du denkst unternehmerisch und packst an – du wartest nicht, bis jemand eine Vorlage für dich erstellt.
  • Struktur: Du bist strukturiert, verlässlich und behältst auch mit mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick.
  • Stakeholder: Du arbeitest gerne cross-funktional und kannst zwischen Sales, Marketing und externen Partnern vermitteln.
  • Verfügbarkeit: Du wohnst in Berlin und kannst regelmäßig (mind. 50% der wöchentlichen Zeit) im Büro sein.
  • Sprache: Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprache-Level und sehr gutes Englisch.

Klingt das nach einer Stelle, in der du etwas bewegen kannst und möchtest? Dann meld’ dich bei uns! Wir freuen uns schon auf ein Gespräch mit dir!

jobs.title: Praktikant Front Office (m/w/d)
Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
Lead Product Manager

About ExTrac

ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.

Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of major areas of ExTrac's AI-driven platform. Reporting into ExTrac's Head of Product, you will work closely with the design, engineering, research and analysis, and customer success teams to take significant product areas from ambiguity to shipped: leading discovery, defining requirements, driving delivery, and bringing order to the tools and processes that product work runs on.

ExTrac is a founder-led, vision-led company. This role : owning prioritisation within your product areas, keeping stakeholders aligned as plans evolve, and acting as a multiplier for product craft across the teams you work with.

What the job involves

Roadmap ownership

  • Own the roadmap for our core SaaS platform, translating the strategy set by ExTrac's founders and product leadership into a clear, sequenced, deliverable plan.

  • Own prioritisation within your area, balancing user needs, business goals, BD requirements, and specific client requirements, and defending those calls with evidence and reasoning.

  • Stay across all work in flight within your areas: who is working on what, expected timelines, and what is paused, delayed, or blocked.

  • Stay close to industry trends and competitor products, especially in AI and B2B SaaS, and feed that intelligence into roadmap discussions.

Discovery and definition

  • Lead feature development from concept to delivery, with clear and actionable PRDs.

  • Conduct investigations, gather information, and assess feasibility.

  • Keep all stakeholders aligned and up to date as plans and requirements evolve.

Product operations and delivery

  • Bring order to the tools and workflows that product development runs on (issue tracking, documentation, sprint and delivery processes), so they reflect how we actually work and scale as we grow.

  • Own the interface between product management and delivery management within your areas: sequencing, dependencies, and visible progress against commitments.

  • Establish the working hygiene (clearly structured initiatives, honest status, well-maintained backlogs) that lets engineering, design, and leadership trust the plan.

Technical and data judgement

  • Apply technical judgement to guide product development within your areas, especially around AI/ML model integration, data processing, and analytics.

  • Translate complex technical solutions into clear product decisions and communicate the trade-offs to stakeholders.

  • Use behavioural data and analytics as a key input to decisions and prioritisation, alongside domain expertise and conviction.

Research, validation and data

  • Use usage analytics and behavioural data to track adoption and surface friction within your product areas, and build workflows to analyse and act on it.

  • Favour observation over interrogation: watching people work usually tells you more than asking them what they want.

  • Use user research and testing for what it does well, validating legibility, usability, and workflow fit. This evaluative feedback should carry real weight and is often decisive; workflow fit deserves particular care given our high-stakes users.

  • Recognise the limits of research when it comes to direction: what we should build is synthesised from deep expertise across intelligence analysis, subject matter, data science, engineering, and design.

  • For bets that cannot be validated up front, apply post-deployment discipline: define success metrics and evaluation timelines, commit in advance to the evidence that would change your mind, and assess honestly whether the bet is paying off.

  • Organise and run internal alpha and beta testing, plus external testing where possible; partner with Customer Success to recruit proxy users and to surface the friction, workflow issues, and pain points that feed into execution and prioritisation.

Working with AI: Co-Analyst

  • Partner closely with the AI team to ensure AI features are genuinely useful, understandable, and aligned with what our users need.

  • Help track and document the specific behaviours and styles built into Co-Analyst responses.

  • Support the work to adapt Co-Analyst to the needs of specific external organisations.

Raising the bar for product practice

  • Contribute to the product function's processes, roadmapping systems, and prioritisation frameworks, and model their consistent use.

  • Help define and track the metrics that indicate product success, adoption, and customer satisfaction within your areas.

jobs.description:
Commercial Strategy & Growth Lead

Powering Great Work

We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. That's Powering Great Work, and it's why every team here exists:

🔧 Trades spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business

🏠 Homeowners get a trusted trade, first time, every time

🚀 We get to build products that change homes and lives across the country

As our Commercial Strategy & Growth Lead, you'll be hands-on, owning pricing, retention and marketplace growth initiatives from idea to result. Which trades should pay what, and where? Why do members churn? How do we ensure our trades get value from our product? You'll find questions like these in our data, answer them yourself and see the answer through to launch. It's a broad remit with real ownership over how we price, how we grow our member base and how we use data, experimentation and AI to run a smarter commercial operation.

The job, unfiltered:

  • Spot the opportunity yourself, size it, build the business case and work with cross-functional teams (Product, CRM, Sales, Retention) to deliver it.

  • Run experiments to grow revenue: test pricing logic, drive upsell, and increase product attachment, then use the results to shape how our pricing model evolves.

  • Tackle churn: look at the health of the member lifecycle, find where value is leaking (including why some members leave early) and lead the work to fix it.

  • Work out how supply shapes revenue: understand what happens to leads, conversion and member value when a trade or area runs short of tradespeople, and recommend what we do about it.

  • Build the tracking, benchmarking and alerting that keep our pricing sharp, using AI and automation where they genuinely help us move faster.

  • Do the doing. You'll work across several programmes at once and move things forward with others, not just write the strategy.

In your first six months, you could ship a pricing test, own a churn intervention programme or build an AI-assisted alerting tool.

The fit:

  • You find and own the work: an opportunity you spotted without being asked, sized, built the case for and saw through to a number.

  • You’re comfortable with SQL, and turn messy datasets into clear recommendations that drive decisions and action.

  • You've made a recommendation that a senior person acted on, and you can explain it in a few clear sentences.

  • You think commercially about pricing, retention and member value, and the trade-offs between volume, churn and conversion.

  • You might be coming from marketplace supply or category, strategy and operations or BizOps, consulting then industry, subscription propositions, or retail pricing and promotions. You don't need a revenue or pricing job title.

Technical Product Manager

Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

The Role

You’ll own the product roadmap for Dex. That covers our candidate product, our client product, our internal tools and the ML systems behind all of them.

Our team moves fast. Your job is to point that speed at the right problems and keep a clear lookahead: what’s next, and what’s coming over the horizon.

Ideas at Dex come from design, engineering, our talent team, clients and candidates. You’ll pull them together, decide what matters most, and turn that into a plan we can deliver.

You'll report to our Head of Engineering and work closely with our founder, as well as across the whole business.

The divide between product managers and engineers has never been thinner, you’re excited by how AI is changing our roles and are excited to be part of how the products of the future are built.

You’re AI pilled, you run agents, you tinker and are excited about technology in general

What You'll Do

  • Own the roadmap. Our candidate product, client product, internal tools and the ML systems that power them are all connected. You'll own how they move forward together.

  • Partner with engineering and design. Work closely with our engineers and designers as the work gets done, from scoping through to shipping.

  • Build for our talent experts. Our internal talent experts are at the core of our business. Work alongside them to build a platform that makes them better at what they do.

  • Run delivery. Own our planning sessions and our roadmap in Linear. Make sure we have a plan, even if it might change, so we always know what’s next and roughly what’s after.

  • Do the analysis. Understand what we stand to gain from each piece of work in terms of metrics, set the hypothesis upfront, and work with the people doing the work to confirm or reject it.

What We're Looking For

  • A strong technical PM. You've worked in product at an early-stage company, and you were likely an engineer before that.

  • Delivery focused. You care deeply about moving fast and shipping.

  • Great with stakeholders. You're comfortable with candidates, clients and our internal recruitment team, and you keep all three at the heart of what gets built.

  • Use data, but aren't beholden to it. You make data-driven decisions where you can, and you're not afraid to make the call when the data isn’t there.

  • Forward thinking with AI. You're all in on AI, you build with it and you tinker in your own time.

Nice to Have

What We Offer

  • Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens

  • Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

jobs.title: Product Owner, Growth
jobs.description:
Product Owner, Growth

Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.

We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.

Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

- Mission-critical problems: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.

- High bar, low ego: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.

- Speed over comfort: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.

- Enduring impact: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.

Team & Locations

We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

The Role

We are looking for product owners who are excited to be part of our early story and help us build a category leading company. You will learn quickly, reflect on "the way the world should work", own outcomes, and drive the creation of financial products and experiences to help our customers reach their full potential. You should have a strong sense of ownership and enjoy taking projects from inception to release. As an early employee, you’ll be working with a nimble team of committed and talented employees and having a large, long-term impact on Flex products and culture.

We are open to candidates from Canada, Mexico, the United States, Brazil and Colombia.

What you'll do

  • Develop and own Flex's "Growth engine" across "Infinite wedges". Flex acquires customers in many unique ways that meet business owners where they are. We build software to make these experiences extremely unique. You'll own our growth - end to end - for the full "multi-product" experience.
  • Drive the enhancement of financial services and products, including mobile apps, online account management tools, and virtual payment solutions. Continuously improve the user experience and add features to meet changing customer needs.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to identify opportunities within the organization's operational processes. Develop internal financial solutions, such as automated reporting tools, data analytics platforms, and workflow optimization systems, to increase efficiency and streamline operations.
  • Work closely with compliance and legal to ensure that all products adhere to relevant financial regulations and industry standards. Mitigate potential risks through robust product design and implementation. Stay up-to-date with changes in industry regulations and security protocols.
  • Conduct user research and market analysis to understand customer preferences, pain points, and emerging trends. Utilize these insights to inform product development decisions.
  • Partner with engineering throughout the development lifecycle. Provide clear and detailed product requirements, prioritize features, and ensure the timely delivery of high-quality solutions. Implement necessary measures to safeguard customer data and ensure compliance with relevant laws.
  • Utilize data analytics and performance metrics to assess product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions to optimize products.
  • Work closely with customer support teams to address customer inquiries, feedback, and issues related to products. Continuously strive to improve customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Develop and communicate a clear product roadmap and strategy. Align the product vision with the Flex's overall objectives.

What you'll need

  • Can run sprints.
  • Extremely high trajectory and horsepower. Flex is a place for people who want to own outcomes.
  • Proven experience as a Product Owner or similar role at a startup with a focus on financial products. We bring SaaS platform principles to traditional FinTech.
  • Solid knowledge of credit risk assessment, lending processes, and banking operations a nice to have.
  • Familiarity with compliance standards, regulations, and security protocols relevant to the credit and banking sectors a nice to have. Willingness to become an expert is a must.
  • Excellent communication, translation, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to leverage data and market insights to inform product decisions.
  • Proficiency in using product management tools and platforms to manage the product backlog and track progress.
  • Passion for innovation, customer-centricity, and continuous improvement in product development.

What we offer

  • A visionary founding team with elite backgrounds and substantial industry experience.
  • A substantial Series B round, providing ample growth and opportunities. You're still an early employee. Today is still day 1.
  • A culture that supports remote work and values connection through semi-annual offsites.
  • Support from leading Silicon Valley venture capitalists and industry insiders.
  • An attractive compensation package, including comprehensive benefits and perks.

Compensation

Additional Information

Interested? We'd love to hear from you

At Flex, we value passion, determination, and honesty. Even if you don't fully match the job specifics, we encourage you to apply. Unusual career paths and unique skills can help you stand out. We believe diversity drives our success.

Why Join Us

Build something generational — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners.

Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.

Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.

True ownership — Small teams, high trust, real accountability.

Founder-level exposure — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors.

High bar, high taste — Move fast without cutting corners.

Elite peers — People here are builders, not tourists.

Real upside — Meaningful equity if you help build something big.

Full-Time Brazil, Canada, Mexico, USA

jobs.title: FP&A Manager
jobs.description:
FP&A Manager

About this Role

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategically minded FP&A Manager to join our Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team as a senior individual contributor, reporting to Director FP&A. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex data systems and executive-level strategy. You will serve as a power administrator for our financial planning software while owning a Business Unit P&L and driving cross-functional collaboration.

You love rolling up sleeves and diving into all activities associated with building businesses. You take a collaborative approach to problem-solving and build effective relationships with cross-functional departments to deliver results. You seek to understand business drivers, initiatives, and blockers, are organized, able to balance priorities, communicate well, take initiative, and are able to work in a dynamic environment, and influence all levels of management and across functions and geographies. This person will be working in a global Company that will be working with partners in UK and Poland.

You Will...

  • Support company-wide financial planning process; long term strategy, annual budgeting, monthly forecasting, and reconciliation of variances to actual results
  • Develop trusted relationships with a broad base of key stakeholders and business partners as a key point of contact for Finance
  • Drive business unit and functional level financial forecasts that accurately predict business performance in order to manage towards desired outcomes
  • Contribute to the development and evolution of FP&A processes, systems, and reporting; improving visibility and accountability towards increasing operating leverage for the business
  • Support strategic short and long-term business decisions through financial modeling and analysis of investment opportunities
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills

You Have...

  • BA/BS degree in a quantitative discipline, with 7+ years of progressive experience in corporate finance and operational roles
  • A track record of building strategic financial models that translate operational initiatives into financial impact, working cross-functionally with business partners to validate assumptions, and presenting complex analyses clearly to senior management
  • Experience implementing, administering, or optimizing FP&A planning systems (e.g., Adaptive Insights, Anaplan, Planful) — including configuring dimensions (business unit, department, entity/currency) to enable flexible P&L reporting, managing scenario/version control, and structuring underlying data models that flow through to financial statements
  • Experience building C-suite and Board-level reporting materials — translating complex financial data into clear, audience-appropriate narratives and commentary that connects performance drivers to business impact and informs executive decision-making
  • Strong business judgment and intellectual curiosity; ability to turn data into actionable insights and recommendations via business models and reporting
  • A proactive approach to mitigating risks and managing cross-functional alignment during organizational transitions
  • An openness and experience using AI to bring efficiencies to your work
  • Advanced skills in using Excel and google sheets

Bonus Points...

  • Relevant certification (e.g. CFA/CPA)
  • First-hand knowledge of online advertising or e-commerce
  • Experience with using SQL, BI and analytics tools

Benefits & Perks

  • Salary Range = 132k - 231k USD - (Actual salary available will vary based on location and market factors.)
  • Vibrant team culture
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, Vision
  • Training (unlimited Udemy + more)
  • Flexible working hours and time off
  • Equity & Retirement Programs including 401K match
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • International work environment with start-up culture

About Fandom

Fandom is the world’s largest fan platform where fans immerse themselves in imagined worlds across entertainment and gaming. Reaching more than 350 million unique visitors per month and hosting more than 250,000 wikis, Fandom is the #1 source for in-depth information on pop culture, gaming, TV and film, where fans learn about and celebrate their favorite fandoms. Fandom’s Gaming division manages the online video game retailer Fanatical. Fandom Productions, the content arm of Fandom, enhances the fan experience through curated editorial coverage and branded content from trusted and established publishing brands Gamespot, TV Guide and Metacritic, along with its Emmy-nominated Honest Trailers and the weekly video news program The Loop. For more information follow @getfandom or visit: www.fandom.com.

Fandom is an equal opportunity employer. Fandom values diversity, and all employment decisions are made on the basis of job requirements and individual qualifications.

Bei uns arbeitest du nicht einfach vorgegebene Testfälle ab. Wir möchten, dass du mitdenkst, bestehende Vorgehensweisen hinterfragst und deine Ideen einbringst, um Softwarequalität nachhaltig zu verbessern.

Enter. Jetzt ist der Moment.

Die Fakten.

Du kennst Wärmepumpen aus der Praxis und willst nicht mehr jeden Morgen um 6 auf die Baustelle? Dann bring dein Wissen ins Büro und sorge dafür, dass unsere Anlagen richtig geplant und gebaut werden.

jobs.title: Werkstudent Wirtschaftsinformatik (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Werkstudent Wirtschaftsinformatik (m/w/d)

Wir stellen uns dir vor.

Eine Kanzlei, vielschichtige Leistungsbereiche und über 45 Teammitglieder. Was wie eine klassische mittelständische Steuerberatungs- und Rechtsanwaltsgesellschaft klingen mag, ist bei genauerem Betrachten vielleicht doch etwas mehr. Wir sehen den Menschen vor den Zahlen, denken und handeln fortschrittlich und arbeiten kontinuierlich daran, uns als Kanzlei und Arbeitgeber sinnvoll weiterzuentwickeln.

Dass wir dafür auch einen Wirtschaftsinformatiker (m/w/d) suchen, mag für eine Steuerkanzlei zunächst ungewöhnlich erscheinen. Für uns ist es allerdings der nächste logische Schritt. Schließlich möchten wir die Digitalisierung unserer Kanzlei aktiv vorantreiben, bestehende Prozesse verbessern und neue technische Möglichkeiten im Bereich KI sinnvoll in unseren Arbeitsalltag integrieren.

Wenn du Freude daran hast, technische Herausforderungen zu lösen, digitale Anwendungen weiterzuentwickeln und eigene Ideen in die Praxis umzusetzen, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Natürlich sind auch wir nicht perfekt. Wir geben jedoch jeden Tag unser Bestes, um für dich einen optimalen Arbeitsort zu schaffen.

Dein individuelles Tätigkeitsprofil.

Du interessierst dich für IT und möchtest mit deiner Arbeit tatsächlich etwas bewegen? Bei uns kannst du die technische Weiterentwicklung einer modernen Kanzlei aktiv mitgestalten und dafür sorgen, dass digitale Anwendungen im Arbeitsalltag reibungslos funktionieren. Dabei kümmerst du dich sowohl um unsere bestehende IT-Landschaft als auch um die Entwicklung neuer Lösungen, mit denen wir wiederkehrende Abläufe automatisieren und unsere Prozesse effizienter gestalten.

Konkret erwarten dich folgende Tätigkeitsbereiche:

  • Technischer Ansprechpartner für interne IT-Themen und Unterstützung unserer Mitarbeiter bei Anwendungsfragen

  • Koordination und Zusammenarbeit mit unserem externen IT-Dienstleister

  • Analyse, Bearbeitung und Nachverfolgung technischer Probleme

  • Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Microsoft-365-Umgebung, insbesondere Teams, SharePoint und OneDrive

  • Einführung neuer Anwendungen sowie Dokumentation unserer IT-Systeme und Prozesse

  • Analyse und Optimierung manueller sowie wiederkehrender Geschäftsprozesse

  • Entwicklung und Betreuung automatisierter Workflows mit Power Automate

  • Erstellung kleiner interner Anwendungen mit Power Apps

  • Anbindung von Fachanwendungen über Schnittstellen wie REST-APIs, HTTP, JSON und Connectoren

  • Datenverarbeitung und -aufbereitung mit Excel und Power Query

Unsere Wünsche an dich.

Wir erwarten nicht, dass du bereits jedes Programm beherrschst oder mit sämtlichen Technologien gearbeitet hast. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du ein gutes technisches Grundverständnis mitbringst, dich gerne in neue Themen einarbeitest und Freude daran hast, eigenständig Lösungen zu entwickeln. Schließlich verändert sich die IT-Welt ständig und wir möchten uns gemeinsam mit dir weiterentwickeln.

Von den folgenden Punkten solltest du dich ebenfalls angesprochen fühlen:

  • Du absolvierst aktuell ein Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder bist in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang immatrikuliert

  • Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis für IT-Systeme, digitale Prozesse und technische Zusammenhänge

  • Microsoft 365 ist dir vertraut und idealerweise hast du dich bereits mit Power Automate, Power Apps oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen beschäftigt

  • Begriffe wie APIs, JSON oder Power Query sind dir bekannt und du hast Interesse daran, dein Wissen in diesen Bereichen zu vertiefen

  • Du arbeitest lösungsorientiert, strukturiert und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung

  • Teamzusammenhalt ist dir wichtig und du hast Freude daran, andere Mitarbeiter bei technischen Fragen zu unterstützen

Das passende Umfeld für deine Karriere.

Ein Arbeitsverhältnis ist ein Geben und Nehmen. Deshalb kannst du dich bei uns auf weit mehr als ein sicheres Arbeitsverhältnis freuen:

  • Gelebte Flexibilität mit Home-Office und flexiblen Arbeitszeiten

  • Mentale Gesundheitsförderung mit vielschichtigen Unterstützungsangeboten und zusätzlich bis zu 12 Coaching- oder Therapiestunden pro Jahr

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung durch einen engagierten Ansprechpartner

  • Regelmäßiges Feedback zur fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung

  • Klare Strukturen gepaart mit digitalen und standardisierten Prozessen

  • Vertrauen und Freiraum für ein eigenständiges Arbeiten

  • Weiterbildungsflatrate

  • Nettolohnoptimierung mit 50 Euro Sachbezugsgutscheinen, betrieblicher Altersvorsorge, Kindergartenzuschuss, Bike-Leasing etc.

  • Business-Englisch und einmal pro Woche ein Fitnessangebot

  • Höhenverstellbare Tische und klimatisierte Räumlichkeiten

  • Beste technische Hard- und Software-Ausstattung (Notebook, Geschäftshandy etc.)

  • Support durch einen kompetenten externen IT-Systempartner

  • Regelmäßige Teamevents und vieles mehr

Mit wenigen Klicks zum neuen Job.
