jobs.title: (Junior) E-Commerce Kaufmann (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
(Junior) E-Commerce Kaufmann (w/m/d)

Du denkst mit, setzt Dinge um und begeisterst dich für Shopify & AI? Gleichzeitig behältst du den Überblick, findest Lösungen und kommunizierst klar? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen!

Wir sind NETSHAKE – die AI-First E-Commerce-Agentur

Als Shopify Premier Partner und eine der führenden AI-First-Agenturen Europas vereinen wir fundiertes E-Commerce-Know-how mit künstlicher Intelligenz. Unser Ziel: bessere Ergebnisse, kürzere Umsetzungszeiten und maximaler Output.

Deine Rolle: Shopify & AI Traffic

Als (Junior) E-Commerce Kaufmann bringst du Shopify und AI Traffic zusammen. Du entwickelst Shops weiter, setzt Optimierungen um und arbeitest daran, dass sie bei Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity und Gemini gefunden und empfohlen werden.

Für deine Kunden bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson: Du leitest Workshops, legst gemeinsam mit ihnen Ziele fest und steuerst die Umsetzung deiner Projekte eigenverantwortlich. Dein Teamlead setzt den Rahmen – du sorgst dafür, dass aus Zielen Ergebnisse werden.

Unsere DNA: AI First

AI ist bei NETSHAKE keine Ergänzung, sondern die Grundlage unserer Arbeitsweise. Wir hinterfragen bestehende Abläufe, automatisieren gezielt und fördern den Ausbau deiner AI-Kompetenz. Unsere Überzeugung: Wer AI souverän einsetzt, macht sich nicht überflüssig, sondern unverzichtbar.

Du möchtest Verantwortung tragen, dich schnell weiterentwickeln und den E-Commerce von morgen mitgestalten? Dann werde Teil von NETSHAKE!

Aufgaben

🛍️ Shopify-Umsetzung

  • Du realisierst Shopify-Shops von der ersten Konzeption bis zum Go-live. Theme-Architektur, Liquid, App-Integrationen und Shopify Functions setzt du selbstständig um.

  • Du unterstützt Händler bei Fragen zu Shop-Struktur, Funktionen und technischen Entscheidungen – verständlich, transparent und mit Blick auf die passende Lösung.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für den Erfolg des gesamten Projekts, nicht nur für einzelne Aufgaben.

🔎 GEO & KI-Sichtbarkeit

  • Du bringst GEO-Strategien in die Umsetzung: Mit strukturierten Daten, Schema Markup, Feeds und optimierten Inhalten schaffst du die Voraussetzungen dafür, dass Kundenshops in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini & Co. als relevante Quellen erkannt und empfohlen werden.

  • Du analysierst Shops mit Blick auf ihre KI-Sichtbarkeit und entwickelst daraus konkrete Maßnahmen.

  • Du überprüfst Ergebnisse, testest neue Ansätze und optimierst kontinuierlich – auf Basis von Daten statt Bauchgefühl.

✍️ Content & Lifecycle

  • Du entwickelst Inhalte, die sowohl für klassische Suchmaschinen als auch für generative KI-Systeme optimiert sind.

  • Du betreust den gesamten Content-Lifecycle deiner Kundenprojekte: von der Erstellung über die Weiterentwicklung bis zum Monitoring.

  • Du erstellst monatliche Performance-Reportings und leitest daraus klare nächste Schritte ab.

⚙️ AI-Tools & Automation

  • Du integrierst AI konsequent in deinen Arbeitsalltag – von Recherche und Shop-Umsetzung über Content und Datenanalyse bis zu Qualitätssicherung und Reporting.

  • Du entwickelst AI-gestützte Workflows und Automatisierungen, die wiederkehrende Aufgaben reduzieren und den Output steigern.

  • Du probierst eigenständig neue AI-Technologien aus und bringst konkrete Einsatzmöglichkeiten ins Team ein.

🤝 Händler & Workshops

  • Du planst und leitest Händler-Workshops mit einem klaren Fokus auf messbare Projektergebnisse.

  • Du hältst Kunden und Team proaktiv auf dem Laufenden, sodass der aktuelle Projektstand jederzeit klar ist.

  • Nach jedem Projektabschluss holst du zwei Bewertungen ein – eine auf Shopify und eine auf Google. Dein Qualitätsanspruch: fünf Sterne.

Qualifikation

🎯 Ownership

Du übernimmst Verantwortung – für deine Aufgaben, das gesamte Projektergebnis und den gemeinsamen Teamerfolg. Wenn etwas nicht nach Plan läuft, konzentrierst du dich auf Lösungen statt auf Schuldzuweisungen.

⚡ Eigenverantwortung

Du erhältst ein Ziel und organisierst selbstständig den Weg dorthin. Du planst deine Sprints, behältst Fristen im Blick und kommunizierst Risiken rechtzeitig. Du wartest nicht darauf, angeschoben zu werden, sondern treibst deine Projekte selbst voran.

💡 Weitblick

Du denkst über einzelne Aufgaben hinaus, erkennst mögliche Probleme früh und entdeckst Verbesserungspotenzial in Abläufen. Statt nur Fragen aufzuwerfen, bringst du durchdachte Optionen und eine begründete Empfehlung mit. Bestehende Prozesse hinterfragst du konstruktiv – und entwickelst bessere Alternativen.

🤖 AI-Kompetenz

AI ist für dich mehr als ein hilfreiches Werkzeug: Sie prägt deine Herangehensweise. Du kennst ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity und Cursor und kannst einschätzen, welches Tool für welche Aufgabe den größten Nutzen bietet. Neue Tools und Claude Skills entdeckst und testest du eigenständig und zeigst dem Team, wie sie sich direkt sinnvoll einsetzen lassen. Du verknüpfst Tools, APIs und KI zu neuen Lösungen.

Außerdem bringst du einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch mit: Du gibst dich nicht damit zufrieden, dass etwas lediglich funktioniert, sondern möchtest wirklich gute Ergebnisse erzielen. Du nimmst Feedback offen an, lernst schnell und probierst Neues aus. Auf deine Zusagen ist Verlass – und wenn etwas dazwischenkommt, kommunizierst du das frühzeitig.

Must-haves

  • 🛍️ Shopify-Expertise: Du hast nachweislich Shopify-Shops für echte Händler aufgebaut und betreut. Mit Themes, Liquid und App-Integrationen arbeitest du sicher.

  • 📈 Content & Marketing: Du bringst Erfahrung in Content-Strategie, SEO oder digitalem Marketing mit – idealerweise mit messbaren Erfolgen.

  • 🔎 AI Search & GEO: Du kennst dich sehr gut mit ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini und Claude aus und verstehst, wie E-Commerce-Marken in KI-Such- und Antwortsystemen sichtbar werden.

  • ⚙️ AI Automation: Du hast bereits mit n8n, Make, Zapier, Custom GPTs oder vergleichbaren Lösungen gearbeitet.

  • 💻 Technisches Verständnis: Du verfügst über Grundkenntnisse in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, strukturierten Daten und Feeds.

  • 🎤 Kundenkommunikation: Du hast Erfahrung darin, Kundenworkshops durchzuführen und zu moderieren.

  • 🇩🇪 Deutsch auf C2-Niveau: Du drückst dich schriftlich wie mündlich klar, sicher und einwandfrei aus.

  • 🚀 Hands-on-Mentalität: Du möchtest nicht nur Konzepte entwickeln, sondern selbst umsetzen, Verantwortung übernehmen und Ergebnisse erzielen.

Benefits – warum NETSHAKE?

🤖 AI First – Wissen, das dich weiterbringt

Du arbeitest mit Premium-AI-Tools und vertiefst dein Wissen in regelmäßigen Trainings und Deep-Dives zu aktuellen Modellen, GEO-Techniken und AI-Workflows. Dabei geht es immer um die praktische Anwendung: mehr Output in weniger Zeit.

jobs.description:
Director, Life Science & Biopharma Accounts

About us

Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed.
Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity.
K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners.

The position can be based remotely in the UK, with a strong focus on the US market

Please submit your CV in English

About the role:

Owkin is looking for a sales professional to join our commercial team. Targeting pharmaceutical companies, biotech companies, CROs, VC/PE firms and selected investor-backed life sciences organizations, you'll have a particular focus on the North American markets.

 

This is a new business development focused, individual contributor role, perfect for someone who enjoys creating commercial opportunities from the ground up while working closely with colleagues across Sales, Partnerships, Technical Sales, Product, Delivery and Marketing. You will identify and build relationships with scientific, digital, innovation, commercial, and executive stakeholders, and guide complex opportunities from first conversation through contract signature.

 

You’ll be selling solutions more than simply a technology platform. Your role will be to help customers understand how K Pro can support their challenges in areas such as drug discovery, translational research, clinical development, and portfolio decision-making. In turn, your customer insight will help the wider commercial team recognise market demand and refine our proposition, messaging, and approach.

 

You will be able to engage credibly with life sciences customers, ask the right questions, identify value quickly, and move opportunities forward to conclusion. Every success moves you towards winning the large partnership opportunities that Owkin is achieving with K Pro. 

 

In particular, you will:

  • Own a focused portfolio of target accounts, with a strong emphasis on the North American market and aligned with the wider sales strategy and team priorities.

  • Generate and qualify pipeline within your portfolio through proactive prospecting, referrals, networks, events, and account-based activity.

  • Open and develop relationships with senior stakeholders across pharmaceutical, biotech, CRO and VC/PE organizations.

  • Own the full sales cycle, from qualification and discovery through proposal, negotiation and close.

  • Lead consultative conversations that uncover scientific, operational, and business priorities.

  • Translate customer needs into clear proposals, business cases, pilots, feasibility studies, or broader Owkin K Pro opportunities.

  • Work with Technical Sales, Product, Delivery, Legal, Finance, and Marketing to shape practical solutions and move deals forward.

  • Build internal champions and maintain momentum across complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • Keep CRM activity, pipeline, and forecasts accurate.

  • Bring customer feedback and market intelligence back to Sales, Marketing, Product, and leadership.

  • Help refine our positioning, target segments, sales materials, and commercial approach as our markets develop.

 

About you

Required qualifications / experience:

  • A track record in winning new business in the USA within complex B2B sales, strategic account development, or consultative selling environments.

  • Experience in proactively creating pipelines and closing opportunities with multiple stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with life sciences, healthcare, technology, data, AI, SaaS, research services, or other technically complex environments; an established platform of connections in these arenas would bring a significant advantage.

  • A demonstrated ability to engage credibly with both scientific and business audiences.

  • Strong prospecting, discovery, qualification, presentation, negotiation, and value-selling skills.

  • Commercial judgment and the ability to identify where Owkin can create differentiated value.

  • Curiosity, resilience, and the ability to operate with autonomy in a fast-moving company.

  • Rigorous efficiency in how you plan, prioritise and execute your sales and development activities.

  • Experience using Salesforce or a similar CRM, with sound forecasting and pipeline discipline.

  • Willingness to travel internationally as needed.

 

Preferred qualifications/bonus:

Experience in at least one of the following would be advantageous:

  • Pharmaceutical R&D, biotech, CROs, AI or data platforms, drug discovery, clinical development, biomedical research, investment or PE/VC backed life sciences firms.

  • An academic background in life sciences, technology, or business is welcome but not essential.

What success could look like in the first 3, 6 to 9 months

  • Clear insight into customer needs, competitive differentiation, and the strongest use cases for Owkin and, in particular, K Pro.

  • A focused portfolio of target accounts, a qualified pipeline aligned with team priorities and a plan of priorities and engagement tactics.

  • Rekindled existing connections and built new relationships leading to commercial opportunities across priority customer segments.

  • Early wins through pilots, feasibility studies, or broader solution engagements.

 

This is an opportunity to join a high-performing commercial team at an important stage in K Pro’s development. You will have the autonomy to build relationships and create opportunities within your portfolio, while working closely with colleagues across Sales, Partnerships, Product, Technical Sales, Delivery, and Marketing to develop the strongest approach for our customers.

 

#LI-HB1

What we offer

  • Flexible work organization

  • Friendly and informal working environment

  • Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds

Recruitment Process & Security

  • Please complete the form and submit your CV.

  • Owkin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status or on the basis of disability.

  • Owkin is a great place to work. As a coveted workplace we are, unfortunately, vulnerable to recruitment phishing scams. We urge all job seekers and candidates to be wary of potential scams. Most of these have individuals posing as representatives of prominent companies, including Owkin, with the aim of obtaining personal, sensitive, or financial information from applicants. These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information:

  • Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn.

  • Communication is always through an official Owkin email address (from the @owkin.com domain), over the phone or through our applicant tracking system (Ashby).

  • The Owkin talent team do use platforms such as LinkedIn, however if you have any concern or doubt about this contact, please ask for them to send an email from @Owkin.com.

  • The Owkin talent team will not solicit personal data from candidates during the application phase including, but not limited to, date of birth, social security numbers, or bank account information;

  • Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger

  • Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format.

If you think that you have been a victim of fraud,

  • Check the identity of the talent team on LinkedIn

  • Check our senior team on our website https://owkin.com/team/

  • Check the existence of the position on our website: https://www.owkin.com/careers#current-opportunities

jobs.title: hbo-stage Analyseren kwaliteit bouwvergunningen BAG
jobs.description:
hbo-stage Analyseren kwaliteit bouwvergunningen BAG

hbo-afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027

Ben jij die nieuwsgierige en enthousiaste student die graag in data duikt en op zoek gaat naar opvallende patronen en verbanden?
Krijg jij energie van het ontrafelen van complexe vraagstukken, het ontdekken van inzichten en het vertalen van data naar betekenisvolle resultaten?

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Het CBS ontvangt maandelijks van de 342 gemeenten in Nederland informatie over verleende bouwvergunningen. Gemeenten leveren deze gegevens aan via enquêtes en registreren de bouwvergunningen daarnaast in de Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen (BAG).

Sinds 2025 publiceert het CBS de cijfers over bouwvergunningen op basis van de BAG. Er is echter een groot en toenemend verschil tussen de cijfers uit de BAG en de tellingen uit de enquêtes. Er is reeds onderzoek gedaan naar deze toenemende verschillen.

Als stagiair ga je dit verder onderzoeken, door middel van een diepgaande analyse van de tijdigheid en kwaliteit van de registratie van gegevens in de BAG. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces om beter inzicht te krijgen in hoe de BAG zich verhoudt tot de werkelijkheid.

Je onderzoekt onder andere:

  • Hoe lang wachten gemeenten met registraties?

  • Worden registraties doorlopend geregistreerd, of opgespaard en in korte tijd geregistreerd in de BAG?

  • Verandert de kwaliteit en tijdigheid door de tijd heen?

Om deze vragen te beantwoorden duik je in een grote database, waar je met behulp van SQL en R of Python trends gaat waarnemen, data visualiseert, en samenvattingen maakt.

Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces, en hoe dit is geïmplementeerd bij gemeenten. Voor deze taak is al eerder onderzoek gedaan, en is er ook al meer informatie beschikbaar. Je verzamelt deze resultaten in een rapport met een overzicht van de huidige stand van zaken.

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag

Ons team bestaat uit 24 enthousiaste collega’s, die met veel passie en plezier werken aan statistische informatie over vastgoed en de woningmarkt.

We maken statistieken over (bouw)vergunningen, ontwikkeling van de woningvoorraad, (gemiddelde) WOZ-waardes, eigendomsverhoudingen, tijdelijke woningen, woningtransformaties en nog heel veel meer. We doen statistisch onderzoek op verzoek van organisaties in de publieke sector. En we beheren en verwerken data voor CBS-collega’s en werken samen met diverse organisaties, waaronder het Kadaster, de ministeries van BZK, VRO en EZK en Eurostat.

We publiceren regelmatig over de dynamiek van de Nederlandse vastgoed- en woningmarkt. Onze nieuwsberichten halen regelmatig journaals, nieuwssites en voorpagina’s van landelijke dagbladen. En daar zijn we trots op!

Dit breng jij mee

Je volgt een hbo opleiding in de studierichting toegepaste wiskunde, data science of sociale wetenschappen.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met de woningmarkt.

  • Je hebt kennis en wellicht ervaring met R/rmarkdown en/of Python en SQL databases. 

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en enthousiast om met data aan de slag te gaan.

  • Je vindt het leuk om nieuwe dingen te ontdekken, neemt graag initiatief en denkt actief mee.

  • Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt ook graag de samenwerking op.

  • Je deelt gemakkelijk je ideeën en bevindingen en staat open voor nieuwe inzichten en feedback.

Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • samenwerkt met ervaren experts binnen hun vakgebied;

  • gaat werken met grote databases (SQL);

  • kennis opbouwt van de BAG en het registratieproces bij bronhouders;

  • analyses samenvat in data visualisaties en overzichtelijke tabellen.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken.

Dit zijn onze voorwaarden

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.
Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking.

Je stuurt dagelijks een team van Logistiek Medewerkers aan, bewaakt de voortgang en zorgt ervoor dat de goederenstroom soepel, veilig en efficiënt verloopt. Bij BERG maken we buiten zijn nóg leuker met onze skelters, trampolines, speeltoestellen en ander kwalitatief buitenspeelgoed. Vanuit onze passie voor actief buitenspelen werken we iedere dag samen aan één doel: The outdoors is yours!

What’s in it for you?
Je komt te werken in een gedreven team waar werkplezier, samenwerking en ontwikkeling belangrijk zijn. Als Logistiek Teamleider krijg je een verantwoordelijke en afwisselende rol waarin je direct bijdraagt aan de prestaties van het logistieke team.

Voordelen voor de sollicitant

Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar).

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen.

Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan.

Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten;

· Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope;

· Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat;

· Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig;

· Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift;

· Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch;

· Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties;

· Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij:

· Salaris: We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis;

· Middelen: Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon;

· Werkdagen: Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur;

· Vergoeding voor thuiswerken: Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten;

· Workation: Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken;

· Leuke teamactiviteiten: Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night;

· Vakantiedagen: Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen;

· Groei en ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS;

· Vakantiegeld: Jaarlijks 8,33%;

Waarom CCS?

Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. Kom bij ons en ontdek wat er mogelijk is als je een carrière bouwt vol passie, plezier en betekenis. Jij bent de ontbrekende schakel in ons team. Word onderdeel van ons verhaal. 🚀

jobs.title: General Manager, Venture & Private Equity
jobs.description:
General Manager, Venture & Private Equity

Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.

We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.

Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

- Mission-critical problems: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.

- High bar, low ego: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.

- Speed over comfort: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.

- Enduring impact: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.

Team & Locations

We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

About The Role

Flex is hiring a General Manager to build and run its venture and private equity business. You own the sector end to end: the strategy for winning it, the relationships and partnerships that open it, the product priorities it needs, and the P&L it produces. You build on Flex’s platform, balance sheet and teams, and you are responsible for making Flex the primary financial institution for venture and private equity.

The role is modeled on sector coverage at an investment bank. You decide which relationships matter, which partnerships can move hundreds of owners onto Flex at once, and what the product must deliver to win them. Flex’s product, credit, risk and member experience teams execute and service alongside you. The role reports directly to the CEO.

Funds are the most efficient path to hundreds of owners at once. A sponsor that standardizes its portfolio on Flex, or a venture firm whose founders bank with Flex from their first wire, delivers in one decision what would otherwise take a hundred. The decision sits with general partners, fund CFOs, operating partners, fund administrators and fund-finance lenders. The General Manager owns those relationships.

What You'll Do

  • 7 to 12 years in investment banking, private credit, private equity, venture, or a senior commercial seat inside venture and private equity. You have a demonstrable record of originating business, not servicing it.

  • An active network in venture and private equity. You can name the 50 people who matter and most of them would take your call this week.

  • Fluent in how funds and their portfolio companies move money: capital calls and distributions, portfolio treasury and credit, operating-partner priorities, and what a portfolio CFO requires to move a banking relationship.

  • Comfortable structuring partnerships, negotiating referral economics, and working through a term sheet without support.

  • You build your own models. Banker-level Excel and a working understanding of the unit economics of deposits, cards and credit.

Requirements

  • 7 to 12 years in investment banking, private credit, private equity, venture, or a senior commercial seat inside construction. You have a demonstrable record of originating business, not servicing it.

  • An active network in construction. You can name the 50 people who matter and most of them would take your call this week.

  • Fluent in how contractors are paid and where their capital gets tied up: margins, working capital, pay applications, retainage, bonding, and who lends against each.

  • Comfortable structuring partnerships, negotiating referral economics, and working through a term sheet without support.

  • You build your own models. Banker-level Excel and a working understanding of the unit economics of deposits, cards and credit.

Nice To Haves

  • Experience in fintech, banking or lending, or selling a financial product to business owners.

  • A standing in venture and private equity: a podcast, a newsletter, a conference stage, or a board seat at a trade body.

  • Investing, advisory or operating experience in a company in venture and private equity.

How To Prepare

As part of the application, please be prepared to submit a one-pager along with your CV on how you would bring venture and private equity to Flex. It should cover:

  • The sector and its owners. Who they are, how many of them fall in Flex’s range, how they make money and where their capital gets tied up.

  • What they need from a bank. The products and terms that would make owners in the sector move their primary relationship, and in what order.

  • The map. The 20 to 30 people and institutions that move the sector, and how many of them you know personally.

  • The first three partnerships. The programs that would put hundreds of owners on Flex at once, and why each counterparty would say yes.

  • The investment and the return. A light P&L for the sector: what Flex would need to put in over the first two years (people, product, partnership economics, marketing) and how that investment comes back, in the form of owners banking with Flex and the revenue they produce. We are looking for the shape of the business and the logic behind it.

  • The plan and the team. How you will build this out and what you will need to do it.

    • Treat it as a coverage pitch. Bring the map, the partnerships and the economics, and be ready to defend each one.

Compensation

Compensation follows the coverage-banking model: a base that allows you to build the book without pressure to pursue the wrong relationships, and variable tied to what your sector produces for Flex, with no ceiling.

  • Base salary. $275,000 to $325,000, adjusted for location and experience.

  • Variable. Targeted at 100% of base. Paid on the revenue your sector generates, including owners sourced through your partnerships.

  • Equity. Eligible for equity compensation

  • First year. A guaranteed variable component while the book is built, agreed at offer.

Final compensation within this range will be based on experience, qualifications, and interview performance. This position is also eligible for equity compensation. Flex offers medical, dental and vision insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Additional Information

Why Join Us

Build something generational — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners.

Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.

Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.

True ownership — Small teams, high trust, real accountability.

Founder-level exposure — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors.

High bar, high taste — Move fast without cutting corners.

Elite peers — People here are builders, not tourists.

Real upside — Meaningful equity if you help build something big.

Senior QA Engineer

About us:

Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive.

The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals.

Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market.

As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies.

About the Role:

The Senior QA Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of the company's software products. This role involves close collaboration with product and engineering teams to define clear acceptance criteria, develop and execute comprehensive test strategies, and build robust automated testing frameworks for a modern web application and its backend services. The engineer plays a critical role in maintaining high standards for product releases and improving the overall quality assurance process, while actively pioneering the integration of AI and LLM tools into the testing lifecycle.

What you’ll be responsible for, the QA engineer:

-

  • Analyzes product specifications to derive comprehensive and testable acceptance criteria.

  • Collaborates with product managers and developers to clarify requirements and identify potential edge cases.

  • Designs, implements, and maintains a robust suite of automated tests, including end-to-end, integration, and regression tests.

  • Performs manual testing for complex or new features prior to the establishment of full automation coverage.

  • Monitors, analyzes, and improves test coverage, reliability, and performance over time.

  • Contributes to the continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) process by integrating automated tests into the deployment pipeline.

  • Enhances overall product quality by creating detailed bug reports, providing constructive feedback, and maintaining clear testing documentation.

  • Designs and deploys AI-assisted testing workflows to automate recurring tasks such as test case generation, test data synthesis, and log analysis.

  • Evaluates and integrates LLM-based testing and coding tools into the QA team's workflow, assessing their reliability, accuracy, and fitness for automated testing and edge-case discovery use cases.

Experience and skills required:

-

  • Proven experience as a Senior QA Engineer (5+ Years of experience) or similar role, specifically testing modern web applications and backend services.

  • Strong proficiency with test automation frameworks such as Cypress, Playwright, or similar tools.

  • Deep understanding of backend services, APIs (REST and GraphQL), and their common failure scenarios.

  • Ability to read and comprehend frontend and backend code to assist in debugging and test creation.

  • Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD tools and processes.

  • Hands-on experience with AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or similar) and demonstrated ability to build, deploy, or thoroughly validate agent-assisted testing systems in a near-production context.

  • Proactive and highly detail-oriented mindset.

  • Advanced proficiency in the English language.

Applicants must be based in South, North or Central America

(applications from other locations will not be considered).

This is a fully remote role, reporting to our Tech Lead.

Product Owner, Payments and Infrastructure

About Flex

Flex is building the AI-native private bank for super premium, closely held business owners.

We are re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs. From the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, financial operations, all rebuilt from the ground up as a single intelligent system.

We are replacing the outdated banks and fragmented tools they are stuck with. The opportunity is a roughly $1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. We are building toward $100B+ in enterprise value by delivering a product that is fundamentally better, not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

What we hold ourselves to: mission-critical problems, high bar low ego, speed over comfort, enduring impact.

Locations: Remote. Open to candidates in Canada, Mexico, the United States, Brazil, and Colombia.

The Role

You will build Flex's payments infrastructure. You will lead our vendor strategy across acquiring, international money movement, and partner banks. You will architect how Flex orchestrates multiple payment providers across bank partners, processors, and international rails into a single elegant customer experience. And you will be the product partner on our transition from operating on partner licenses to operating on our own money transmitter licenses, which is a foundational shift in how Flex works.

This seat requires someone who can hold a serious technical conversation with a Tier 1 bank, who has personally implemented payment rails at meaningful scale, and who can translate vendor selection into clear product decisions. The candidate we want has lived through at least one major payments transition (processor change, license expansion, or rails buildout) and knows what to watch for.

You do not need to be a lawyer. You do need to understand what the operational shift into a forward thinking strategy around money movement means, and be able to communicate the now program, the in-between, and the future program clearly to the rest of the company.

What you will do

Own major Tier 1 bank partner implementations and the broader bank partner strategy.

Architect the multi-provider payments stack across acquiring, international money movement, and partner banks. Tomorrow it means more rails, more corridors, more direct integrations.

Lead vendor selection across new payment rails as Flex scales domestically and internationally.

Partner to deliver our MTL acquisition process. Own the product implications of the partner-licensed-to-directly-licensed transition. Translate the operational change for the rest of the company.

Build the framework for international money movement across multiple corridors. Pair payment providers thoughtfully so the customer experience is elegant and the vendor risk is balanced.

Team & Locations

We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

About The Role

Flex is hiring a General Manager to build and run its construction business. You own the sector end to end: the strategy for winning it, the relationships and partnerships that open it, the product priorities it needs, and the P&L it produces. You build on Flex’s platform, balance sheet and teams, and you are responsible for making Flex the primary financial institution for construction.

The role is modeled on sector coverage at an investment bank. You decide which relationships matter, which partnerships can move hundreds of owners onto Flex at once, and what the product must deliver to win them. Flex’s product, credit, risk and member experience teams execute and service alongside you. The role reports directly to the CEO.

Construction is one of the largest and most capital-intensive owner-operated sectors in Flex’s range. Contractors, specialty trades, developers and building-products distributors carry long receivable cycles, bonding requirements and heavy equipment and payroll spend, and they decide where to bank on the advice of a small circle of sureties, lenders, associations and software vendors. The General Manager owns that circle.

What You'll Do

  • Own the sector P&L. You are accountable for one number: owners in construction banking with Flex and the revenue they generate. You build the model behind it, report against it weekly, and answer for it.

  • Map the sector and cover it. Within 90 days you have identified the 200 people who move construction and have a coverage plan for each. From then on, that is where your time goes.

  • Originate. Bring owners and firms to Flex directly, through dinners, site visits, conferences, portfolio days and referrals. You represent Flex in your sector and you are expected to be present in it.

  • Structure the partnerships that move the sector. A surety or construction-lender referral program. A trade association. A franchisor or buying group. A construction ERP integration. A sponsor rolling Flex across a portfolio of contractors. You identify them, negotiate them, and own the relationship after signature.

  • Set the product agenda for your sector. You tell product leadership what owners require before they will move their primary banking relationship, in what order, and why.

  • Build the team as the book grows. You begin with Flex’s account executives, account managers and member experience team supporting you. When the pipeline exceeds what one person can cover, you hire and lead your own sector team.

  • Work AI-native. Research, relationship tracking, outreach and modeling run on tools you build or adopt, so your time goes to relationships.

Requirements

  • 7 to 12 years in investment banking, private credit, private equity, venture, or a senior commercial seat inside construction. You have a demonstrable record of originating business, not servicing it.

  • An active network in construction. You can name the 50 people who matter and most of them would take your call this week.

  • Fluent in how contractors are paid and where their capital gets tied up: margins, working capital, pay applications, retainage, bonding, and who lends against each.

  • Comfortable structuring partnerships, negotiating referral economics, and working through a term sheet without support.

  • You build your own models. Banker-level Excel and a working understanding of the unit economics of deposits, cards and credit.

Nice To Haves

  • Experience in fintech, banking or lending, or selling a financial product to business owners.

  • A standing in construction: a podcast, a newsletter, a conference stage, or a board seat at a trade body.

  • Investing, advisory or operating experience in a company in construction.

How To Prepare

As part of the application, please be prepared to submit a one-pager along with your CV on how you would bring construction to Flex. It should cover:

  • The sector and its owners. Who they are, how many of them fall in Flex’s range, how they make money and where their capital gets tied up.

  • What they need from a bank. The products and terms that would make owners in the sector move their primary relationship, and in what order.

  • The map. The 20 to 30 people and institutions that move the sector, and how many of them you know personally

  • The first three partnerships. The programs that would put hundreds of owners on Flex at once, and why each counterparty would say yes.

  • The investment and the return. A light P&L for the sector: what Flex would need to put in over the first two years (people, product, partnership economics, marketing) and how that investment comes back, in the form of owners banking with Flex and the revenue they produce. We are looking for the shape of the business and the logic behind it.

  • The plan and the team. How you will build this out and you will need to do it.

    • Treat it as a coverage pitch. Bring the map, the partnerships and the economics, and be ready to defend each one.

Compensation

Compensation follows the coverage-banking model: a base that allows you to build the book without pressure to pursue the wrong relationships, and variable tied to what your sector produces for Flex, with no ceiling.

  • Base salary. $275,000 to $325,000, adjusted for location and experience.

  • Variable. Targeted at 100% of base. Paid on the revenue your sector generates, including owners sourced through your partnerships.

  • Equity. Eligible for equity compensation

  • First year. A guaranteed variable component while the book is built, agreed at offer.

Final compensation within this range will be based on experience, qualifications, and interview performance. This position is also eligible for equity compensation. Flex offers medical, dental and vision insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Additional Information

Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.

Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.

Elite peers — People here are builders, not tourists.

Senior Piping Engineer (Power Generation / Gas-to-Power)

What We’re Building

Candid is building the AI layer for EPCs.

We use AI to reduce the manual effort behind preconstruction engineering by automating document understanding, consistency checks, and repetitive workflow steps across major disciplines. Our goal is to make preconstruction 10x faster without sacrificing engineering quality.

We recently raised $6.5M from top AI and industrial investors (including Schneider Electric and Meta’s Chief AI Scientist). Our team includes engineers from MIT, Carnegie Mellon, major LNG and power projects, and leading EPCs.

This Role

We're hiring a senior piping engineer who has actually delivered power generation and gas-to-power projects at a top EPC, PMC, or owner-operator. Think combined cycle, simple cycle and peakers, gas-to-power for data centers and behind-the-meter campuses, LNG, and cogeneration, with the high-energy steam cycle and balance of plant piping that goes with them. If your career has been refining or petrochem process piping with no power work, this isn't the right fit.

This is a hands-on role. You'll do real piping engineering on our delivery work for the parts our software can't handle yet, you'll be the quality check on what the software does produce, and you'll shape where the product goes next. Three jobs in one, and the mix shifts as the product gets better.

What You'll Do

This is hands-on engineering plus product. Day to day you'll:

  • Do real piping engineering on our FEL-2 and early-phase delivery work, owning the parts our software can't handle yet so projects ship

  • Be the quality gate on Candid's automated piping outputs: catch what's wrong before it reaches a client, and feed it back so the product gets sharper

  • Define how piping information gets developed and validated through FEED and early detailed design on power and gas-to-power projects, and what "good" looks like

  • Review and validate piping content across P&IDs, line lists, piping specs, and tie-in lists

  • Build repeatable checks that catch tagging, completeness, and consistency issues early

  • Map where piping rework happens, why it happens, and what inputs drive it

  • Clarify interface points with Process, Mechanical, I&C, Electrical, and Civil/Structural (pipe racks and supports)

  • Separate the steps that are genuinely repetitive from the ones that need real engineering judgment

You'll help define the checks, workflows, and product requirements that let software take on the repetitive parts, with engineers in control.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years at a large scale EPC, PMC, or owner-operator, with most of it on power generation or gas-to-power

  • Direct experience on combined cycle, simple cycle, gas-to-power, LNG, or cogeneration projects (not refining or petrochem only)

  • You've personally owned line list and piping spec development through FEED

  • Strong on power plant piping: high-energy steam cycle (main steam, hot and cold reheat, feedwater), plus fuel gas, condensate, cooling water, and balance of plant piping

  • Hands-on with ASME B31.1 (power piping) and B31.3 (process piping)

  • Familiarity with pipe stress analysis and stress-critical line identification (CAESAR II or similar)

  • Experience with plot plan and 3D model driven layout (AVEVA E3D / PDMS, SmartPlant 3D, or similar)

  • You spot inconsistencies across P&IDs, line lists, and vendor packages fast

  • Clear understanding of cross-discipline dependencies

Nice to Have

  • Discipline lead or technical authority experience

  • Work on data center or behind-the-meter power campuses

  • High-energy piping materials and metallurgy (P91, P22 chrome-moly), or pipe support and spring hanger design

  • Brownfield tie-ins and constructability constraints

  • Real interest in AI and automation

Who Thrives Here

You've outgrown the big-firm machine. You're tired of waiting three weeks for a markup to clear four layers of review, and tired of watching good work die in a stage gate. You want to own your scope end to end, see what you build actually ship, and have a direct line to the founders and the product instead of a 12-person approval chain.

At Candid you'll wear several hats and there's no playbook handing you a defined lane. If that sounds like freedom, you'll love it here. If it sounds like chaos, you won't, and that's okay.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Search & Recommendation
jobs.description:
Senior Staff Software Engineer, Search & Recommendation

About Cantina:

Cantina Labs is a social AI company, developing a suite of advanced real-time models that push the boundaries of expression, personality, and realism. We bring characters to life, transforming how people tell stories, connect, and create. We build and power ecosystems. Cantina, our flagship social AI platform, is just the beginning.

If you're excited about the potential AI has to shape human creativity and social interactions, join us in building the future!

About the Role:

Cantina is a place where people create AI characters and the videos those characters star in, and the catalog grows far faster than anyone can browse. Search and recommendations are what turn that catalog into a product: they decide which characters a new user meets in their first minute, which creators get discovered, and what appears in every feed, leaderboard, and discovery surface we ship. We are hiring a Senior Staff Software Engineer to own that area end to end — retrieval, ranking, relevance quality, and the roadmap for all three. This is the first dedicated hire for search and recommendations, so you will inherit a real production system serving live traffic along with a large amount of unclaimed ground, and you will set the technical direction rather than execute someone else’s.

What you'll do:

  • Own the architecture and roadmap for search and recommendations end to end — query understanding, retrieval, ranking, and the surfaces they feed: search, discovery, the home feed, and our trending and creator leaderboards.

  • Make relevance a measured discipline rather than an opinion: define the quality metrics per surface, build the offline evaluation and golden-set tooling, and run the online experiments that decide whether a ranking change ships.

  • Design and evolve the ranking stack — engagement signal pipelines, decay and freshness models, and the pattern we use to combine pre-computed index-time signals with live re-ranking at query time.

  • Own OpenSearch in production: index and mapping design, reindex and cutover safety, query performance, cost, and the operational headroom of the clusters behind every discovery surface.

  • Build candidate generation and personalization for recommendation surfaces, and partner with data and ML on the feature pipelines and models behind them.

  • Work directly with Product and Trust & Safety on what “good” means for each surface — quality gates, cold-start behavior for brand-new creators and characters, and what must never be recommended.

  • Set the engineering standard for the area: instrumentation, flag-gated rollouts, and runbooks that let other teams change ranking behavior without breaking it.

  • Act as the technical point of contact for discovery across backend teams, and mentor the engineers whose work touches it.

What you'll bring:

  • 10+ years building production software, with substantial depth in search, ranking, recommendations, or ML-driven relevance on a consumer-scale product.

  • Hands-on expertise with a production search engine — OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Lucene, Vespa, or similar — covering index and analyzer design, relevance tuning, and operating the cluster, not only querying it.

  • A rigorous approach to relevance measurement: you have owned offline evaluation, golden sets, and A/B or interleaving frameworks, and you can explain what moved a metric and why.

  • Fluency across the recommender stack — candidate generation, feature pipelines, embedding retrieval, re-ranking — and a working understanding of the serving constraints that make an offline win fail online.

  • Strong distributed systems and backend fundamentals, with production experience in Go or a comparable systems language, and comfort in the data layer behind it (SQL warehouses, streaming and batch pipelines).

  • Demonstrated ownership of an ambiguous area: you have picked up something with no dedicated owner, decided what mattered, and can show the result.

  • Clear written communication and the judgment to work with Product on real tradeoffs between relevance, freshness, safety, and latency.

  • Preferred: experience with AI-generated or rapidly growing content catalogs, severe cold-start conditions, or ranking under trust-and-safety constraints.

Compensation:

The anticipated annual base salary range for this role is between $250,000 - $320,000 (USD). When determining compensation, a number of factors will be considered, including skills, experience, job scope, location, and competitive compensation market data.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary and generous company equity

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance – 99.99% of premiums covered by Cantina

  • 42 days of paid time off, including:

    • 15 PTO days

    • 10 sick days

    • 15 company holidays

    • 2 floating holidays

  • Generous parental leave & fertility support

  • 401(k) retirement savings plan

  • Lifestyle spending account – $500/month to use however you’d like

  • Complimentary lunch and snacks for in-office employees

  • One Medical membership, and more!

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager

About the Role

As a Customer Success Manager at NetBox Labs, you will own the success of a regional portfolio of customers. Your primary responsibility is to make sure customers adopt NetBox Labs’ products and see real value from them, which drives strong retention and healthy expansion.

You will be the main point of contact for your customers from onboarding through renewal. You will run regular check-ins, track customer health, spot risk early, and work with Renewals, Sales, Support, and Onboarding to keep every account on track. You will follow proven Customer Success playbooks and help improve them as the team grows.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise customers within your region

  • Build and maintain customer success plans tied to each customer’s goals

  • Partner with Onboarding to ensure a smooth handoff and fast time to value

  • Drive product adoption through regular check-ins, success reviews, and enablement

  • Build strong relationships with day-to-day users and key technical stakeholders, and grow relationships with senior stakeholders

  • Monitor customer health signals and act early on churn risk

  • Partner with the Renewals team to support on-time renewals with no surprises

  • Identify usage and product expansion opportunities and bring them to Sales

  • Work with Support and Engineering to resolve escalations and keep customers informed

  • Share customer feedback with Product so customer needs shape the roadmap

  • Keep customer records and activity up to date in our CS tools

  • Follow team playbooks and suggest improvements based on what you see in the field

What Success Looks Like

  • High gross retention across your portfolio

  • Customers onboarded on time and actively using NetBox Labs

  • Clear, documented success plans for your key accounts

  • Renewals with no surprises, supported by early risk flags

  • Qualified expansion opportunities passed to Sales, driven by adoption

  • Customers who see you as their go-to contact at NetBox Labs

  • Accurate, current customer data that the team can rely on

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related customer-facing role

  • Track record of driving adoption and retention in a SaaS or subscription business

  • Experience working with technical customers and stakeholders

  • Ability to explain technical capabilities in terms of business value

  • Comfort supporting renewal and expansion conversations alongside Renewals and Sales

  • Organized and proactive, able to manage many accounts at once

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills

  • Experience working cross-functionally in a growing organization

Nice to Have

  • Background in infrastructure, networking, DevOps, or automation

  • Experience in a high-growth or scaling SaaS company

  • Experience with open-source software or developer-focused platforms

  • Familiarity with CS platforms and CRM tools

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

  • We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

  • Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

  • We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

  • Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer (Power Generation / Gas-to-Power)
jobs.description:
Senior Mechanical Engineer (Power Generation / Gas-to-Power)

What We’re Building

Candid is building the AI layer for EPCs.

We use AI to reduce the manual effort behind preconstruction engineering by automating document understanding, consistency checks, and repetitive workflow steps across major disciplines. Our goal is to make preconstruction 10x faster without sacrificing engineering quality.

We recently raised $6.5M from top AI and industrial investors (including Schneider Electric and Meta’s Chief AI Scientist). Our team includes engineers from MIT, Carnegie Mellon, major LNG and power projects, and leading EPCs.

This Role

We're hiring a senior mechanical engineer who has actually delivered power generation and gas-to-power projects at a top EPC, PMC, owner-operator, or equipment OEM. Think combined cycle, simple cycle and peakers, gas-to-power for data centers and behind-the-meter campuses, LNG, and cogeneration, with the rotating equipment and balance of plant that goes with them. If your career has been refining or petrochem static equipment with no power work, this isn't the right fit.

This is a hands-on role. You'll do real mechanical engineering on our delivery work for the parts our software can't handle yet, you'll be the quality check on what the software does produce, and you'll shape where the product goes next. Three jobs in one, and the mix shifts as the product gets better.

What You'll Do

This is hands-on engineering plus product. Day to day you'll:

  • Do real mechanical engineering on our FEL-2 and early-phase delivery work, owning the parts our software can't handle yet so projects ship

  • Be the quality gate on Candid's automated mechanical outputs: catch what's wrong before it reaches a client, and feed it back so the product gets sharper

  • Define how equipment scope gets developed and validated through FEED on power and gas-to-power projects, and what "good" looks like

  • Review and validate mechanical content across equipment datasheets, vendor packages, and discipline handoffs

  • Build repeatable checks that catch scope gaps and inconsistencies early

  • Map where mechanical rework happens, why it happens, and what inputs drive it

  • Clarify interface points with Process, Piping, I&C, and Electrical

  • Separate the steps that are genuinely repetitive from the ones that need real engineering judgment

You'll help define the checks, workflows, and product requirements that let software take on the repetitive parts, with engineers in control.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years at a large scale EPC, PMC, owner-operator, or OEM, with most of it on power generation or gas-to-power

  • Direct experience on combined cycle, simple cycle, gas-to-power, LNG, or cogeneration projects (not refining or petrochem only)

  • You've personally owned mechanical equipment datasheet development and vendor package review through FEED

  • Strong on rotating and power-plant equipment: gas turbines, steam turbines, HRSGs, pumps, compressors, fans, and balance of plant mechanical (cooling systems, fuel gas conditioning, water treatment)

  • Hands-on with equipment specification to API and ASME (API 610, 611, 612, 617; ASME VIII; B31.1 power piping)

  • Experience coordinating OEM turbine and major equipment packages (GE Vernova, Siemens Energy, Mitsubishi Power, or similar)

  • You spot inconsistencies across datasheets, P&IDs, and vendor packages fast

  • Clear understanding of cross-discipline dependencies

  • You've felt boxed in by big-company process and you want out

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and wearing multiple hats; bias to action over waiting for perfect

Nice to Have

  • Discipline lead or technical authority experience

  • Work on data center or behind-the-meter power campuses

  • Taking equipment from FEED into procurement and detailed engineering

  • Packaged or modular systems and skid integration

  • Real interest in AI and automation

Who Thrives Here

You've outgrown the big-firm machine. You're tired of waiting three weeks for a markup to clear four layers of review, and tired of watching good work die in a stage gate. You want to own your scope end to end, see what you build actually ship, and have a direct line to the founders and the product instead of a 12-person approval chain.

At Candid you'll wear several hats and there's no playbook handing you a defined lane. If that sounds like freedom, you'll love it here. If it sounds like chaos, you won't, and that's okay.

Perks

  • Meaningful base + equity

  • Unlimited PTO. Great work needs recharging.

  • Health insurance covering medical, dental, and vision

  • Up to $150/mo health and wellness reimbursement (gym, fitness classes, and similar)

Full-Time USA

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Account Manager

We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

We're hiring an Account Manager II to make Instacart Ads the place CPG advertisers and agencies trust to grow their business, by improving campaign performance, widening how brands invest across our ad products, and shaping the advertiser experience. This role sits at the intersection of client strategy and campaign performance, and the person who fills it will have a direct line of sight to advertiser growth and retention. Twelve months from now, the advertisers you partner with should see Instacart as a growth partner whose recommendations they act on.

What you'll cook up in your first year

  • Advertiser Relationships: CPG clients and agency partners treat you as a trusted advisor. Working with Sales, you understand their business objectives and build strategies that support their long-term growth on Instacart.
  • Campaign Performance: Each advertiser has a full-funnel media strategy tied to its goals. You use campaign data and marketplace insights to recommend investment and optimization approaches that measurably improve results, and you manage gap-to-goal across multiple business units.
  • Advertiser Growth: Advertisers adopt your optimization and upsell recommendations and expand their use of Instacart advertising products. You get there by explaining clearly how each product works, building persuasive narratives, and handling objections with confidence across multiple stakeholders.
  • Business Reviews: Recurring client conversations and quarterly business reviews turn campaign data into a clear story of business impact, opportunities, and next steps. You own the vision and content for these reviews, and advertisers leave knowing what to do next. You also resolve campaign and partner issues with limited guidance.
  • Product and Team Influence: Advertiser pain points reach the right internal teams as specific feedback that shapes product enhancements and process improvements. You also share best practices across the category and Advertiser Success teams and lead projects that strengthen team-wide capabilities.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

You are customer-focused and analytical, comfortable influencing senior stakeholders, and energized by a fast-paced role where priorities and solutions keep evolving. You use judgment and initiative to balance immediate client needs against longer-term chances to improve products, processes, and advertiser outcomes, and you are at your best explaining complex campaign data in plain terms.

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree in business, advertising, commerce, digital marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 4+ years of experience in account management, digital advertising, paid media, ad operations, ecommerce, client services, or a related field
  • Experience building and maintaining strong client relationships in an external-facing role
  • Experience analyzing campaign or business performance data and turning findings into clear recommendations and client-facing narratives
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, and Slides)
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities independently and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced, changing environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presenting confidently to advertisers, agencies, and internal stakeholders

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience with Salesforce and Tableau; familiarity with Mode is a plus
  • Knowledge of paid search, display advertising, ad serving, consumer packaged goods, or ecommerce, and experience developing full-funnel media strategies and optimizing campaigns against performance goals
  • Experience managing business reviews, quota-related planning, upsell opportunities, or growth strategies across multiple business units
  • Strong attention to detail and organization, creative problem solving, and experience influencing product or operational improvements by synthesizing customer feedback and business insights
